title_en: Kitāb al-Kharāj of Yaḥyā ibn Ādam

sections.title_en: In the name of God, the Most Merciful, the Most Compassionate. Chapter on the ghanīma (booty) and the fayʾ.

entries.label: Narration
entries.isnad_ar: حَدَّثَنَا الْحَسَنُ بْنُ صَالِحٍ، قَالَ:
entries.matn_ar: سَمِعْنَا أَنَّ الْغَنِيمَةَ مَا غَلَبَ عَلَيْهِ الْمُسْلِمُونَ بِالْقِتَالِ حَتَّى يَأْخُذُوهُ عَنْوَةً، وَأَنَّ الْفَيْئَ مَا صُولِحُوا عَلَيْهِ، يَقُولُ: مِنَ الْجِزْيَةِ وَالْخَرَاجِ "
entries.isnad_en: Al-Hasan b. Salih narrated to us. He said:
entries.matn_en: We heard that the ghanima is what the Muslims overcame by fighting until they took it by force ('anwatan), and that the fay' is what they were reconciled upon, he says: from the jizya and the kharaj.

entries.label: Narration
entries.isnad_ar: قَالَ الْحَسَنُ بْنُ صَالِحٍ: وَأَمَّا مَا هَرَبَ أَهْلُهُ ، وَتَرَكُوهُ مِنْ غَيْرِ قِتَالٍ، فَهَذَا
entries.matn_ar: " كَانَ لِرَسُولِ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم ، مِمَّا لَمْ يُوجِفْ عَلَيْهِ الْمُسْلِمُونَ بِخَيْلٍ ، وَلَا رِكَابٍ ، فَكَانَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم يَضَعُهُ حَيْثُ يَرَى "
entries.isnad_en: Al-Hasan b. Salih said:
entries.matn_en: As for what its people fled and left without fighting, this belonged to the Messenger of God ﷺ, as part of what the Muslims had not spurred on with horses or camels, and the Messenger of God ﷺ would place it where he saw fit.

entries.label: Narration
entries.matn_ar: قَالَ يَحْيَى: قُلْتُ لِلْحَسَنِ: فَإِنْ قَاتَلُوا عَلَى أَرْجُلِهِمْ حَتَّى يَظْهَرُوا؟ قَالَ: " فَهِيَ لَهُمْ "
entries.isnad_en: Yahya said:
entries.matn_en: I said to al-Hasan: And if they fight on foot until they prevail? He said: It belongs to them.

entries.label: Narration
entries.isnad_ar: قَالَ: " فَأَمَّا الْغَنِيمَةُ فَفِيهَا الْخُمُسُ لِلَّهِ عز وجل، وَهُوَ مَرْدُودٌ مِنَ اللَّهِ عز وجل عَلَى الَّذِينَ سَمَّى اللَّهُ
entries.matn_ar: {لِلرَّسُولِ ، وَلِذِي الْقُرْبَى وَالْيَتَامَى ، وَالْمَسَاكِينِ ، وَابْنِ السَّبِيلِ} [الأنفال: 41] ، لَا يُوضَعُ فِي غَيْرِهِمْ، وَذَلِكَ إِلَى الْإِمَامِ ، يَضَعُهُ فِيمَنْ حَضَرَهُ مِنْهُمْ، بَعْدَ أَنْ يَجْتَهِدَ رَأْيَهُ ، وَيَتَحَرَّى الْعَدْلَ، وَلَا يَعْمَلُ فِي ذَلِكَ بِالْهَوَى، وَمَا بَقَى بَعْدَ الْخُمُسِ ، فَهُوَ لِلَّذِينَ غَلَبُوا عَلَيْهِ مِنَ الْمُسْلِمِينَ، يُقْسَمُ بَيْنَهُمْ بِالسَّوِيَّةِ
entries.isnad_en: He said:
entries.matn_en: As for the ghanima, in it is the fifth (khums) for God, mighty and majestic, and it is returned from God, mighty and majestic, to those whom God named: {for the Messenger, and for the near of kin, and the orphans, and the poor, and the wayfarer} [al-Anfal: 41]. It is not placed with anyone other than them, and that is up to the imam, who places it among those of them who are present, after he exerts his judgment (yajtahid ra'yahu), strives for justice, and does not act in this by caprice. What remains after the fifth belongs to those of the Muslims who prevailed over it; it is divided among them equally.

entries.label: Narration
entries.matn_ar: وَقَالَ بَعْضُهُمْ: لَا يُضْرَبُ إِلَّا لِلْفَرَسِ، وَلَا يُفَضَّلُ الْفَرَسُ عَلَى الرَّجِلِ، وَلَكِنْ لِلْفَرَسِ سَهْمٌ، وَلِلرَّجِلِ سَهْمٌ، وَقَالَ أَصْحَابُنَا: لِلْفَرَسِ سَهْمَانِ وَلِصَاحِبِهِ سَهْمٌ، ⦗ص: 19⦘ فَمَنْ كَانَ مَعَهُ فَرَسٌ ، ضُرِبَ لِفَرَسِهِ بِسَهْمَيْنِ، وَلَهُ بِسَهْمٍ
entries.matn_en: And some of them said: A share is allotted only for the horse, and the horse is not given preference over the foot-soldier, but the horse has one share and the foot-soldier has one share. Our companions said: The horse has two shares and its owner one share, [p. 19] so whoever has a horse with him, two shares are allotted for his horse and one for him.

entries.label: Narration
entries.matn_ar: ، وَمَنْ كَانَ مَعَهُ فَرَسَانِ ، فَقَدِ اخْتُلِفَ فِيهِ، قَالَ بَعْضُهُمْ: " لَا يُضْرَبُ إِلَّا لِفَرَسٍ وَاحِدٍ، وَقَالَ بَعْضُهُمْ: يُضْرَبُ لِفَرَسَيْنِ بِأَرْبَعَةِ أَسْهُمٍ، فَأَمَّا مَا زَادَ عَلَى الْفَرَسَيْنِ مِنَ الْخَيْلِ، فَلَيْسَ يُضْرَبُ لَهُ بِشَيْءٍ، وَالْإِبِلُ وَالْبِغَالُ وَالْحَمِيرُ كَذَلِكَ لَا يُضْرَبُ لَهَا بِشَيْءٍ
entries.matn_en: And whoever has two horses with him, there is disagreement about it. Some of them said: A share is allotted only for one horse. And some of them said: Four shares are allotted for two horses. As for what exceeds two horses, nothing is allotted for it, and camels, mules and donkeys likewise: nothing is allotted for them.

entries.label: Narration
entries.matn_ar: ، وَأَمَّا الْبَرَاذِينُ: فَقَدِ اخْتُلِفَ فِيهَا، فَقَالَ بَعْضُهُمْ: الْبِرْذَوْنُ مِنَ الْخَيْلِ، وَهُوَ بِمَنْزِلَةِ الْفَرَسِ، وَقَالَ بَعْضُهُمْ: يُضْرَبُ لَهُ بِسَهْمٍ وَاحِدٍ، وَقَالَ بَعْضُهُمْ: لَيْسَ لِلْبِرْذَوْنِ شَيْءٌ
entries.matn_en: As for the baradhin (non-Arab horses), there is disagreement about them. Some of them said: The birdhawn is among horses and has the status of the horse. And some of them said: One share is allotted for it. And some of them said: The birdhawn has nothing.

entries.label: Narration
entries.matn_ar: ، وَلَا يَجُوزُ لِأَحَدٍ مِنَ الْجُنْدِ الَّذِينَ شَهِدُوا الْغَنِيمَةَ، أَنْ يَبِيعَ سَهْمَهُ مِنَ الْمَغْنَمِ، وَلَا يُعْتِقَهُ حَتَّى تُقْسَمَ الْغَنِيمَةُ، وَالْغَنِيمَةُ: جَمِيعُ مَا أَصَابُوا مِنْ شَيْءٍ، قَلَّ ذَلِكَ أَوْ كَثُرَ، حَتَّى الْإِبَرَ ، إِلَّا الْأَرَضِينَ
entries.matn_en: It is not permissible for any of the soldiers who witnessed the ghanima to sell his share of the spoil, nor to free it, until the ghanima is divided. The ghanima is everything they obtained of anything, little or much, even needles, except the lands.

entries.label: Narration
entries.matn_ar: فَإِنَّ الْأَرَضِينَ إِلَى الْإِمَامِ، إِنْ رَأَى أَنْ يُخَمِّسَهَا، وَيَقْسِمَ أَرْبَعَةَ أَخْمَاسِهَا لِلَّذِينَ ظَهَرُوا عَلَيْهَا فَعَلَ ذَلِكَ، وَإِنْ رَأَى أَنْ يَدَعَهَا فَيْئًا لِلْمُسْلِمِينَ عَلَى حَالِهَا أَبَدًا فَعَلَ، بَعْدَ أَنْ يُشَاوِرَ فِي ذَلِكَ ، وَيَجْتَهِدَ رَأْيَهُ؛ لِأَنَّ رَسُولَ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم قَدْ وَقَفَ بَعْضَ مَا ظَهَرَ عَلَيْهِ مِنَ الْأَرَضِينَ فَلَمْ يَقْسِمْهَا، وَقَدْ قَسَمَ بَعْضَ مَا ظَهَرَ عَلَيْهِ
entries.matn_en: For the lands belong to the imam: if he sees fit to take a fifth of them and divide four fifths of them among those who prevailed over them, he does so; and if he sees fit to leave them as fay' for the Muslims in their state forever, he does so, after consulting about it and exerting his judgment, because the Messenger of God ﷺ endowed (waqafa) some of the lands he prevailed over and did not divide them, and he divided some of what he prevailed over.

entries.label: Narration
entries.isnad_ar: أَخْبَرَنَا إِسْمَاعِيلُ، قَالَ: حَدَّثَنَا الْحَسَنُ، قَالَ: حَدَّثَنَا يَحْيَى، قَالَ: حَدَّثَنَا ابْنُ مُبَارَكٍ، عَنْ سُفْيَانَ، أَنَّهُ قَالَ:
entries.matn_ar: " إِنْ شَاءَ الْإِمَامُ خَمَّسَهَا، وَقَسَمَ أَرْبَعَةَ أَخْمَاسِهَا، وَإِنْ شَاءَ جَعَلَهَا فَيْئًا، كَمَا صَنَعَ عُمَرُ بْنُ الْخَطَّابِ بِالسَّوَادِ "
entries.isnad_en: Isma'il informed us. He said: al-Hasan narrated to us. He said: Yahya narrated to us. He said: Ibn Mubarak narrated to us, from Sufyan, that he said:
entries.matn_en: If the imam wishes he takes the fifth of it and divides four fifths of it, and if he wishes he makes it fay', as 'Umar b. al-Khattab did with the Sawad.

entries.label: Narration
entries.isnad_ar: أَخْبَرَنَا إِسْمَاعِيلُ، قَالَ: حَدَّثَنَا الْحَسَنُ، قَالَ: حَدَّثَنَا يَحْيَى، قَالَ حَدَّثَنَا وَكِيعٌ، قَالَ: سَمِعْتُ سُفْيَانَ بْنَ سَعِيدٍ، يَقُولُ:
entries.matn_ar: " الْغَنِيمَةُ مَا أَصَابَ الْمُسْلِمُونَ عَنْوَةً، فَفِيهِ الْخُمُسُ لِمَنْ سَمَّى اللَّهُ ، وَأَرْبَعَةُ أَخْمَاسٍ لِمَنْ شَهِدَهُ، وَالْفَيْءُ مَا صَالَحَ عَلَيْهِ الْمُسْلِمُونَ بِغَيْرِ ⦗ص: 20⦘ قِتَالٍ، لَيْسَ فِيهِ خُمُسٌ ، فَهُوَ لِمَنْ سَمَّى اللَّهُ وَرَسُولُهُ
entries.isnad_en: Isma'il informed us. He said: al-Hasan narrated to us. He said: Yahya narrated to us. He said: Waki' narrated to us. He said: I heard Sufyan b. Sa'id say:
entries.matn_en: The ghanima is what the Muslims obtained by force; in it is the fifth for those whom God named, and four fifths for those who witnessed it. The fay' is what the Muslims settled upon by treaty without [p. 20] fighting; there is no fifth in it, and it belongs to those whom God and His Messenger named.

entries.label: Narration
entries.matn_ar: " وَقَالَ بَعْضُ الْفُقَهَاءِ: " الْأَرْضُ لَا تُخَمَّسُ؛ لِأَنَّهَا فَيْءٌ، وَلَيْسَتْ بِغَنِيمَةٍ، لِأَنَّ الْغَنِيمَةَ لَا تُوقَفُ، وَالْأَرْضُ إِنْ شَاءَ الْإِمَامُ وَقَفَهَا، وَإِنْ شَاءَ قَسَمَهَا كَمَا يَقْسِمُ الْفَيْءَ، فَلَيْسَ فِي الْفَيْءِ خُمُسٌ، وَلَكِنْ لِجَمِيعِ الْمُسْلِمِينَ، كَمَا قَالَ اللَّهُ عز وجل: {مَا أَفَاءَ اللَّهُ عَلَى رَسُولِهِ مِنْ أَهْلِ الْقُرَى} [الحشر: 7] حَتَّى قَالَ: {لِلْفُقَرَاءِ الْمُهَاجِرِينَ} [الحشر: 8] ، ثُمَّ قَالَ: {وَالَّذِينَ تَبَوَّءُوا الدَّارَ وَالْإِيمَانَ مِنْ قَبْلِهِمْ} ، ثُمَّ قَالَ: {وَالَّذِينَ جَاءُوا مِنْ بَعْدِهِمْ} ، فَلَمْ يَبْقَ أَحَدٌ مِنَ الْمُسْلِمِينَ إِلَّا دَخَلَ فِي ذَلِكَ، فَإِنْ خَمَّسَهَا ، فَقَدْ صَارَتْ غَنِيمَةً، فَيَقْسِمُ أَرْبَعَةَ أَخْمَاسِهَا بَيْنَ مَنْ حَضَرَهَا
entries.matn_en: And some of the jurists said: The land is not subject to the fifth, because it is fay' and is not ghanima, because the ghanima is not endowed, whereas the land, if the imam wishes he endows it, and if he wishes he divides it as the fay' is divided, for there is no fifth in the fay', but it belongs to all the Muslims, as God, mighty and majestic, said: {What God bestowed (afa'a) upon His Messenger from the people of the towns} [al-Hashr: 7] until He said: {for the poor emigrants} [al-Hashr: 8], then He said: {and those who had settled in the abode and in faith before them}, then He said: {and those who came after them}, so no Muslim remained who did not enter into that. If he takes a fifth of it, it has become ghanima, and he divides four fifths of it among those who were present at it.

entries.label: Narration
entries.matn_ar: " وَقَدْ جَاءَ عَنْ رَسُولِ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم فِي أَعْرَابِ الْمُسْلِمِينَ: " أَنَّهُ لَيْسَ لَهُمْ فِي الْفَيْءِ وَالْغَنِيمَةِ شَيْءٌ - إِلَّا أَنْ يُجَاهِدُوا مَعَ الْمُسْلِمِينَ، فَمَنْ لَمْ يُجَاهِدْ مَعَ الْمُسْلِمِينَ، وَلَمْ يَكُ فَقِيرًا، أَوْ شُغِلَ بِتِجَارَةٍ ، أَوْ عَمَلٍ غَيْرَ ذَلِكَ، فَلَا شَيْءَ لَهُ فِي الْغَنِيمَةِ وَالْفَيْءِ، إِلَّا أَنْ تُصِيبَهُ حَاجَةٌ ، فَيَدْخُلَ مَعَ أَهْلِ الْحَاجَةِ "
entries.matn_en: And it has come from the Messenger of God ﷺ concerning the Bedouins of the Muslims that they have no share in the fay' and the ghanima—unless they wage jihad with the Muslims. Whoever does not wage jihad with the Muslims, and is not poor, or is occupied with trade or other work, has no share in the ghanima and the fay', unless need befalls him, whereupon he enters with the people of need.

entries.label: Narration
entries.isnad_ar: أَخْبَرَنَا إِسْمَاعِيلُ، قَالَ: حَدَّثَنَا الْحَسَنُ، قَالَ: حَدَّثَنَا يَحْيَى، قَالَ: حَدَّثَنَا سُفْيَانُ بْنُ سَعِيدٍ، عَنْ عَلْقَمَةَ بْنِ مَرْثَدٍ، عَنْ سُلَيْمَانَ بْنِ بُرَيْدَةَ، عَنْ أَبِيهِ،
entries.matn_ar: أَنَّ رَسُولَ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم قَالَ فِي أَعْرَابِ الْمُسْلِمِينَ: " لَيْسَ لَهُمْ فِي الْفَيْءِ وَالْغَنِيمَةِ شَيْءٌ، إِلَّا أَنْ يُجَاهِدُوا مَعَ الْمُسْلِمِينَ "
entries.isnad_en: Isma'il informed us. He said: al-Hasan narrated to us. He said: Yahya narrated to us. He said: Sufyan b. Sa'id narrated to us, from 'Alqama b. Marthad, from Sulayman b. Buraydah, from his father,
entries.matn_en: that the Messenger of God ﷺ said concerning the Bedouins of the Muslims: They have no share in the fay' and the ghanima, unless they wage jihad with the Muslims.

entries.label: Narration
entries.matn_ar: قَالَ يَحْيَى: وَقَالَ عُمَرُ بْنُ الْخَطَّابِ رضي الله عنه: " مَا مِنْ مُسْلِمٍ إِلَّا وَلَهُ فِي هَذَا الْفَيْءِ حَقٌّ، إِلَّا مَا مَلَكَتْ أَيْمَانُكُمْ "
entries.isnad_en: Yahya said:
entries.matn_en: 'Umar b. al-Khattab (r) said: There is no Muslim but has a right in this fay', except what your right hands possess.

entries.label: Narration
entries.isnad_ar: أَخْبَرَنَا إِسْمَاعِيلُ، قَالَ: حَدَّثَنَا الْحَسَنُ، قَالَ: حَدَّثَنَا يَحْيَى، قَالَ: حَدَّثَنَا عُثْمَانُ بْنُ مِقْسَمٍ الْبُرِّيُّ، عَنْ عَمْرِو بْنِ عُبَيْدٍ، عَنِ الْحَسَنِ، قَالَ:
entries.matn_ar: " الْفَيْءُ وَالْغَنِيمَةُ مُحْكَمَةٌ، لَمْ يَنْسَخْهَا شَيْءٌ "
entries.isnad_en: Isma'il informed us. He said: al-Hasan narrated to us. He said: Yahya narrated to us. He said: 'Uthman b. Miqsam al-Burri narrated to us, from 'Amr b. 'Ubayd, from al-Hasan, who said:
entries.matn_en: The fay' and the ghanima are muhkama (firmly established); nothing has abrogated them.

entries.label: Narration
entries.isnad_ar: قَالَ يَحْيَى: وَسَمِعْتُ شَرِيكَ بْنَ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ يَقُولُ:
entries.matn_ar: " إِنَّمَا أَرْضُ الْخَرَاجِ، مَا كَانَ صُلْحًا عَلَى خَرَاجٍ يُؤَدُّونَهُ إِلَى الْمُسْلِمِينَ "، قُلْتُ لَهُ: فَمَا بَالُ سَوَادِ الْكُوفَةِ؟ قَالَ: " هَذَا أُخِذَ عَنْوَةً فَهُوَ فَيْءٌ، وَلَكِنَّهُمْ تُرِكُوا فِيهِ، وَوُضِعَ عَلَيْهِمْ شَيْءٌ، وَلَيْسَ بِالْخَرَاجِ "
entries.isnad_en: Yahya said: I heard Sharik b. 'Abd Allah say:
entries.matn_en: The land of kharaj is only what was settled by treaty upon a kharaj that they pay to the Muslims. I said to him: And what of the Sawad of Kufa? He said: This was taken by force, so it is fay', but they were left in it and something was imposed upon them, and it is not the kharaj.

entries.label: Narration
entries.isnad_ar: أَخْبَرَنَا إِسْمَاعِيلُ، قَالَ: حَدَّثَنَا الْحَسَنُ، قَالَ: حَدَّثَنَا يَحْيَى، قَالَ: حَدَّثَنَا زِيَادُ بْنُ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ بنِ الطُّفَيْلِ، عَنْ مُحَمَّدِ بْنِ إِسْحَاقَ، قَالَ:
entries.matn_ar: سَأَلْتُ ابْنَ شِهَابٍ عَنْ خَيْبَرَ فَأَخْبَرَنِي أَنَّهُ بَلَغَهُ أَنَّ رَسُولَ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم افْتَتَحَ خَيْبَرَ عَنْوَةً بَعْدَ الْقِتَالِ، وَكَانَتْ خَيْبَرُ مِمَّا أَفَاءَ اللَّهُ عَلَى رَسُولِهِ، فَخَمَّسَهَا رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم، وَقَسَمَهَا بَيْنَ الْمُسْلِمِينَ، وَنَزَلَ مَنْ نَزَلَ مِنْ أَهْلِ خَيْبَرَ عَلَى الْجَلَاءِ، فَدَعَاهُمْ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم إِلَى مُعَامَلَةِ الْأَرْضِ
entries.isnad_en: Isma'il informed us. He said: al-Hasan narrated to us. He said: Yahya narrated to us. He said: Ziyad b. 'Abd Allah b. al-Tufayl narrated to us, from Muhammad b. Ishaq, who said:
entries.matn_en: I asked Ibn Shihab about Khaybar, and he informed me that it had reached him that the Messenger of God ﷺ conquered Khaybar by force after fighting, and Khaybar was among what God bestowed upon His Messenger, so the Messenger of God ﷺ took a fifth of it and divided it among the Muslims; those of the people of Khaybar who submitted did so on the basis of exile (jala'), and the Messenger of God ﷺ invited them to a mu'amala (sharecropping arrangement) on the land.

entries.label: Narration
entries.isnad_ar: أَخْبَرَنَا إِسْمَاعِيلُ، قَالَ: حَدَّثَنَا الْحَسَنُ، قَالَ: حَدَّثَنَا يَحْيَى، قَالَ: سَمِعْتُ حَسَنَ بْنَ صَالِحٍ يَقُولُ:
entries.matn_ar: " كُنَّا نَسْمَعُ أَنَّ مَا دُونَ، الْجَبَلِ مِنْ سَوَادِنَا فَهُوَ فَيْءٌ، وَمَا وَرَاءَ الْجَبَلِ فَهُوَ صُلْحٌ "، قَالَ حَسَنٌ: " فَمَنْ كَانَ مِنْهُمْ صُلْحًا، فَعَلَيْهِمُ الَّذِي صُولِحُوا عَلَيْهِ، فَيُخَلَّى بَيْنَهُمْ وَبَيْنَ أَرَضِيهِمْ، وَلَا يُوضَعُ عَلَيْهَا شَيْءٌ مَا أَقَامُوا بِصُلْحِهِمْ ، يُؤَدُّونَهُ إِلَى الْمُسْلِمِينَ "
entries.isnad_en: Isma'il informed us. He said: al-Hasan narrated to us. He said: Yahya narrated to us. He said: I heard Hasan b. Salih say:
entries.matn_en: We used to hear that what is on this side of the mountain of our Sawad is fay', and what is beyond the mountain is by treaty. Hasan said: Whoever of them was by treaty, upon them is that upon which they were reconciled, and they are left alone with their lands, and nothing is placed upon them so long as they abide by their treaty, which they pay to the Muslims.

entries.label: Narration
entries.isnad_ar: قَالَ يَحْيَى: قُلْتُ لِلْحَسَنِ: فَإِنْ عَجَزُوا عَنْ ذَلِكَ؟ قَالَ:
entries.matn_ar: " يُخَفَّفُ عَنْهُمْ، وَإِنِ احْتَمَلُوا أَكْثَرَ مِنْ ذَلِكَ فَلَا يُزَادُ عَلَيْهِمْ، وَإِنْ تَظَالَمُوا فِيمَا بَيْنَهُمْ حَمَلَهُمْ إِمَامُ الْمُسْلِمِينَ عَلَى الْعَدْلِ، وَوَضَعَ ذَلِكَ الصُّلْحَ عَلَيْهِمْ جَمِيعًا، بِقَدْرِ مَا يُطِيقُونَ فِي أَمْوَالِهِمْ وَأَرْضِيهِمْ، وَلَا يُطْرَحُ عَنْهُمْ شَيْءٌ لِمَوْتِ مَنْ مَاتَ، وَلَا لْإِسْلَامِ مَنْ أَسْلَمَ مِنْهُمْ، وَيُؤْخَذُ بِذَلِكَ كُلِّهِ مَنْ بَقِيَ مِنْهُمْ مَا كَانُوا يُطِيقُونَهُ وَيَحْتَمِلُونَهُ ⦗ص: 22⦘
entries.isnad_en: Yahya said:
entries.matn_en: I said to al-Hasan: And if they are unable to do that? He said: It is lightened for them; and if they can bear more than that, nothing is added to them; and if they wrong one another among themselves, the imam of the Muslims compels them to justice and imposes that treaty upon all of them according to what they can bear in their property and their lands; and nothing is dropped from them on account of the death of whoever dies, nor on account of the Islam of whoever of them becomes Muslim, and whoever remains of them is held to all of that, to the extent that they can bear and endure. [p. 22]

entries.label: Narration
entries.isnad_ar: " قَالَ يَحْيَى: وَسَمِعْنَا فِي بَعْضِ الْحَدِيثِ:
entries.matn_ar: " أَنَّ رَجُلَيْنِ أَسْلَمَا مِنْ أَهْلِ أُلَّيْسَ، فَرَفَعَ عُمَرُ جِزْيَتَهُمَا مِنْ جَمِيعِ الْخَرَاجِ، وَذَلِكَ أَنَّ أَهْلَ أُلَّيْسَ كَانُوا صُلْحًا "
entries.isnad_en: Yahya said:
entries.matn_en: We heard in some hadith that two men of the people of Ullays became Muslim, so 'Umar removed their jizya from the total kharaj; that was because the people of Ullays were by treaty.

entries.label: Narration
entries.isnad_ar: قَالَ يَحْيَى: قَالَ الْحَسَنُ:
entries.matn_ar: " مَنْ أَسْلَمَ مِنْ أَهْلِ الصُّلْحِ رُفِعَ الْخَرَاجُ عَنْ رَأْسِهِ ، وَعَنْ أَرْضِهِ، تَصِيرُ أَرْضَ عُشْرٍ، إِلَا أَنْ يَكُونَ مِنْ أَهْلِ الصُّلْحِ، صُولِحُوا عَلَى أَنْ يُوضَعَ عَلَى رُءُوسِهِمُ الْجِزْيَةُ، وَعَلَى أَرْضِيهِمُ الْخَرَاجُ، فَمَنْ أَسْلَمَ رُفِعَتِ الْجِزْيَةُ عَنْ رَأْسِهِ، وَكَانَ الْخَرَاجُ عَلَى أَرْضِهِ عَلَى حَالِهِ
entries.isnad_en: Yahya said: Al-Hasan said:
entries.matn_en: Whoever of the people of the treaty becomes Muslim, the kharaj is lifted from his head and from his land; it becomes 'ushr land, unless he is of the people of a treaty who were reconciled on the basis that the jizya be placed on their heads and the kharaj on their lands: then whoever becomes Muslim, the jizya is lifted from his head and the kharaj remains upon his land as it was.

entries.label: Narration
entries.matn_ar: قَالَ يَحْيَى: قَالَ حَسَنٌ: وَأَمَّا سَوَادُنَا هَذَا، فَإِنَّا سَمِعْنَا أَنَّهُ كَانَ فِي أَيْدِي النَّبَطِ، فَظَهَرَ عَلَيْهِمْ أَهْلُ فَارِسَ، فَكَانُوا يُؤَدُّونَ إِلَيْهِمُ الْخَرَاجَ، فَلَمَّا ظَهَرَ الْمُسْلِمُونَ عَلَى أَهْلِ فَارِسَ، تَرَكُوا السَّوَادَ وَمَنْ يُقَاتِلُهُمْ مِنَ النَّبَطِ وَالدَّهَّاقِينَ عَلَى حَالِهِمْ، وَوَضَعُوا الْجِزْيَةَ عَلَى رُءُوسِ الرِّجَالِ، وَمَسَحُوا عَلَيْهِمْ مَا كَانَ فِي أَيْدِيهِمْ مِنَ الْأَرْضِ، وَوَضَعُوا عَلَيْهَا الْخَرَاجَ، وَقَبَضُوا عَلَى كُلِّ أَرْضٍ لَيْسَتْ فِي يَدِ أَحَدٍ فَكَانَتْ صَوَافِيَ إِلَى الْإِمَامِ
entries.isnad_en: Yahya said: Hasan said:
entries.matn_en: As for this Sawad of ours, we heard that it was in the hands of the Nabat; the people of Fars prevailed over them, and they used to pay the kharaj to them. When the Muslims prevailed over the people of Fars, they left the Sawad and those of the Nabat and the dihqans who did not fight them as they were, and placed the jizya on the heads of the men, and surveyed for them what was in their hands of land and placed the kharaj upon it, and took possession of every land that was in the hand of no one, and it became sawafi (crown lands) for the imam.

entries.label: Narration
entries.matn_ar: " قَالَ يَحْيَى: وَمِنْ حُجَّةِ حَسَنٍ فِي الْأَرْضِ الَّتِي لَمْ يُوضَعْ عَلَيْهَا الْخَرَاجُ، أَنَّهَا أَرْضُ عُشْرٍ إِذَا أَسْلَمَ صَاحِبُهَا: قَوْلُ عُمَرَ لِلرَّجُلِ حِينَ قَالَ: أَسْلَمْتُ ، فَضَعْ عَنْ أَرْضِي الْخَرَاجَ - فَقَالَ: " إِنَّ أَرْضَكَ أُخِذَتْ عَنْوَةً "، فَهَذَا غَيْرُ مَا صُولِحُوا عَلَيْهِ، وَوَضَعَ عُمَرُ الْخَرَاجَ عَلَى كُلِّ عَامِرٍ وَغَامِرٍ مِنْ أَرَضِيهِمْ يَنَالُهُ الْمَاءُ ، وَيَقْدِرُ عَلَى عِمَارَتِهِ، عَمِلَهُ صَاحِبُهُ أَوْ لَمْ يَعْمَلْهُ. قَالَ حَسَنٌ: وَلَا أَنْ يَدَعَ عَمَلَهُ مِنْ عُذْرٍ، فَإِنَّهُ يُخَفَّفُ عَنْهُ، وَلَا يُكَلَّفُ فَوْقَ طَاقَتِهِ "
entries.isnad_en: Yahya said:
entries.matn_en: Among the argument of Hasan concerning the land upon which the kharaj was not placed, that it is 'ushr land when its owner becomes Muslim, is the statement of 'Umar to the man when he said: I have become Muslim, so lift the kharaj from my land. He said: Your land was taken by force. This differs from what they were reconciled upon. 'Umar placed the kharaj on every cultivated and uncultivated tract ('amir wa-ghamir) of their lands that water reaches and that can be cultivated, whether its owner worked it or did not work it. Hasan said: But [this does] not [apply] if he abandons working it for an excuse, for it is lightened for him and he is not burdened beyond his capacity.

entries.label: Narration
entries.isnad_ar: قَالَ حَسَنٌ فِي أَرْضِ الْخَرَاجِ لِأَهْلِ الذِّمَّةِ:
entries.matn_ar: " مَنْ أَسْلَمَ مِنْهُمْ فَهُوَ حُرٌّ مُسْلِمٌ، وَيُطْرَحُ الْجِزْيَةُ عَنْ رَأْسِهِ، وَلَهُ الْخِيَارُ فِي أَرْضِهِ، إِنْ شَاءَ أَقَامَ فِيهَا ، يُؤَدِّي عَنْهَا مَا ⦗ص: 23⦘ كَانَتْ تُؤَدِّي، وَإِنْ شَاءَ تَرَكَهَا ، فَقَبَضَهَا الْإِمَامُ لِلْمُسْلِمِينَ مَعَ مَا فِي يَدَيْهِ، مِمَّا كَانَ فِي أَيْدِي أَهْلِ فَارِسَ
entries.isnad_en: Hasan said concerning the kharaj land of the dhimmis:
entries.matn_en: Whoever of them becomes Muslim is a free Muslim, and the jizya is dropped from his head, and he has the choice regarding his land: if he wishes he stays on it, paying for it what it used to pay, [p. 23] and if he wishes he leaves it, and the imam takes possession of it for the Muslims together with what is in his hands of what was in the hands of the people of Fars.

entries.label: Narration
entries.matn_ar: ، وَمَنْ قُتِلَ مِنْهُمْ فِي الْحَرْبِ، وَمَنْ هَرَبَ وَتَرَكَ أَرْضَهُ، وَكُلُّ أَرْضٍ لَمْ يَكُنْ فِيهَا أَحَدٌ يُمْسَحُ عَلَيْهِ، وَلَمْ يُوضَعْ عَلَيْهَا الْخَرَاجُ، قَالَ الْحَسَنُ: " فَذَلِكَ لِلْمُسْلِمِينَ، وَهُوَ إِلَى الْإِمَامِ، إِنْ شَاءَ أَقَامَ فِيهَا مَنْ يُعَمِّرُهَا، وَيُؤَدِّي إِلَى بَيْتِ مَالِ الْمُسْلِمِينَ عَنْهَا شَيْئًا، وَيَكُونُ الْفَضْلَةُ لَهُ، وَإِنْ شَاءَ أَنْفَقَ عَلَيْهَا مِنْ بَيْتِ مَالِ الْمُسْلِمِينَ، وَاسْتَأْجَرَ مَنْ يَقُومُ فِيهَا، وَيَكُونُ فَضْلُهَا لِلْمُسْلِمِينَ، وَإِنْ شَاءَ أَقْطَعَهَا رَجُلًا مِمَّنْ لَهُ غَنَاءٌ عَنِ الْمُسْلِمِينَ "
entries.matn_en: And whoever of them was killed in the war, and whoever fled and left his land, and every land in which there was no one to be surveyed and upon which the kharaj was not placed—al-Hasan said: That belongs to the Muslims and is up to the imam: if he wishes he settles on it someone who develops it and pays something from it to the treasury (bayt mal) of the Muslims, with the surplus going to him; and if he wishes he spends on it from the treasury of the Muslims and hires someone to attend to it, with its surplus going to the Muslims; and if he wishes he grants it as an iqta' to a man of those who render service (ghana') on behalf of the Muslims.

entries.label: Narration
entries.matn_ar: قَالَ يَحْيَى: وَكَرِهَ حَسَنُ بْنُ صَالِحٍ شِرَى أَرْضِ الْخَرَاجِ، " وَلَمْ يَرَ بَأْسًا بِشِرَى أَرْضِ الصُّلْحِ مِثْلَ أَهْلِ الْحِيرَةِ وَنَحْوِهِمْ "
entries.isnad_en: Yahya said:
entries.matn_en: Hasan b. Salih disliked the purchase of kharaj land, and saw no harm in the purchase of land of treaty, such as the people of al-Hira and the like.

entries.label: Narration
entries.isnad_ar: أَخْبَرَنَا إِسْمَاعِيلُ، قَالَ: حَدَّثَنَا الْحَسَنُ، قَالَ: حَدَّثَنَا يَحْيَى، قَالَ: حَدَّثَنَا الْحَسَنُ بْنُ صَالِحٍ، عَنِ ابْنِ أَبِي لَيْلَى، أَنَّهُ كَانَ يَقُولُ:
entries.matn_ar: " قَدْ رَدَّ عُمَرُ بْنُ الْخَطَّابِ رضي الله عنه إِلَيْهِمْ أَرَضِيهِمْ، وَتَرَكَهَا لَهُمْ ، وَصَالَحَهُمْ عَلَى الْخَرَاجِ، قَالَ: " فَكَانَ لَا يَرَى بِشِرَاهَا بَأْسًا "
entries.isnad_en: Isma'il informed us. He said: al-Hasan narrated to us. He said: Yahya narrated to us. He said: al-Hasan b. Salih narrated to us, from Ibn Abi Layla,
entries.matn_en: that he used to say: 'Umar b. al-Khattab (r) returned their lands to them and left them to them, and reconciled them on the kharaj. He said: So he saw no harm in purchasing it.

entries.label: Narration
entries.isnad_ar: قَالَ يَحْيَى: قَالَ الْحَسَنُ فِي أَهْلِ الْخَرَاجِ الَّذِينَ وَضَعَ عَلَيْهِمْ عُمَرُ بْنُ الْخَطَّابِ الْجِزْيَةَ عَلَى رُءُوسِهِمْ ثَمَانِيَةً وَأَرْبَعِينَ، وَأَرْبَعَةً وَعِشْرِينَ، وَاثْنَيْ عَشَرَ، قَالَ:
entries.matn_ar: " وَلَا يُوضَعُ عَلَيْهِمْ أَكْثَرُ مِنْ ذَلِكَ، وَمَنْ عَجَزَ مِنْهُمْ خُفِّفَ عَنْهُ، وَأَمَّا أَرْضُهُمْ فَعَلَيْهَا الْخَرَاجُ الَّذِي وَضَعَهُ عُمَرُ بْنُ الْخَطَّابِ: عَلَى الْجَرِيبِ قَفِيزٌ وَدِرْهَمٌ، وَعَلَى النَّخْلِ وَالرِّطَابِ وَالْكَرْمِ وَالشَّجَرِ مَا وَضَعَهُ عَلَيْهِمْ عُمَرُ، فَإِنِ احْتَمَلُوا أَكْثَرَ مِنْ ذَلِكَ فَلَا يُزَادُ عَلَيْهِمْ، وَإِنْ عَجَزُوا عَنْ ذَلِكَ خُفِّفَ عَنْهُمْ، وَلَا يُكَلَّفُونَ فَوْقَ طَاقَتِهِمْ "، كَمَا قَالَ عُمَرُ "
entries.isnad_en: Yahya said: Al-Hasan said:
entries.matn_en: Concerning the people of the kharaj upon whose heads 'Umar b. al-Khattab placed the jizya—forty-eight, twenty-four and twelve [dirhams]—he said: No more than that is placed upon them, and whoever of them is unable is lightened; as for their land, upon it is the kharaj that 'Umar b. al-Khattab placed: on the jarib a qafiz and a dirham, and on date palms, fresh fodder (ritab), vines and trees what 'Umar placed on them. If they can bear more than that, nothing is added to them, and if they are unable it is lightened for them, and they are not burdened beyond their capacity, as 'Umar said.

entries.label: Narration
entries.isnad_ar: قَالَ يَحْيَى، قَالَ حَسَنٌ:
entries.matn_ar: " وَلَا نَعْلَمُ عَلِيًّا خَالَفَ عُمَرَ، وَلَا غَيَّرَ شَيْئًا مِمَّا صَنَعَ حِينَ قَدِمَ الْكُوفَةَ "
entries.isnad_en: Yahya said, Hasan said:
entries.matn_en: We do not know that 'Ali opposed 'Umar, or changed anything of what he did when he came to Kufa.

entries.label: Narration
entries.isnad_ar: أَخْبَرَنَا إِسْمَاعِيلُ، قَالَ: حَدَّثَنَا الْحَسَنُ، قَالَ: حَدَّثَنَا يَحْيَى، قَالَ: حَدَّثَنَا ابْنُ مُبَارَكٍ، عَنْ إِسْمَاعِيلَ بْنِ أَبِي خَالِدٍ، عَنِ الشَّعْبِيِّ،
entries.matn_ar: أَنَّ عَلِيًّا عليه السلام قَالَ لِأَهْلِ نَجْرَانَ حِينَ كَلَّمُوهُ: " إِنَّ عُمَرَ كَانَ رَشِيدَ الْأَمْرِ، وَلَنْ أُغَيِّرَ شَيْئًا صَنَعَهُ عُمَرُ رَضِيَ اللَّهُ عَنْهُ
entries.isnad_en: Isma'il informed us. He said: al-Hasan narrated to us. He said: Yahya narrated to us. He said: Ibn Mubarak narrated to us, from Isma'il b. Abi Khalid, from al-Sha'bi,
entries.matn_en: that 'Ali (a) said to the people of Najran when they spoke to him: 'Umar was sound in his judgment (rashid al-amr), and I will not change anything that 'Umar (r) did.

entries.label: Narration
entries.isnad_ar: أَخْبَرَنَا إِسْمَاعِيلُ، قَالَ: حَدَّثَنَا الْحَسَنُ، قَالَ: حَدَّثَنَا يَحْيَى، قَالَ: حَدَّثَنَا ⦗ص: 24⦘ أَبُو مُعَاوِيَةَ، عَنْ حَجَّاجٍ، عَمَّنْ أَخْبَرَهُ، عَنِ الشَّعْبِيِّ، قَالَ:
entries.matn_ar: قَالَ عَلِيٌّ رضي الله عنه حِينَ قَدِمَ الْكُوفَةَ: " مَا كُنْتُ لِأَحُلَّ عُقْدَةً شَدَّهَا عُمَرُ "
entries.isnad_en: Isma'il informed us. He said: al-Hasan narrated to us. He said: Yahya narrated to us. He said: [p. 24] Abu Mu'awiya narrated to us, from Hajjaj, from one who informed him, from al-Sha'bi, who said:
entries.matn_en: 'Ali (r) said when he came to Kufa: I would not undo a knot that 'Umar tied.

entries.label: Narration
entries.isnad_ar: أَخْبَرَنَا إِسْمَاعِيلُ، قَالَ: حَدَّثَنَا الْحَسَنُ، قَالَ: حَدَّثَنَا يَحْيَى، قَالَ: حَدَّثَنَا شَرِيكٌ، عَنْ زُبَيْدٍ "
entries.matn_ar: كَانَ عَلِيٌّ يُشَبَّهُ بِعُمَرَ - يَعْنِي: فِي السِّيرَةِ "
entries.isnad_en: Isma'il informed us. He said: al-Hasan narrated to us. He said: Yahya narrated to us. He said: Sharik narrated to us, from Zubayd:
entries.matn_en: 'Ali was likened to 'Umar—meaning: in conduct (sira).

entries.label: Narration
entries.isnad_ar: قَالَ يَحْيَى: قَالَ حَسَنُ بْنُ صَالِحٍ فِي الْمُسْلِمِ يَشْتَرِي أَرْضَ الْخَرَاجِ، كَرِهَهَ، وَقَالَ:
entries.matn_ar: " إِنْ فَعَلَ ، فَعَلَيْهِ أَنْ يُؤَدِّيَ عَنِ الْأَرْضِ مَا كَانَ يُؤَدِّي عَنْهَا، وَعَلَيْهِ الْعُشْرُ أَوْ نِصْفُ الْعُشْرِ فِي ثَمَرَتِهِ وَحَرْثِهِ، كَانَ يَقُولُ: " الْخَرَاجُ عَلَى الْأَرْضِ، وَالْعُشْرُ أَوْ نِصْفُ الْعُشْرِ زَكَاةٌ مَفْرُوضَةٌ عَلَى الْمُسْلِمِينَ "، وَذَكَرَهُ عَنْ عُمَرَ بْنِ عَبْدِ الْعَزِيزِ
entries.isnad_en: Yahya said: Hasan b. Salih said
entries.matn_en: regarding a Muslim who buys kharaj land—he disliked it, and said: If he does, he must pay for the land what it used to pay, and he must pay the 'ushr or half the 'ushr on its fruit and its crops. He used to say: The kharaj is on the land, and the 'ushr or half 'ushr is an obligatory zakat upon the Muslims. And he mentioned it from 'Umar b. 'Abd al-'Aziz.

entries.label: Narration
entries.matn_ar: قَالَ يَحْيَى: وَأَحْسَنُ ذَلِكَ عِنْدَنَا فِي نَصْرَانِيَّيْنِ مِنْ بَنِي تَغْلِبَ اشْتَرَيَا أَرْضَ خَرَاجٍ: أَنَّ عَلَيْهِ الْخَرَاجَ، وَلَيْسَ عَلَيْهِ غَيْرُهُ، كَمَا قَالَ عُمَرُ لِعُتْبَةَ بْنِ فَرْقَدٍ حِينَ اشْتَرَى أَرْضَ خَرَاجٍ، فَقَالَ عُمَرُ: " أَدِّ عَنْهَا مَا كَانَتْ تُؤَدِّي "
entries.isnad_en: Yahya said:
entries.matn_en: The best view in our opinion concerning two Christians of Banu Taghlib who purchased kharaj land is that he owes the kharaj, and nothing else is owed by him, as 'Umar said to 'Utba b. Farqad when he purchased kharaj land: 'Umar said: Pay for it what it used to pay.

entries.label: Unnumbered report
entries.matn_ar: قَالَ يَحْيَى: وَسَمِعْنَا عَنْ عِكْرِمَةَ أَنَّهُ قَالَ: " لَا يَجْتَمِعُ الْعُشْرُ وَالْخَرَاجُ
entries.isnad_en: Yahya said:
entries.matn_en: And we heard from 'Ikrima that he said: The 'ushr and the kharaj are not combined

entries.label: Narration
entries.isnad_ar: أَخْبَرَنَا إِسْمَاعِيلُ، قَالَ: حَدَّثَنَا الْحَسَنُ، قَالَ: حَدَّثَنَا يَحْيَى، قَالَ: حَدَّثَنَا حَسَنٌ، عَنِ ابْنِ أَبِي لَيْلَى، قَالَ:
entries.matn_ar: " يُرْسَلُ إِلَى نَصَارَى بَنِي تَغْلِبَ فِي دِيَارِهِمْ، وَيُضَاعَفُ عَلَيْهِمِ الصَّدَقَةُ
entries.isnad_en: Isma'il informed us. He said: al-Hasan narrated to us. He said: Yahya narrated to us. He said: Hasan narrated to us, from Ibn Abi Layla, who said:
entries.matn_en: A collector is sent to the Christians of Banu Taghlib in their homes, and the sadaqa is doubled upon them.

entries.label: Narration
entries.matn_ar: " قَالَ الْحَسَنُ: وَلَا يُرْسَلُ إِلَى أَحَدٍ مِنْ أَهْلِ الذِّمَّةِ فِي مَوَاشِيهِمْ مِنَ الْإِبِلِ وَالْبَقَرِ وَالْغَنَمِ السَّائِمَةِ، وَلَا فِي شَيْءٍ مِنَ الثِّمَارِ وَالزَّرْعِ فِي أَرَضِيهِمْ، غَيْرَ بَنِي تَغْلِبَ، فَإِنَّهُ يُرْسَلُ إِلَيْهِمْ فِي ذَلِكَ كُلِّهِ؛ لِأَنَّهُمْ صُولِحُوا عَلَيْهِ، هَذَا مَعْنَى مَا قَالَ حَسَنٌ، يَقُولُ: " هَذَا عَلَيْهِمْ بِمَنْزِلَةِ الْجِزْيَةِ عَلَى غَيْرِهِمْ، يُؤْخَذُونَ بِهِ، وَلَيْسَ يُؤْخَذُ مِنْ غَيْرِهِمْ مِنْ أَهْلِ الذِّمَّةِ صَدَقَةٌ مُضَاعَفَةٌ، إِلَّا فِيمَا تَجِرُوا فِيهِ، إِذَا مَرُّوا بِهِ عَلَى الْعَاشِرِ "
entries.isnad_en: Al-Hasan said:
entries.matn_en: A collector is not sent to anyone of the dhimmis for their livestock—camels, cattle and pasturing sheep—nor for any of the fruits and crops on their lands, other than Banu Taghlib; for them he is sent for all of that, because they were reconciled upon it. This is the meaning of what Hasan said; he says: This is upon them in the position of the jizya on others; they are held to it. And from other dhimmis no doubled sadaqa is taken, except on what they trade in, when they pass with it by the 'ashir (toll collector).

entries.label: Narration
entries.isnad_ar: أَخْبَرَنَا إِسْمَاعِيلُ، قَالَ: حَدَّثَنَا الْحَسَنُ، قَالَ: حَدَّثَنَا يَحْيَى، قَالَ:
entries.matn_ar: وَقَالَ حَسَنٌ: " مَنْ أَسْلَمَ مِنْ بَنِي تَغْلِبَ فَأَرْضُهُ أَرْضُ عُشْرٍ؛ لِأَنَّهَا لَمْ تَكُنْ أَرْضَ خَرَاجٍ "
entries.isnad_en: Isma'il informed us. He said: al-Hasan narrated to us. He said: Yahya narrated to us. He said: And Hasan said:
entries.matn_en: Whoever of Banu Taghlib becomes Muslim, his land is 'ushr land, because it was not kharaj land.

entries.label: Narration
entries.matn_ar: قَالَ حَسَنٌ: وَيُؤْخَذُ مِنْ جَمِيعِ أَهْلِ الذِّمَّةِ فِيمَا تَجِرُوا فِيهِ إِذَا مَرُّوا بِهِ عَلَى ⦗ص: 25⦘ الْعَاشِرِ، وَلَا يُؤْخَذُ مِنْهُمْ فِي السَّنَةِ إِلَا مَرَّةً، وَلَا يُؤْخَذُ مِنْ أَقَلَّ مِنْ مِائَتَيْ دِرْهَمٍ شَيْءٌ، وَيُضَاعَفُ عَلَيْهِمُ الصَّدَقَةُ فِي ذَلِكَ كُلِّهِ، يُؤْخَذُ مِنْهُمْ نِصْفُ الْعُشْرِ، وَيُؤْخَذُ مِنْ أَهْلِ الْحَرْبِ الْعُشْرُ، قَالَ يَحْيَى: " وَأَحْسَنُ ذَلِكَ عِنْدَنَا أَنْ يُجْعَلَ كُلُّ شَيْءٍ يُؤْخَذُ مِنْ بَنِي تَغْلِبَ وَمِمَّا تَجِرَ فِيهِ أَهْلُ الْعَهْدِ، وَمَنْ دَخَلَ إِلَيْنَا مِنْ أَهْلِ الْحَرْبِ بِأَمَانٍ فِي تِجَارَةٍ، فَذَلِكَ كُلُّهُ بِمَنْزِلَةِ الْفَيْءِ؛ لِأَنَّهُ صُلْحٌ ، وَلَيْسَ بِمَنْزِلَةِ الصَّدَقَةِ، إِنَّمَا هُوَ فَيْءٌ لِلْمُسْلِمِينَ، بِمَنْزِلَةِ الْخَرَاجِ وَالْجِزْيَةِ "
entries.isnad_en: Hasan said:
entries.matn_en: And from all the dhimmis is taken what they trade in when they pass with it by the 'ashir, [p. 25] and it is taken from them only once a year, and nothing is taken from less than two hundred dirhams, and the sadaqa is doubled upon them in all of that: half of the 'ushr is taken from them, and the 'ushr is taken from the people of war (ahl al-harb). Yahya said: The best view in our opinion is that everything taken from Banu Taghlib, and from what the people of the covenant trade in, and from those of the people of war who enter our land under a safe-conduct (aman) for trade—all of that is in the position of fay', because it is by treaty and is not in the position of sadaqa; it is only fay' for the Muslims, in the position of the kharaj and the jizya.

entries.label: Narration
entries.isnad_ar: قال يَحْيَى، قَالَ حَسَنٌ:
entries.matn_ar: " أَرْضُ الْخَرَاجِ مَا مُسِحَ ، وَوُضِعَ عَلَيْهِ الْخَرَاجُ " وَقَالَ غَيْرُهُ: " مَا كَانَ لَا يَصِلُ إِلَيْهِ مَاءُ الْأَنْهَارِ ، فَاسْتُخْرِجَتْ فِيهِ عَيْنٌ، فَهُوَ أَرْضُ عُشْرٍ، وَكُلُّ شَيْءٍ سَقَتْهُ أَنْهَارُ الْخَرَاجِ، أَوْ سِيقَ إِلَيْهِ الْمَاءُ مِنْهَا ، فَهُوَ أَرْضُ خَرَاجٍ "
entries.isnad_en: Yahya said: Hasan said:
entries.matn_en: The land of kharaj is what was surveyed and upon which the kharaj was placed. And another said: What the water of the rivers did not reach, and in which a spring was then drawn out, is 'ushr land; and everything that the rivers of the kharaj watered, or to which water was conducted from them, is kharaj land.

entries.label: Narration
entries.isnad_ar: أَخْبَرَنَا إِسْمَاعِيلُ، قَالَ: حَدَّثَنَا الْحَسَنُ، قَالَ: حَدَّثَنَا يَحْيَى، قَالَ: حَدَّثَنَا قَيْسٌ، عَنْ مُغَلِّسٍ، عَنْ مُقَاتِلِ بْنِ حَيَّانَ، عَنْ أَبِي مِجْلَزٍ، عَنْ زِيَادِ بْنِ حُدَيْرٍ، عَنْ عُمَرَ رضي الله عنه فِي أَرْضِ الْحَرْبِ قَالَ:
entries.matn_ar: " مَنْ أَقَامَ مِنْهُمْ سِتَّةَ أَشْهُرٍ أُخِذَ مِنْهُ الْعُشْرُ، وَمَنْ أَقَامَ سَنَةً أُخِذَ مِنْهُ نِصْفُ الْعُشْرِ "
entries.isnad_en: Isma'il informed us. He said: al-Hasan narrated to us. He said: Yahya narrated to us. He said: Qays narrated to us, from Mughallis, from Muqatil b. Hayyan, from Abu Mijlaz, from Ziyad b. Hudayr, from 'Umar (r), concerning the land of war, he said:
entries.matn_en: Whoever of them stays six months, the 'ushr is taken from him, and whoever stays a year, half the 'ushr is taken from him.

entries.label: Narration
entries.isnad_ar: وَقَالَ أَبُو حَنِيفَةَ:
entries.matn_ar: " إِذَا كَانَ يَبْلُغُهَا مَاءُ أَنْهَارِ الْخَراِجِ، فَهِيَ مِنْ أَرْضِ الْخَرَاجِ، وَلَيْسَتْ بِأَرْضِ عُشْرٍ "، قَالَ يَحْيَى: بَلَغَنِي ذَلِكَ عَنْهُ
entries.isnad_en: And Abu Hanifa said:
entries.matn_en: If the water of the rivers of the kharaj reaches it, it is of the land of kharaj and is not 'ushr land. Yahya said: That reached me from him.

entries.label: Narration
entries.isnad_ar: أَخْبَرَنَا إِسْمَاعِيلُ، قَالَ: حَدَّثَنَا الْحَسَنُ، قَالَ: حَدَّثَنَا يَحْيَى، قَالَ: حَدَّثَنَا عَبَّادُ بْنُ الْعَوَّامِ، عَنْ عَوْفٍ الْأَعْرَابِيِّ، قَالَ: قَرَأْتُ كِتَابَ عُمَرَ بْنِ الْخَطَّابِ رضي الله عنه إِلَى أَبِي مُوسَى:
entries.matn_ar: إِنَّ أَبَا عَبْدِ اللَّهِ سَأَلَنِي أَرْضًا عَلَى شَاطِئِ دِجْلَةَ يَفْتَلِي فِيهَا خَيْلَهُ، فَإِنْ كَانَتْ لَيْسَتْ مِنْ أَرْضِ الْجِزْيَةِ، وَلَا يَجْرِي فِيهَا مَاءُ الْجِزْيَةِ، فَأَعْطِهَا إِيَّاهُ ⦗ص: 26⦘
entries.isnad_en: Isma'il informed us. He said: al-Hasan narrated to us. He said: Yahya narrated to us. He said: 'Abbad b. al-'Awwam narrated to us, from 'Awf al-A'rabi, who said:
entries.matn_en: I read the letter of 'Umar b. al-Khattab (r) to Abu Musa: Abu 'Abd Allah asked me for land on the bank of the Tigris in which to rear his horses; if it is not of the land of the jizya, and the water of the jizya does not flow in it, give it to him. [p. 26]

entries.label: Narration
entries.isnad_ar: " قَالَ يَحْيَى: وَقَالَ بَعْضُ الْفُقَهَاءِ فِي أَرْضِ بَنِي تَغْلِبَ:
entries.matn_ar: " إِنِ اشْتَرَاهَا مُسْلِمٌ فَعَلَيْهَا الْعُشْرُ مُضَاعَفٌ ، لَا يَتَحَوَّلُ أَبَدًا، وَكَذَلِكَ مَا اسْتَفَادُوا مِنْ أَرْضِ الْعُشْرِ، فَإِنَّهُ تُضَاعَفُ عَلَيْهَا الصَّدَقَةُ، فَإِنْ أَسْلَمَ ، أَوْ بَاعَهَا بَعْدَ ذَلِكَ مِنْ مُسْلِمٍ فَعَلَيْهَا الْعُشْرُ مُضَاعَفٌ "
entries.isnad_en: Yahya said:
entries.matn_en: And some of the jurists said concerning the land of Banu Taghlib: If a Muslim purchases it, the doubled 'ushr is upon it, which never changes. Likewise what they acquire of 'ushr land: the sadaqa is doubled upon it, and if one becomes Muslim, or sells it thereafter to a Muslim, the doubled 'ushr is upon it.

entries.label: Narration
entries.isnad_ar: قال: يَحْيَى قَالَ حَسَنُ بْنُ صَالِحٍ:
entries.matn_ar: " مَنْ أَسْلَمَ مِنْ بَنِي تَغْلِبَ فَأَرْضُهُ أَرْضُ عُشْرٍ؛ لِأَنَّ الَّذِي عَلَى أَرْضِهِ لَيْسَ بِخَرَاجٍ، وَلَيْسَ عَلَيْهِمُ الْجِزْيَةُ، وَكُلُّ أَرْضٍ كَانَتْ لِلْعَرَبِ - الَّذِينَ لَا تُقْبَلُ مِنْهُمُ الْجِزْيَةُ، وَلَا يَقْبَلُ مِنْهُمْ إِلَّا الْإِسْلَامُ ، أَوِ الْقَتْلُ - فَإِنَّ أَرْضَهُمْ أَرْضُ عُشْرٍ، وَكَذَلِكَ صَنَعَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم بِكُلِّ أَرْضٍ ظَهَرَ عَلَيْهَا مِنْ أَرْضِ الْعَرَبِ، فَإِنَّهُ لَمْ يَضَعْ عَلَيْهَا الْخَرَاجَ، وَلَكِنَّهَا صَارَتْ أَرْضَ عُشْرٍ
entries.isnad_en: Yahya said: Hasan b. Salih said:
entries.matn_en: Whoever of Banu Taghlib becomes Muslim, his land is 'ushr land, because what is upon his land is not kharaj, and the jizya is not upon them. And every land that belonged to the Arabs—those from whom the jizya is not accepted, and from whom nothing is accepted but Islam or death—their land is 'ushr land. And likewise the Messenger of God ﷺ did with every land of the land of the Arabs that he prevailed over: he did not place the kharaj upon it, but it became 'ushr land.

entries.label: Narration
entries.isnad_ar: أَخْبَرَنَا إِسْمَاعِيلُ، قَالَ: حَدَّثَنَا الْحَسَنُ، قَالَ: حَدَّثَنَا يَحْيَى، قَالَ: حَدَّثَنَا فُضَيْلُ بْنُ عِيَاضٍ، عَنْ لَيْثٍ، عَنْ مُجَاهِدٍ، قَالَ:
entries.matn_ar: " يُقَاتَلُ أَهْلُ الْأَوْثَانِ عَلَى الْإِسْلَامِ، وَيُقَاتَلُ أَهْلُ الْكِتَابِ عَلَى الْجِزْيَةِ
entries.isnad_en: Isma'il informed us. He said: al-Hasan narrated to us. He said: Yahya narrated to us. He said: Fudayl b. 'Iyad narrated to us, from Layth, from Mujahid, who said:
entries.matn_en: The people of idols are fought over Islam, and the People of the Book are fought over the jizya.

entries.label: Narration
entries.isnad_ar: " قَالَ يَحْيَى:
entries.matn_ar: " وَكَذَلِكَ أَهْلُ الرِّدَّةِ عَنِ الْإِسْلَامِ، بِمَنْزِلَةِ مُشْرِكِي الْعَرَبِ، وَكُلُّ أَرْضٍ كَانَتْ لِعَبَدَةِ الْأَوْثَانِ مِنَ الْعَجَمِ، أَوْ لِأَهْلِ الْكِتَابِ مِنَ الْعَجَمِ أَوِ الْعَرَبِ مِمَّنْ يُقْبَلُ مِنْهُمُ الْجِزْيَةُ، فَإِنَّ أَرْضَهُمْ أَرْضُ خَرَاجٍ، وَإِنْ صَالَحُوا عَلَى الْجِزْيَةِ عَلَى رُءُوسِهِمْ ، وَالْخَرَاجُ عَلَى أَرْضِهِمْ ، فَإِنَّ ذَلِكَ يُقْبَلُ مِنْهُمْ، وَإِنْ ظَهَرَ الْمُسْلِمُونَ، فَإِنَّ الْإِمَامَ يَقْسِمُ جَمِيعَ مَا أَجَلَبُوا بِهِ فِي الْعَسْكَرِ مِنْ كُرَاعٍ أَوْ سِلَاحٍ ، أَوْ مَالٍ بَعْدَ مَا يُخَمِّسُهُ، وَهِيَ الْغَنِيمَةُ الَّتِي لَا يُوقَفُ شَيْءٌ مِنْهَا، وَذَلِكَ قَوْلُهُ: {مَا غَنِمْتُمْ مِنْ شَيْءٍ فَأَنَّ لِلَّهِ خُمُسَهُ} فَأَمَّا الْقُرَى وَالْمَدَائِنُ وَالْأَرْضُ فَهِيَ فَيْءٌ كَمَا قَالَ اللَّهُ تبارك وتعالى: {مَا أَفَاءَ اللَّهُ عَلَى رَسُولِهِ مِنْ أَهْلِ الْقُرَى} [الحشر: 7] وَالْإِمَامُ بِالْخِيَارِ فِي ذَلِكَ، إِنْ شَاءَ وَقَفَهُ وَتَرَكَهُ لِلْمُسْلِمِينَ، وَإِنْ شَاءَ قَسَمَهُ بَيْنَ مَنْ حَضَرَهُ، وَقَالَ بَعْضُ الْفُقَهَاءِ: لَيْسَ فِيهِ خُمُسٌ. وَقَالَ بَعْضُهُمْ: إِنْ قَسَمَهُ فَفِيهِ الْخُمُسُ، وَإِنْ وَقَفَهُ كَانَ فَيْئًا، وَقَالَ بَعْضُ الْفُقَهَاءِ: إِنَّمَا وَقَفَ عُمَرُ بْنُ الْخَطَّابِ رضي الله عنه سَوَادَ الْكُوفَةِ لِأَنَّهُ لَيْسَ مِمَّا حَازَهُ الْمُسْلِمُونَ حِينَ ظَهَرُوا عَلَيْهِ، وَلَوْ كَانُوا حَازُوهُ وَجَمَعُوا مَا فِيهِ مِنَ السَّبْيِ وَالْأَمْوَالِ، كَانَ غَنِيمَةً، لَيْسَ لِلْإِمَامِ أَنْ يَقِفَهُ حَتَّى يُخْرِجَ مِنْهُ الْخُمُسَ لِلَّهِ، ثُمَّ يَقْسِمَ أَرْبَعَةَ أَخْمَاسِهَا بَيْنَ الَّذِينَ حَضَرُوا فَتْحَهُ "
entries.isnad_en: Yahya said:
entries.matn_en: And likewise the people of apostasy from Islam are in the position of the polytheists of the Arabs. Every land that belonged to idol-worshippers of the non-Arabs ('ajam), or to the People of the Book of the non-Arabs or Arabs from whom the jizya is accepted, their land is kharaj land; and if they make peace on the basis of the jizya upon their heads and the kharaj upon their lands, that is accepted from them. If the Muslims prevail, the imam divides all that they brought with them to the camp of mounts (kura'), weapons or property, after taking its fifth. That is the ghanima, none of which is endowed, and that is His saying: {Whatever you take as spoil, then to God belongs its fifth} [al-Anfal: 41]. As for the villages, cities and land, they are fay', as God, blessed and exalted, said: {What God bestowed upon His Messenger from the people of the towns} [al-Hashr: 7], and the imam has the choice in this: if he wishes he endows it and leaves it to the Muslims, and if he wishes he divides it among those present. Some of the jurists said: There is no fifth in it. And some of them said: If he divides it, the fifth is in it, and if he endows it, it is fay'. And some of the jurists said: 'Umar b. al-Khattab (r) endowed the Sawad of Kufa only because it was not among what the Muslims took possession of when they prevailed over it; had they taken possession of it and gathered what was in it of captives and property, it would have been ghanima, and the imam would not be permitted to endow it until he takes out of it the fifth for God, then divides four fifths of it among those who were present at its conquest.

entries.label: Narration
entries.isnad_ar: أَخْبَرَنَا إِسْمَاعِيلُ، قَالَ: حَدَّثَنَا الْحَسَنُ، قَالَ: حَدَّثَنَا يَحْيَى، قَالَ: حَدَّثَنَا أَبُو بَكْرِ بْنُ عَيَّاشٍ، عَنِ الْحَسَنِ الْبَصْرِيِّ، أَنَّهُ كَانَ يَقُولُ:
entries.matn_ar: " مَا كَانَ فِي الْعَسْكَرِ فَهُوَ لِلَّذِينَ غَلَبُوا عَلَيْهِ، وَالْأَرْضُ لِلْمُسْلِمِينَ "
entries.isnad_en: Isma'il informed us. He said: al-Hasan narrated to us. He said: Yahya narrated to us. He said: Abu Bakr b. 'Ayyash narrated to us, from al-Hasan al-Basri, that he used to say:
entries.matn_en: What is in the camp belongs to those who prevailed over it, and the land belongs to the Muslims.

entries.label: Narration
entries.isnad_ar: أَخْبَرَنَا إِسْمَاعِيلُ، قَالَ: حَدَّثَنَا الْحَسَنُ، قَالَ: حَدَّثَنَا يَحْيَى، قَالَ: حَدَّثَنَا ابْنُ مُبَارَكٍ، عَنِ ابْنِ لَهِيعَةَ، عَنْ يَزِيدَ بْنِ أَبِي حَبِيبٍ، قَالَ: كَتَبَ عُمَرُ إِلَى سَعْدٍ حِينَ افْتَتَحَ الْعِرَاقَ: "
entries.matn_ar: أَمَّا بَعْدُ، فَقَدْ بَلَغَنِي كِتَابُكَ تَذْكُرُ أَنَّ النَّاسَ سَأَلُوكَ أَنْ تَقْسِمَ بَيْنَهُمْ مَغَانِمَهُمْ ، وَمَا أَفَاءَ اللَّهُ عَلَيْهِمْ، فَإِذَا أَتَاكَ كِتَابِي هَذَا ، فَانْظُرْ مَا أَجْلَبَ النَّاسُ بِهِ إِلَى الْعَسْكَرِ مِنْ كُرَاعٍ أَوْ مَالٍ، فَاقْسِمْهُ بَيْنَ مَنْ حَضَرَ مِنَ الْمُسْلِمِينَ، وَاتْرُكِ الْأَرَضِينَ وَالْأَنْهَارَ لِعُمَّالِهَا، لِيَكُونَ ذَلِكَ فِي أُعْطِيَاتِ الْمُسْلِمِينَ، فَإِنَّكَ إِنْ قَسَمْتَهَا بَيْنَ مَنْ حَضَرَ لَمْ يَكُنْ لِمَنْ بَقِيَ بَعْدَهُمْ شَيْءٌ، وَقَدْ كُنْتُ أَمَرْتُكَ أَنْ تَدْعُوَ النَّاسَ إِلَى الْإِسْلَامِ، فَمَنْ أَسْلَمَ ، وَاسْتَجَابَ لَكَ قَبْلَ الْقِتَالِ فَهُوَ رَجُلٌ مِنَ الْمُسْلِمِينَ، لَهُ مَا لَهُمْ ، وَلَهُ سَهْمٌ فِي الْإِسْلَامِ، وَمَنِ اسْتَجَابَ لَكَ بَعْدَ الْقِتَالِ وَبَعْدَ الْهَزِيمَةِ، فَهُوَ رَجُلٌ مِنَ الْمُسْلِمِينَ، وَمَالُهُ لِأَهْلِ الْإِسْلَامِ؛ لِأَنَّهُمْ قَدْ أَحْرَزُوهُ قَبْلَ الْإِسْلَامِ "
entries.isnad_en: Isma'il informed us. He said: al-Hasan narrated to us. He said: Yahya narrated to us. He said: Ibn Mubarak narrated to us, from Ibn Lahi'a, from Yazid b. Abi Habib, who said:
entries.matn_en: 'Umar wrote to Sa'd when he conquered Iraq: To proceed: Your letter has reached me, mentioning that the people asked you to divide among them their spoils and what God bestowed upon them. So when this letter of mine reaches you, look at what the people brought to the camp of mounts or property, and divide it among those of the Muslims who are present, and leave the lands and rivers to their cultivators ('ummal), so that that may be for the stipends (a'tiyat) of the Muslims; for if you divide them among those present, nothing will remain for those who come after them. I had ordered you to call the people to Islam; whoever became Muslim and responded to you before the fighting is a man of the Muslims, has what they have, and has a share in Islam; and whoever responded to you after the fighting and after the defeat is a man of the Muslims, but his property belongs to the people of Islam, because they had secured it before Islam.

entries.label: Narration
entries.isnad_ar: أَخْبَرَنَا إِسْمَاعِيلُ، قَالَ: حَدَّثَنَا الْحَسَنُ، قَالَ: حَدَّثَنَا يَحْيَى، قَالَ: حَدَّثَنَا سُفْيَانُ بْنُ عُيَيْنَةَ، عَنِ ابْنِ أَبِي نَجِيحٍ، عَنْ مُجَاهِدٍ، قَالَ:
entries.matn_ar: أَيُّمَا مَدِينَةٍ أُخِذَتْ عَنْوَةً فَأَسْلَمَ أَهْلُهَا قَبْلَ أَنْ يَقْتَسِمُوا، فَهُمْ أَحْرَارٌ ، وَأَمْوَالُهُمْ لِلْمُسْلِمِينَ، قَالَ يَحْيَى: " لَعَلَّ هَذَا إِذَا كَانُوا أَهْلَ مَدِينَةٍ مِنَ الْعَرَبِ الَّذِينَ لَا يُسْتَرَقُّونَ، وَلَا يُقْبَلُ مِنْهُمْ إِلَّا الْجِزْيَةُ فَإِنَّهُمْ أَحْرَارٌ، وَأَمَّا ذَرَارِيُّهُمْ فَإِنَّهُمْ يَجْرِي عَلَيْهِمُ السِّبَاءُ، وَكَذَلِكَ أَهْلُ الرِّدَّةِ بِمَنْزِلَتِهِمْ، وَأَمَّا مَنْ كَانَ يَقَعُ عَلَيْهِ الرِّقُّ، فَإِنْ أَسْلَمَ بَعْدَ مَا يُؤْسَرُ فَهُوَ رَقِيقٌ، وَكُلُّ مَنْ أَسْلَمَ مِنْ خَلْقِ اللَّهِ قَبْلَ الْقِتَالِ، فَهُمْ أَحْرَارٌ مُسْلِمُونَ، وَأَرَضُوهُمْ أَرْضُ عُشْرٍ؛ لِأَنَّهُمْ أَسْلَمُوا قَبْلَ أَنْ يَظْهَرَ عَلَيْهِمُ الْمُسْلِمُونَ، وَقَبْلَ أَنْ يَجْرِيَ عَلَيْهِمُ الْخَرَاجُ
entries.isnad_en: Isma'il informed us. He said: al-Hasan narrated to us. He said: Yahya narrated to us. He said: Sufyan b. 'Uyayna narrated to us, from Ibn Abi Najih, from Mujahid, who said:
entries.matn_en: Any city taken by force whose people became Muslim before they divided [it], they are free and their property belongs to the Muslims. Yahya said: Perhaps this applies if they were the people of a city of the Arabs, who are not enslaved and from whom nothing is accepted but the jizya—they are free, but as for their offspring, captivity (siba') applies to them; and likewise the people of apostasy are in their position. As for one upon whom slavery falls, if he becomes Muslim after being captured he is a slave. And everyone of God’s creation who becomes Muslim before the fighting is free and Muslim, and their land is 'ushr land, because they became Muslim before the Muslims prevailed over them and before the kharaj was applied to them.

entries.label: Narration
entries.matn_ar: " قَالَ يَحْيَى: وَقَدْ سَبَى عَلِيٌّ ذَرَارِيَّ أَهْلِ الرِّدَّةِ مِنْ بَنِي نَاجِيَةَ، وَقَدْ حَكَمَ سَعْدُ ⦗ص: 28⦘ بْنُ مُعَاذٍ فِي بَنِي قُرَيْظَةَ حِينَ نَقَضُوا الْعَهْدَ أَنْ يُقْتَلُ مُقَاتِلُهُمْ، وَأَنْ يُسْبَى ذَرَارِيُّهُمْ - فَقَالَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم: " أَصَبْتَ فِيهِمْ حُكْمَ اللَّهِ عز وجل
entries.isnad_en: Yahya said:
entries.matn_en: And 'Ali enslaved the offspring of the people of apostasy from Banu Najiya, and Sa'd [p. 28] b. Mu'adh ruled concerning Banu Qurayza when they broke the covenant that their fighters be killed and that their offspring be taken captive; and the Messenger of God ﷺ said: You have judged among them with the judgment of God, mighty and majestic.

entries.label: Narration
entries.matn_ar: " حَدَّثَنَا شَرِيكٌ، عَنْ أَبِي إِسْحَاقَ، عَنْ عَمْرِو بْنِ شُرَحْبِيلَ حَدِيثُ بَنِي قُرَيْظَةَ هَذَا".
entries.isnad_en: Sharik narrated to us, from Abu Ishaq, from 'Amr b. Shurahbil
entries.matn_en: this hadith of Banu Qurayza.

entries.label: Narration
entries.matn_ar: أَخْبَرَنَا إِسْمَاعِيلُ، قَالَ: حَدَّثَنَا الْحَسَنُ، قَالَ: حَدَّثَنَا يَحْيَى، قَالَ: حَدَّثَنَا إِسْرَائِيلُ، وَقَيْسٌ، وَسُفْيَانُ بْنُ عُيَيْنَةَ عَنْ عَمَّارٍ الدُّهْنِيِّ، عَنْ أَبِي الطُّفَيْلِ، عَنْ عَلِيٍّ حَدِيثَ بَنِي نَاجِيَةَ هَذَا الَّذِي ذَكَرْنَاهُ "
entries.isnad_en: Isma'il informed us. He said: al-Hasan narrated to us. He said: Yahya narrated to us. He said: Isra'il, Qays and Sufyan b. 'Uyayna narrated to us, from 'Ammar al-Duhni, from Abu al-Tufayl, from 'Ali
entries.matn_en: this hadith of Banu Najiya that we have mentioned.

entries.label: Narration
entries.isnad_ar: أَخْبَرَنَا إِسْمَاعِيلُ، قَالَ: حَدَّثَنَا الْحَسَنُ، قَالَ: حَدَّثَنَا يَحْيَى، قَالَ:
entries.matn_ar: وَكَانَ الْحَسَنُ بْنُ صَالِحٍ، يَقُولُ: " الْحُكْمُ فِيمَنْ نَقَضَ مِنْ أَهْلِ الْعَهْدِ، الْقَتْلُ أَوِ الْإِسْلَامُ، وَلَا يُقْبَلُ مِنْهُمُ الْجِزْيَةُ بَعْدَ النَّقْضِ ". وَقَالَ غَيْرُهُ: يُسْتَقْبَلُ بِهِمُ الْأَمْرُ
entries.isnad_en: Isma'il informed us. He said: al-Hasan narrated to us. He said: Yahya narrated to us. He said: And al-Hasan b. Salih used to say:
entries.matn_en: The ruling concerning one of the people of the covenant who breaks it is death or Islam, and the jizya is not accepted from them after the breach. And another said: The matter is dealt with anew with respect to them.

entries.label: Narration
entries.isnad_ar: أَخْبَرَنَا إِسْمَاعِيلُ، قَالَ: حَدَّثَنَا الْحَسَنُ، قَالَ: حَدَّثَنَا يَحْيَى، قَالَ: حَدَّثَنَا أَبُو بَكْرِ بْنُ عَيَّاشٍ، عَنْ أَبِي حُصَيْنٍ، عَنِ الشَّعْبِيِّ، قَالَ:
entries.matn_ar: قَالَ عُمَرُ بْنُ الْخَطَّابِ رضي الله عنه: " لَيْسَ عَلَى عَرَبِيٍّ مِلْكٌ، وَلَكِنَّا نُقَوِّمُهُمْ أُنْمُلَةَ خَمْسِينَ مِنَ الْإِبِلِ
entries.isnad_en: Isma'il informed us. He said: al-Hasan narrated to us. He said: Yahya narrated to us. He said: Abu Bakr b. 'Ayyash narrated to us, from Abu Husayn, from al-Sha'bi, who said: 'Umar b. al-Khattab (r) said:
entries.matn_en: There is no ownership over an Arab (laysa 'ala 'arabi milk), but we assess their value (nuqawwimuhum), a finger-joint (unmula), at fifty of the camels.

entries.label: Narration
entries.matn_ar: " وَكُلُّ رَجُلٍ ارْتَدَّ عَنِ الْإِسْلَامِ، وَقَارَبَ الْمُسْلِمِينَ، وَقَاتَلَهُمْ مَعَ الْمُشْرِكِينَ، ثُمَّ أَسَرَهُ الْمُسْلِمُونَ بَعْدُ، فَإِنَّهُ لَا يُقْبَلُ مِنْهُمُ إِلَّا الْإِسْلَامُ أَوِ الْقَتْلُ، فَإِنْ أَسْلَمَ حَرُمَ دَمُهُ، وَقَالَ حَسَنُ بْنُ صَالِحٍ: " يُسْتَرَقُّ "، وَقَالَ غَيْرُهُ: لَا يُسْتَرَقُّ، وَلَكِنْ إِذَا رَجَعَ إِلَى الْإِسْلَامِ صَارَ حُرًّا مُسْلِمًا، بِمَنْزِلَةِ الْحُكْمِ فِي الْعَرَبِ لَا يُقْبَلُ مِنْهُ إِلَّا الْإِسْلَامُ ⦗ص: 29⦘
entries.matn_en: And every man who apostatized from Islam, drew near to the Muslims and fought them together with the polytheists, and whom the Muslims then captured: only Islam or death is accepted from him; if he becomes Muslim his blood is made inviolable. And Hasan b. Salih said: He is enslaved. And another said: He is not enslaved, but when he returns to Islam he becomes a free Muslim, in the position of the ruling concerning the Arabs, from whom nothing but Islam is accepted. [p. 29]

entries.label: Narration
entries.matn_ar: "، وَقَدْ قَالَ بَعْضُ أَصْحَابِنَا فِي أَرْضِ الْبَصْرَةِ: " أَرْضُهَا أَرْضُ عُشْرٍ؛ لِأَنَّهَا اسْتُخْرِجَتْ مِنْ أَنْهَارِ الْخَرَاجِ؛ لِأَنَّ الْبَطَائِحَ تَقْطَعُ مَا بَيْنَهَا وَبَيْنَ دِجْلَةَ، وَشُرْبُهَا مِنَ الْبَطَائِحِ وَمِنَ الْبَحْرِ، وَالْبَطَائِحُ وَالْبَحْرُ لَيْسَا مِنْ أَنْهَارِ الْخَرَاجِ "
entries.matn_en: And some of our companions said concerning the land of Basra: Its land is 'ushr land, because it was drawn out from the rivers of the kharaj, for the marshes (bata'ih) cut off what is between it and the Tigris, and its irrigation is from the marshes and from the sea, and the marshes and the sea are not among the rivers of the kharaj.

entries.label: Narration
entries.isnad_ar: قال يَحْيَى وَقَالَ الْحَسَنُ بْنُ صَالِحٍ فِي أَرْضِ الْعَرَبِ وَغَيْرِهِمْ:
entries.matn_ar: " إِذَا أَسْلَمَ عَلَيْهَا ، وَمَنْ أَحْيَا أَرْضًا مَيْتَةً أَوِ اسْتَخْرَجَهَا، فَهَذِهِ أَرْضُ الْعُشْرِ وَفِيهَا الصَّدَقَةُ "، قَالَ: " وَمَنْ أَسْلَمَ مِنْ أَهْلِ الصُّلْحِ الَّذِينَ لَمْ يُوضَعْ عَلَى أَرَضِيهِمُ الْخَرَاجُ، فَأَرْضُهُ أَرْضُ عُشْرٍ "
entries.isnad_en: Yahya said: And al-Hasan b. Salih said
entries.matn_en: concerning the land of the Arabs and others: When one becomes Muslim upon it, and whoever revives dead land or draws it out, this is 'ushr land and sadaqa is due on it. He said: And whoever becomes Muslim of the people of the treaty upon whose lands the kharaj was not placed, his land is 'ushr land.

entries.label: Narration
entries.isnad_ar: قَالَ يَحَيْىَ، وَقَالَ حَسَنٌ فِي الذِّمِّيِّ يَشْتَرِي أَرْضَ عُشْرٍ، قَالَ:
entries.matn_ar: " إِنْ كَانَ مِنْ بَنِي تَغْلِبَ، فَعَلَيْهِ الصَّدَقَةُ مُضَاعَفَةً، وَإِنْ كَانَ مِنْ غَيْرِهِمْ مِنْ أَهْلِ الْعَهْدِ، فَلَيْسَ عَلَيْهِ فِيهَا عُشْرٌ وَلَا خَرَاجٌ "
entries.isnad_en: Yahya said: And Hasan said
entries.matn_en: concerning the dhimmi who buys 'ushr land: If he is of Banu Taghlib, the sadaqa is upon him doubled, and if he is of others of the people of the covenant, there is neither 'ushr nor kharaj upon him in it.

entries.label: Narration
entries.isnad_ar: أَخْبَرَنَا إِسْمَاعِيلُ، قَالَ: حَدَّثَنَا الْحَسَنُ، قَالَ: حَدَّثَنَا يَحْيَى، قَالَ: حَدَّثَنَا حُمَيْدٌ، عَنْ حَسَنٍ، أَنَّهُ قَالَ:
entries.matn_ar: " هِيَ بِمَنْزِلَةِ الْإِبِلِ وَالْغَنَمِ السَّائِمَةِ يَشْتَرِيهَا الذِّمِّيُّ، فَلَيْسَ عَلَيْهِ فِيهَا شَيْءٌ "
entries.isnad_en: Isma'il informed us. He said: al-Hasan narrated to us. He said: Yahya narrated to us. He said: Humayd narrated to us, from Hasan, that he said:
entries.matn_en: It is in the position of camels and pasturing sheep that the dhimmi buys: there is nothing upon him in it.

entries.label: Narration
entries.matn_ar: قَالَ يَحْيَى، وَقَالَ حَسَنُ بْنُ صَالِحٍ، وَشَرِيكٌ، فِي الْمُسْلِمِ يَسْتَأْجِرُ مِنْهُ الذِّمِّيُّ أَرْضًا مِنْ أَرْضِ الْعُشْرِ فَيَزْرَعُهَا، قَالَا: " لَيْسَ عَلَى الذِّمِّيِّ فِيمَا خَرَجَ لَهُ فِيهَا عُشْرٌ وَلَا خَرَاجٌ، وَلَا عَلَى الْمُسْلِمِ فِيمَا أَخَذَ مِنَ الْأَرْضِ عُشْرٌ "
entries.isnad_en: Yahya said: And Hasan b. Salih and Sharik said
entries.matn_en: concerning a Muslim from whom a dhimmi rents land of 'ushr land and sows it, they both said: The dhimmi owes neither 'ushr nor kharaj on what comes out for him from it, and the Muslim owes no 'ushr on what he took from the land.

entries.label: Narration
entries.isnad_ar: أَخْبَرَنَا إِسْمَاعِيلُ، قَالَ: حَدَّثَنَا الْحَسَنُ، قَالَ: حَدَّثَنَا يَحْيَى، قَالَ: حَدَّثَنَا أَبُو مُعَاوِيَةَ، عَنِ الْحَسَنِ بْنِ عُمَارَةَ، عَنِ الْحَكَمِ، فِي الْمُشْرِكِ يَشْتَرِي أَرْضَ الْعُشْرِ مِنَ الْمُسْلِمِ، قَالَ:
entries.matn_ar: " يُؤْخَذُ مِنْهُ الْخُمُسُ، يَقُولُ: يُضَاعَفُ عَلَيْهِ الصَّدَقَةُ، بِمَنْزِلَةِ مَا تَجِرُوا فِيهِ، فَإِنْ أَسْلَمَ صَارَتْ أَرْضَ عُشْرٍ، وَكَذَلِكَ تَغْلِبِيٌّ أَسْلَمَ، فَأَرْضُهُ أَرْضُ عُشْرٍ؛ لِأَنَّهُ لَمْ يَكُنْ عَلَيْهَا خَرَاجٌ
entries.isnad_en: Isma'il informed us. He said: al-Hasan narrated to us. He said: Yahya narrated to us. He said: Abu Mu'awiya narrated to us, from al-Hasan b. 'Umara, from al-Hakam, concerning the polytheist who buys 'ushr land from the Muslim, he said:
entries.matn_en: The fifth is taken from him—he means: the sadaqa is doubled upon him, in the position of what they trade in. If he becomes Muslim it becomes 'ushr land. Likewise a Taghlibi who becomes Muslim: his land is 'ushr land, because there was no kharaj upon it.

entries.label: Narration
entries.isnad_ar: أَخْبَرَنَا إِسْمَاعِيلُ، قَالَ: حَدَّثَنَا الْحَسَنُ، قَالَ: حَدَّثَنَا يَحْيَى، قَالَ: حَدَّثَنَا ابْنُ مُبَارَكٍ، عَنْ أَبِي حَنِيفَةَ فِي مُعَاهَدٍ اشْتَرَى أَرْضًا مِنْ أَرْضِ الْعُشْرِ، قَالَ:
entries.matn_ar: " يُوضَعُ عَلَيْهَا الْخَرَاجُ، فَإِنْ بَاعَهَا بَعْدُ مِنْ مُسْلِمٍ، فَعَلَيْهَا عَلَى حَالِهِ ، لَا يَتَحَوَّلُ عَنْهَا أَبَدًا ". قَالَ ⦗ص: 30⦘ يَحْيَى: وَقَالَ ابْنُ مُبَارَكٍ: بَلَغَنِي عَنْ سُفْيَانَ أَنَّهُ قَالَ: لَيْسَ عَلَيْهِ خَرَاجٌ
entries.isnad_en: Isma'il informed us. He said: al-Hasan narrated to us. He said: Yahya narrated to us. He said: Ibn Mubarak narrated to us, from Abu Hanifa, concerning a mu'ahad (covenanted person) who bought land of 'ushr land, he said:
entries.matn_en: The kharaj is placed on it, and if he then sells it to a Muslim, it remains upon it as it was; it never changes from it. [p. 30] Yahya said: And Ibn Mubarak said: It has reached me from Sufyan that he said: There is no kharaj upon him.

entries.label: Narration
entries.isnad_ar: قَالَ يَحْيَى: وَسَأَلْتُ الْحَسَنَ بْنَ صَالِحٍ، عَنِ
entries.matn_ar: " الْعَنْبَرِ وَاللُّؤْلُؤِ وَمَا يَخْرُجُ مِنَ الْبَحْرِ، فَلَمْ يَرَ فِيهِ شَيْئًا، وَشَبَّهَهُ بِصَيْدِ السَّمَكِ "
entries.isnad_en: Yahya said:
entries.matn_en: I asked al-Hasan b. Salih about ambergris, pearls and what comes out of the sea; he saw nothing in it and likened it to the catching of fish.

entries.label: Narration
entries.isnad_ar: أَخْبَرَنَا إِسْمَاعِيلُ، قَالَ: حَدَّثَنَا الْحَسَنُ، قَالَ: حَدَّثَنَا يَحْيَى، قَالَ: حَدَّثَنَا مُبَارَكُ بْنُ فَضَالَةَ، عَنِ الْحَسَنِ، قَالَ:
entries.matn_ar: " لَيْسَ فِي صَيْدِ السَّمَكِ صَدَقَةٌ
entries.isnad_en: Isma'il informed us. He said: al-Hasan narrated to us. He said: Yahya narrated to us. He said: Mubarak b. Fadala narrated to us, from al-Hasan, who said:
entries.matn_en: There is no sadaqa on the catching of fish.

entries.label: Narration
entries.matn_ar: " وَأَمَّا الْمَعْدِنُ فَقَدِ اخْتُلِفَ فِيهِ، فَقَالَ بَعْضُهُمْ: فِيهِ الْخُمُسُ، وَالْمَعْدِنُ فِي أَرْضِ الْعَرَبِ، وَأَرْضِ الْعَجَمِ سَوَاءٌ "
entries.matn_en: As for the mine, there is disagreement concerning it. Some of them said: In it is the fifth, and the mine is the same in the land of the Arabs and the land of the non-Arabs.

entries.label: Narration
entries.isnad_ar: أَخْبَرَنَا إِسْمَاعِيلُ، قَالَ: حَدَّثَنَا الْحَسَنُ، قَالَ: حَدَّثَنَا يَحْيَى، قَالَ: حَدَّثَنَا إِسْرَائِيلُ، عَنْ مُغِيرَةَ، عَنْ إِبْرَاهِيمَ، قَالَ:
entries.matn_ar: " لَيْسَ فِي الْخَيْلِ وَالْبِغَالِ وَالْحَمِيرِ صَدَقَةٌ " - يَعْنِي: السَّائِمَةَ
entries.isnad_en: Isma'il informed us. He said: al-Hasan narrated to us. He said: Yahya narrated to us. He said: Isra'il narrated to us, from Mughira, from Ibrahim, who said:
entries.matn_en: There is no sadaqa on horses, mules and donkeys—meaning: pasturing ones.

entries.label: Narration
entries.matn_ar: وَمَنْ عَمِلَ فِي الْمَعْدِنِ - مِنْ حُرٍّ أَوْ عَبْدٍ ، أَوْ مُسْلِمٍ ، أَوْ مُعَاهَدٍ أَوْ صَبِيٍّ ، أَوِ امْرَأَةٍ - فَهُوَ سَوَاءٌ، قَالَ بَعْضُهُمْ: فِيهِ الْخُمُسُ، وَقَالَ بَعْضُهُمْ: فِيهِ الصَّدَقَةُ "
entries.matn_en: And whoever works in the mine—whether free or slave, Muslim or covenanted, boy or woman—is the same. Some of them said: In it is the fifth, and some of them said: In it is the sadaqa.

entries.label: Narration
entries.isnad_ar: أَخْبَرَنَا إِسْمَاعِيلُ، قَالَ: حَدَّثَنَا الْحَسَنُ، قَالَ: حَدَّثَنَا يَحْيَى، قَالَ: حَدَّثَنَا شَرِيكٌ، عَنْ سَالِمٍ، عَنْ سَعِيدِ بْنِ جُبَيْرٍ، قَالَ:
entries.matn_ar: " لَيْسَ فِي حَجَرٍ زَكَاةٌ إِلَّا مَا كَانَ لِتِجَارَةٍ مِنْ جَوْهَرٍ، وَلَا يَاقُوتٍ وَلَا لُؤْلُؤٍ وَلَا غَيْرِهِ، إِلَّا الذَّهَبُ وَالْفِضَّةُ
entries.isnad_en: Isma'il informed us. He said: al-Hasan narrated to us. He said: Yahya narrated to us. He said: Sharik narrated to us, from Salim, from Sa'id b. Jubayr, who said:
entries.matn_en: There is no zakat on any stone except what is for trade, whether jewel, ruby, pearl or other, except gold and silver.

entries.label: Narration
entries.matn_ar: " وَقَدْ قَالَ بَعْضُ الْفُقَهَاءِ فِي النُّحَاسِ وَالْحَدِيدِ وَالرَّصَاصِ: هُوَ ، وَمَا سِوَاهُ فِي الْمَعْدِنِ بِمَنْزِلَةِ الذَّهَبِ وَالْفِضَّةِ، وَأَمَّا الْإِثْمِدُ وَالزَّبَرْجَدُ وَالْفَيْرُوزُ فَهُوَ بِمَنْزِلَةِ مَا سِوَاهُ مِنَ الْحِجَارَةِ وَالطِّينِ، لَيْسَ فِيهِ شَيْءٌ "
entries.matn_en: And some of the jurists said concerning copper, iron and lead: It, and what is other than it in the mine, is in the position of gold and silver; as for antimony (ithmid), chrysolite (zabarjad) and turquoise (fayruzaj), it is in the position of what is other than it of stones and clay; there is nothing in it.

entries.label: Narration
entries.isnad_ar: أَخْبَرَنَا إِسْمَاعِيلُ، قَالَ: حَدَّثَنَا الْحَسَنُ، قَالَ: حَدَّثَنَا يَحْيَى، قَالَ: حَدَّثَنَا حُسَيْنُ بْنُ زَيْدٍ، عَنْ جَعْفَرِ بْنِ مُحَمَّدٍ، عَنْ أَبِيهِ، عَنْ عَلِيِّ بْنِ الْحُسَيْنِ، قَالَ:
entries.matn_ar: " لَيْسَ فِي الْعَسَلِ زَكَاةٌ "
entries.isnad_en: Isma'il informed us. He said: al-Hasan narrated to us. He said: Yahya narrated to us. He said: Husayn b. Zayd narrated to us, from Ja'far b. Muhammad, from his father, from 'Ali b. al-Husayn, who said:
entries.matn_en: There is no zakat on honey.

entries.label: Narration
entries.isnad_ar: أَخْبَرَنَا إِسْمَاعِيلُ، قَالَ: حَدَّثَنَا الْحَسَنُ، قَالَ: حَدَّثَنَا يَحْيَى، قَالَ: حَدَّثَنَا الْأَشْجَعِيُّ، عَنْ سُفْيَانَ، عَنْ مَنْصُورٍ، عَنْ مُجَاهِدٍ،
entries.matn_ar: فِي قَوْلِهِ عز وجل: " {ابْتِغَاءَ حِلْيَةٍ أَوْ مَتَاعٍ} [الرعد: 17] ، قَالَ: " ابْتِغَاءُ الْحِلْيَةِ: الذَّهَبُ، وَالْفِضَّةُ، وَالْمَتَاعُ: الْحَدِيدُ، وَالصُّفْرُ "
entries.isnad_en: Isma'il informed us. He said: al-Hasan narrated to us. He said: Yahya narrated to us. He said: al-Ashja'i narrated to us, from Sufyan, from Mansur, from Mujahid, concerning His saying, mighty and majestic: {seeking ornaments or utensils (mata')} [al-Ra'd: 17], he said:
entries.matn_en: Seeking ornaments: gold and silver; and the mata': iron and brass (sufr).

entries.label: Narration
entries.isnad_ar: أَخْبَرَنَا إِسْمَاعِيلُ، قَالَ: حَدَّثَنَا الْحَسَنُ، قَالَ: حَدَّثَنَا يَحْيَى قَالَ:
entries.matn_ar: سَأَلْتُ الْحَسَنَ بْنَ صَالِحٍ، عَنِ الْعَسَلِ، فَلَمْ يَرَ فِيهِ شَيْئًا، وَذَكَرَ عَنْ مُعَاذٍ " أَنَّهُ يَأْخُذُ مِنَ الْعَسَلِ شَيْئًا "، وَقَدِ اخْتُلِفَ فِي الْعَسَلِ، فَقَالَ بَعْضُهُمْ: " فِيهِ الْعُشْرُ، وَإِنَّمَا ذَلِكَ إِذَا كَانَ فِي أَرْضِ الْعُشْرِ، فَأَمَّا إِذَا كَانَ فِي أَرْضِ الْخَرَاجِ فَلَيْسَ فِيهِ اخْتِلَافٌ نَعْلَمُهُ أَنَّهُ لَيْسَ فِيهِ شَيْءٌ
entries.isnad_en: Isma'il informed us. He said: al-Hasan narrated to us. He said: Yahya narrated to us. He said:
entries.matn_en: I asked al-Hasan b. Salih about honey, and he saw nothing in it, and he mentioned from Mu'adh that he used to take something from honey. And there is disagreement about honey. Some of them said: In it is the 'ushr, and that is only if it is in 'ushr land; but if it is in kharaj land, there is no disagreement that we know of that there is nothing in it.

entries.label: Narration
entries.matn_ar: ، وَأَمَّا النِّفْطُ وَالْقِيرُ وَالزِّئْبَقُ وَالْمُومِيَا يَكُونُ لَهُ عَيْنٌ فِي الْأَرْضِ، فَلَيْسَ فِيهِ شَيْءٌ نَعْلَمُهُ فِي أَرْضِ عُشْرٍ، وَلَا فِي أَرْضِ خَرَاجٍ
entries.matn_en: As for naphtha, bitumen (qir), mercury and mumiya' that has a spring in the land, there is nothing in it that we know of, in 'ushr land or in kharaj land.

entries.label: Narration
entries.matn_ar: " قَالَ: وَكَذَلِكَ الْآجَامُ لَمْ نَسْمَعْ أَنَّهُ وُضِعَ عَلَيْهَا شَيْءٌ، إِلَّا حَدِيثًا وَاحِدًا، عَنْ عَلِيٍّ: " أَنَّهُ وَضَعَ عَلَى أَجَمَةِ بُرْسٍ أَرْبَعَةَ آلَافِ دِرْهَمٍ كُلَّ سَنَةٍ، وَكَتَبَ بِذَلِكَ كِتَابًا فِي قِطْعَةِ أَدَمٍ "
entries.isnad_en: He said:
entries.matn_en: Likewise the reed-thickets (ajam): we have not heard that anything was placed on them, except one hadith from 'Ali: that he placed on a reed-thicket of Burs four thousand dirhams every year, and wrote a document about that on a piece of tanned leather (adam).

entries.label: Narration
entries.isnad_ar: قَالَ يَحْيَى: سَأَلْتُ حَسَنَ بْنَ صَالِحٍ عَنِ الرِّكَازِ، فَقَالَ:
entries.matn_ar: " هُوَ الْكَنْزُ الْعَادِيُّ، مَا كَانَ مِنْ ضَرْبِ الْأَعَاجِمِ، وَفِيهِ الْخُمُسُ "، وَقَالَ: غَيْرُ الْحَسَنِ: " الرِّكَازُ: هُوَ الذَّهَبُ وَالْفِضَّةُ الَّتِي تُخْلَقُ مَعَ الْأَرْضِ ، فَفِيهِ الْخُمُسُ "
entries.isnad_en: Yahya said:
entries.matn_en: I asked Hasan b. Salih about the rikaz, and he said: It is the ancient treasure (al-kanz al-'adi), what was of the minting of the non-Arabs, and in it is the fifth. And one other than al-Hasan said: The rikaz is the gold and silver that are created with the earth; in it is the fifth.

entries.label: Narration
entries.isnad_ar: قَالَ يَحْيَى، قَالَ الْحَسَنُ:
entries.matn_ar: " مَا كَانَ مِنْ ضَرْبِ الْإِسْلَامِ فَهُوَ بِمَنْزِلَةِ الضَّالَّةِ وَاللُّقَطَةِ، إِنْ وُجِدَ مَنْ يُعَرِّفُهَا، وَإِلَّا تُصُدِّقَ بِهَا "
entries.isnad_en: Yahya said: Al-Hasan said:
entries.matn_en: What was of the minting of Islam is in the position of the stray animal and the lost property (luqata): if someone is found to announce it, [it is announced], otherwise it is given in sadaqa.

entries.label: Unnumbered report
entries.isnad_ar: قَالَ يَحْيَى، قَالَ الْحَسَنُ:
entries.matn_ar: " وَأَرْبَعَةُ أَخْمَاسِ الرِّكَازِ لِمَنْ وَجَدَهُ، وَلَا يُنْظُرُ إِلَى صَاحِبِ الْأَرْضِ الَّتِي وُجِدَ فِيهَا "، وَقَالَ غَيْرُهُ: صَاحِبُ الْمِلْكِ لِرَقَبَةِ الْأَرْضِ أَحَقُّ بِهِ، قَالَ: " وَإِنْ كَانَ الْمَعْدِنُ فِي مِلْكِ رَجُلٍ مُسْلِمٍ، أَوْ مُعَاهَدٍ، فَلَيْسَ فِيهِ خُمُسٌ وَلَا غَيْرُهُ "
entries.isnad_en: Yahya said: Al-Hasan said:
entries.matn_en: Four fifths of the rikaz belong to the one who found it, and the owner of the land in which it was found is not considered. And another said: The owner of the property in the substance of the land (raqabat al-ard) has more right to it. He said: And if the mine is in the property of a Muslim man or a covenanted person, there is no fifth in it nor anything else.

entries.label: Narration
entries.isnad_ar: أَخْبَرَنَا إِسْمَاعِيلُ، قَالَ: حَدَّثَنَا الْحَسَنُ، قَالَ: حَدَّثَنَا يَحْيَى، قَالَ: حَدَّثَنَا سُفْيَانُ بْنُ عُيَيْنَةَ، عَنْ عَمْرِو بْنِ دِينَارٍ، عَنْ عِكْرِمَةَ، فِي قَوْلِهِ عز وجل:
entries.matn_ar: {وَأَوْرَثَكُمْ أَرْضَهُمْ وَدِيَارَهُمْ وَأَمْوَالَهُمْ وَأَرْضًا لَمْ تَطَئُوهَا} قَالَ: " مَا ظَهَرَ عَلَيْهِ الْمُسْلِمُونَ إِلَى يَوْمِ الْقِيَامَةِ "
entries.isnad_en: Isma'il informed us. He said: al-Hasan narrated to us. He said: Yahya narrated to us. He said: Sufyan b. 'Uyayna narrated to us, from 'Amr b. Dinar, from 'Ikrima, concerning His saying, mighty and majestic: {And He made you inherit their land, their homes, and their wealth, and a land you had not trodden} [al-Ahzab: 27], he said:
entries.matn_en: What the Muslims prevail over until the Day of Resurrection.

entries.label: Narration
entries.isnad_ar: أَخْبَرَنَا إِسْمَاعِيلُ، قَالَ: حَدَّثَنَا الْحَسَنُ، قَالَ: حَدَّثَنَا يَحْيَى، قَالَ: حَدَّثَنَا سُفْيَانُ بْنُ عُيَيْنَةَ، عَنِ الزُّهْرِيِّ، قَالَ:
entries.matn_ar: " كَانَ أَمْوَالُ بَنِي النَّضِيرِ مِمَّا أَفَاءَ اللَّهُ عَلَى رَسُولِهِ، وَلَمْ يُوجِفْ عَلَيْهِ بِخَيْلٍ وَلَا رِكَابٍ، فَكَانَتْ لِرَسُولِ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم خَالِصَةً، فَقَسَمَهَا رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم بَيْنَ الْمُهَاجِرِينَ، وَلَمْ يُعْطِ أَحَدًا مِنَ الْأَنْصَارِ مِنْهَا شَيْئًا إِلَّا رَجُلَيْنِ كَانَا فَقِيرَيْنِ: سِمَاكَ بْنَ خَرَشَةَ أَبَا دُجَانَةَ، وَسَهْلَ بْنَ حُنَيْفٍ "
entries.isnad_en: Isma'il informed us. He said: al-Hasan narrated to us. He said: Yahya narrated to us. He said: Sufyan b. 'Uyayna narrated to us, from al-Zuhri, who said:
entries.matn_en: The property of Banu al-Nadir was among what God bestowed upon His Messenger, for which no horses or camels were spurred, so it belonged exclusively (khalisatan) to the Messenger of God ﷺ, and the Messenger of God ﷺ divided it among the Emigrants and gave none of the Ansar anything of it except two men who were poor: Simak b. Kharasha Abu Dujana and Sahl b. Hunayf.

entries.label: Narration
entries.isnad_ar: أَخْبَرَنَا إِسْمَاعِيلُ، قَالَ: حَدَّثَنَا الْحَسَنُ، قَالَ: حَدَّثَنَا يَحْيَى، قَالَ: حَدَّثَنَا سُفْيَانُ بْنُ عُيَيْنَةَ، وَأَبُو بَكْرِ بْنُ عَيَّاشٍ، عَنْ يَحْيَى بْنِ سَعِيدٍ، عَنْ أَنَسِ بْنِ مَالِكٍ، قَالَ:
entries.matn_ar: " دَعَا رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم الْأَنْصَارَ لِيَكْتُبَ لَهُمْ بِشَيْءٍ بِالْبَحْرَيْنِ فَقَالُوا: لَا حَتَّى تَكْتُبَ لِإِخْوَانِنَا مِنَ الْمُهَاجِرِينَ بِمِثْلِهِ، فقال: إِنَّكُمْ سَتَرَوْنَ بَعْدِي أَثَرَةً ، فَاصْبِرُوا حَتَّى تَلْقَوْنِي "
entries.isnad_en: Isma'il informed us. He said: al-Hasan narrated to us. He said: Yahya narrated to us. He said: Sufyan b. 'Uyayna and Abu Bakr b. 'Ayyash narrated to us, from Yahya b. Sa'id, from Anas b. Malik, who said:
entries.matn_en: The Messenger of God ﷺ summoned the Ansar to write for them something in al-Bahrayn, and they said: No, not until you write for our brothers of the Emigrants the like of it. He said: You will see after me preferential treatment (athara), so be patient until you meet me.

entries.label: Narration
entries.isnad_ar: أَخْبَرَنَا إِسْمَاعِيلُ، قَالَ: حَدَّثَنَا الْحَسَنُ، قَالَ: حَدَّثَنَا يَحْيَى، قَالَ: حَدَّثَنَا ابْنُ أَبِي زَائِدَةَ، عَنْ مُحَمَّدِ بْنِ إِسْحَاقَ،
entries.matn_ar: فِي قَوْلِهِ عز وجل: {مَا أَفَاءَ اللَّهُ عَلَى رَسُولِهِ مِنْهُمْ} [الحشر: 6] قَالَ: " مِنْ بَنِي النَّضِيرِ " {فَمَا أَوْجَفْتُمْ عَلَيْهِ مِنْ خَيْلٍ وَلَا رِكَابٍ وَلَكِنَّ اللَّهَ يُسَلِّطُ رُسُلَهُ عَلَى مَنْ يَشَاءُ} [الحشر: 6] ، قَالَ: " أَعْلَمَهُمْ أَنَّهَا لِرَسُولِهِ خَاصَّةً دُونَ النَّاسِ، فَقَسَمَهَا فِي الْمُهَاجِرِينَ إِلَّا سَهْلَ بْنَ حُنَيْفٍ، وَأَبَا دُجَانَةَ ذَكَرَا فَقْرًا ، فَأَعْطَاهُمَا " قَالَ: وَأَمَّا قَوْلُهُ: {مَا أَفَاءَ اللَّهُ عَلَى ⦗ص: 33⦘ رَسُولِهِ مِنْ أَهْلِ الْقُرَى فَلِلَّهِ وَلِلرَّسُولِ} [الحشر: 7] إِلَى آخِرِ الْآيَةِ ، قَالَ: " هَذَا قَسْمٌ آخَرُ بَيْنَ الْمُسْلِمِينَ، عَلَى مَا وَضَعَهُ اللَّهُ عز وجل عَلَيْهِ "
entries.isnad_en: Isma'il informed us. He said: al-Hasan narrated to us. He said: Yahya narrated to us. He said: Ibn Abi Za'ida narrated to us, from Muhammad b. Ishaq, concerning His saying, mighty and majestic:
entries.matn_en: {What God bestowed upon His Messenger from them} [al-Hashr: 6], he said: From Banu al-Nadir; {for you did not spur against it any horses or camels, but God gives His messengers authority over whom He wills} [al-Hashr: 6], he said: He informed them that it was for His Messenger specially, to the exclusion of the people, so he divided it among the Emigrants except Sahl b. Hunayf and Abu Dujana, who mentioned poverty, so he gave them. He said: As for His saying: {What God bestowed upon [p. 33] His Messenger from the people of the towns belongs to God and to the Messenger} [al-Hashr: 7] to the end of the verse, he said: This is another division among the Muslims, according to what God, mighty and majestic, laid down for it.

entries.label: Narration
entries.isnad_ar: أَخْبَرَنَا إِسْمَاعِيلُ، قَالَ: حَدَّثَنَا الْحَسَنُ، قَالَ: حَدَّثَنَا يَحْيَى، قَالَ: حَدَّثَنَا يَحْيَى بْنُ أَبِي زَائِدَةَ، عَنْ شُعْبَةَ، عَنْ سِمَاكٍ الْحَنَفِيِّ، قَالَ: سَمِعْتُ ابْنَ عَبَّاسٍ
entries.matn_ar: يَقُولُ فِي قَوْلِهِ عز وجل: " {وَأُخْرَى لَمْ تَقْدِرُوا عَلَيْهَا} [الفتح: 21] ، قَالَ: " هُوَ مَا أَصَبْتُمْ بَعْدُ "
entries.isnad_en: Isma'il informed us. He said: al-Hasan narrated to us. He said: Yahya narrated to us. He said: Yahya b. Abi Za'ida narrated to us, from Shu'ba, from Simak al-Hanafi, who said: I heard Ibn 'Abbas say concerning His saying, mighty and majestic: {and another [victory] which you were not able to [take]} [al-Fath: 21], he said:
entries.matn_en: It is what you obtained afterwards.

entries.label: Narration
entries.isnad_ar: أَخْبَرَنَا إِسْمَاعِيلُ، قَالَ: حَدَّثَنَا الْحَسَنُ، قَالَ: حَدَّثَنَا يَحْيَى، قَالَ: حَدَّثَنِي أَبُو بَكْرِ بْنُ عَيَّاشٍ، عَنِ الْكَلْبِيِّ، عَنْ أَبِي صَالِحٍ، عَنِ ابْنِ عَبَّاسٍ،
entries.matn_ar: قَوْلُهُ عز وجل: " {قَدْ أَحَاطَ اللَّهُ بِهَا} [الفتح: 21] " أَنَّهَا سَتَكُونُ لَكُمْ بِمَنْزِلَةِ قَوْلِهِ: أَحَاطَ اللَّهُ بِهَا عِلْمًا، أَنَّهَا لَكُمْ "
entries.isnad_en: Isma'il informed us. He said: al-Hasan narrated to us. He said: Yahya narrated to us. He said: Abu Bakr b. 'Ayyash narrated to me, from al-Kalbi, from Abu Salih, from Ibn 'Abbas, concerning His saying, mighty and majestic: {God has encompassed it} [al-Fath: 21],
entries.matn_en: that it will be yours, in the position of His saying: God has encompassed it in knowledge, that it is yours.

entries.label: Narration
entries.isnad_ar: أَخْبَرَنَا إِسْمَاعِيلُ، قَالَ: حَدَّثَنَا الْحَسَنُ، قَالَ: حَدَّثَنَا يَحْيَى، قَالَ: حَدَّثَنَا أَبُو بَكْرٍ، عَنِ الْكَلْبِيِّ، قَالَ:
entries.matn_ar: لَمَّا ظَهَرَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم عَلَى أَمْوَالِ بَنِي النَّضِيرِ وَكَانُوا أَوَّلَ مَنْ أُجْلِيَ، وَذَلِكَ قَوْلُهُ عز وجل: {هُوَ الَّذِي أَخْرَجَ الَّذِينَ كَفَرُوا مِنْ أَهْلِ الْكِتَابِ مِنْ دِيَارِهِمْ لَأَوَّلِ الْحَشْرِ} [الحشر: 2] . قَالَ: الْحَشْرُ هُوَ الْجَلَاءُ، وَهُوَ قَوْلُهُ عز وجل: {وَلَوْلَا أَنْ كَتَبَ اللَّهُ عَلَيْهِمُ الْجَلَاءَ} [الحشر: 3] . " فَكَانَتْ مِمَّا لَمْ يُوجِفِ الْمُسْلِمُونَ عَلَيْهِ بِخَيْلٍ وَلَا رِكَابٍ " {وَلَكِنَّ اللَّهَ يُسَلِّطُ رُسُلَهُ عَلَى مَنْ يَشَاءُ} [الحشر: 6] ، فَقَالَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم لِلْأَنْصَارِ: " إِنَّ إِخْوَانَكُمْ مِنَ الْمُهَاجِرِينَ لَيْسَتْ لَهُمْ أَمْوَالٌ، فَإِنْ شِئْتُمْ قَسَمْتُ هَذِهِ وَأَمْوَالَكُمْ بَيْنَكُمْ وَبَيْنَهُمْ جَمِيعًا، وَإِنْ شِئْتُمْ أَمْسَكْتُمْ أَمْوَالَكُمْ ، وَقَسَمْتُ هَذِهِ فِيهِمْ خَاصَّةً "، قَالَ: فَقَالُوا: لَا، بَلْ تُقْسَمُ هَذِهِ فِيهِمْ، وَاقْسِمْ لَهُمْ مِنْ أَمْوَالِنَا مَا شِئْتَ، قَالَ: فَنَزَلَتْ {وَيُؤْثِرُونَ عَلَى أَنْفُسِهِمْ وَلَوْ كَانَ بِهِمْ خَصَاصَةٌ} [الحشر: 9] . قَالَ: وَقَالَ أَبُو بَكْرٍ: يَا مَعْشَرَ الْأَنْصَارِ جَزَاكُمُ اللَّهُ خَيْرًا، فَوَاللَّهِ مَا مَثَلُنَا وَمَثَلُكُمْ إِلَّا كَمَا قَالَ طُفَيْلٌ الْغَنَوِيُّ لِبَنِي جَعْفَرٍ ⦗ص: 34⦘ : [البحر الطويل] جَزَى اللَّهُ عَنَّا جَعْفَرًا حِينَ أَشْرَفَتْ … بِنَا نَعْلُنَا فِي الْواطِئِينَ فَزَلَّتِ أَبَوْا أَنْ يَمَلُّونَا وَلَوْ أَنَّ أُمَّنَا … تُلَاقِي الَّذِي يَلْقَوْنَ مِنَّا لَمَلَّتِ فَذُو الْمَالِ مَوْفُورٌ وَكُلُّ مُعَصَّبٍ … إِلَى حُجُرَاتٍ أَدْفَأَتْ وَأَظَلَّتِ
entries.isnad_en: Isma'il informed us. He said: al-Hasan narrated to us. He said: Yahya narrated to us. He said: Abu Bakr narrated to us, from al-Kalbi, who said:
entries.matn_en: When the Messenger of God ﷺ prevailed over the property of Banu al-Nadir, who were the first to be exiled, and that is His saying, mighty and majestic: {He it is who drove out those who disbelieved among the People of the Book from their homes at the first gathering (hashr)} [al-Hashr: 2]. He said: The hashr is the exile (jala'), and that is His saying, mighty and majestic: {Had God not decreed exile for them} [al-Hashr: 3]. “So it was among what the Muslims had not spurred horses or camels against,” {but God gives His messengers authority over whom He wills} [al-Hashr: 6]. The Messenger of God ﷺ said to the Ansar: Your brothers of the Emigrants have no property; if you wish, I will divide this and your property between you and them all, and if you wish you may keep your property and I will divide this among them specifically. He said: They said: No, rather let this be divided among them, and divide for them from our property whatever you wish. He said: Then was revealed: {and they prefer others over themselves, even if they are in need} [al-Hashr: 9]. He said: And Abu Bakr said: O company of the Ansar, may God reward you well; by God, our likeness and yours is only as Tufayl al-Ghanawi said of Banu Ja'far [p. 34] : [meter: al-tawil] May God reward Ja'far on our behalf when our sandals, with us among those who tread, slipped. / They refused to grow weary of us, and if our mother had met what they meet from us, she would have wearied. / The man of wealth is amply provided for, and every kinsman [is drawn] to chambers that gave warmth and shelter.

entries.label: Narration
entries.isnad_ar: أَخْبَرَنَا إِسْمَاعِيلُ، قَالَ: حَدَّثَنَا الْحَسَنُ، قَالَ: حَدَّثَنَا يَحْيَى، قَالَ: حَدَّثَنِي ابْنُ أَبِي زَائِدَةَ، عَنْ عَوْفٍ الْأَعْرَابِيِّ، عَنِ الْحَسَنِ،
entries.matn_ar: فِي قَوْلِهِ عز وجل: {مَا آتَاكُمُ الرَّسُولُ فَخُذُوهُ وَمَا نَهَاكُمْ عَنْهُ فَانْتَهُوا} [الحشر: 7] ، قَالَ: " كَانَ يُؤْتِيهِمُ الْغَنَائِمَ ، وَيَنْهَاهُمْ عَنِ الْغُلُولِ "
entries.isnad_en: Isma'il informed us. He said: al-Hasan narrated to us. He said: Yahya narrated to us. He said: Ibn Abi Za'ida narrated to me, from 'Awf al-A'rabi, from al-Hasan, concerning His saying, mighty and majestic: {What the Messenger gives you, take it; and what he forbids you, abstain from it} [al-Hashr: 7], he said:
entries.matn_en: He used to give them the spoils and forbid them from ghulul (misappropriation of spoils).

entries.label: Narration
entries.isnad_ar: أَخْبَرَنَا إِسْمَاعِيلُ، قَالَ: حَدَّثَنَا الْحَسَنُ، قَالَ: حَدَّثَنَا يَحْيَى، قَالَ: حَدَّثَنَا سُفْيَانُ بْنُ عُيَيْنَةَ، عَنْ مَعْمَرٍ، عَنِ الزُّهْرِيِّ، عَنْ مَالِكِ بْنِ أَوْسِ بْنِ الْحَدَثَانِ، عَنْ عُمَرَ بْنِ الْخَطَّابِ رضي الله عنه، قَالَ:
entries.matn_ar: " كَانَتْ أَمْوَالُ بَنِي النَّضِيرِ مِمَّا أَفَاءَ اللَّهُ عَلَى رَسُولِهِ، لَمْ يُوجِفْ عَلَيْهِ الْمُسْلِمُونَ بِخَيْلٍ وَلَا رِكَابٍ، فَكَانَتْ لِرَسُولِ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم خَاصَّةً، فَكَانَ يُنْفِقُ مِنْهَا نَفَقَةَ سَنَتِهِ، وَمَا بَقِيَ جَعَلَهُ فِي الْكُرَاعِ وَالسِّلَاحِ، عُدَّةً فِي سَبِيلِ اللَّهِ عز وجل "
entries.isnad_en: Isma'il informed us. He said: al-Hasan narrated to us. He said: Yahya narrated to us. He said: Sufyan b. 'Uyayna narrated to us, from Ma'mar, from al-Zuhri, from Malik b. Aws b. al-Hadathan, from 'Umar b. al-Khattab (r), who said:
entries.matn_en: The property of Banu al-Nadir was among what God bestowed upon His Messenger, for which the Muslims had not spurred horses or camels, so it belonged exclusively to the Messenger of God ﷺ; he would spend from it the expenditure of his year, and what remained he put into mounts and weapons, as equipment in the way of God, mighty and majestic.

entries.label: Narration
entries.isnad_ar: أَخْبَرَنَا إِسْمَاعِيلُ، قَالَ: حَدَّثَنَا الْحَسَنُ، قَالَ: حَدَّثَنَا يَحْيَى، قَالَ: حَدَّثَنِي إِبْرَاهِيمُ بْنُ حُمَيْدٍ الرُّؤَاسِيُّ، عَنْ أُسَامَةَ بْنِ زَيْدٍ اللَّيْثِيِّ، قَالَ: أَخْبَرَنِي ابْنُ شِهَابٍ، عَنْ مَالِكِ بْنِ أَوْسِ بْنِ الْحَدَثَانِ، عَنْ عُمَرَ بْنِ الْخَطَّابِ رضي الله عنه، قَالَ:
entries.matn_ar: " كَانَتْ لِرَسُولِ صلى الله عليه وسلم ثَلَاثُ صَفَايَا: خَيْبَرُ، وَفَدَكُ، وَبَنُو النَّضِيرِ، فَأَمَّا بَنُو النَّضِيرِ فَكَانَتْ حَبْسًا لِنَوَائِبِهِ، وَأَمَّا فَدَكُ فَكَانَتْ لِأَبْنَاءِ السَّبِيلِ، وَأَمَّا خَيْبَرُ فَجَزَّأَهَا ثَلَاثَةَ أَجْزَاءٍ: جُزْأَيْنِ بَيْنَ الْمُسْلِمِينَ، وَجُزْءًا لِنَفَقَةِ أَهْلِهِ، وَمَا فَضَلَ عَنْ نَفَقَةِ أَهْلِهِ رُدَّ عَلَى فُقَرَاءِ الْمُهَاجِرِينَ، ثُمَّ قَالَ عُمَرُ: إِنَّ اللَّهَ خَصَّ رَسُولَ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم مِنْ هَذَا الْفَيْءِ بِشَيْءٍ لَمْ يُعْطِهِ أَحَدًا غَيْرَهُ، ثُمَّ ⦗ص: 35⦘ قَرَأَ: {مَا أَفَاءَ اللَّهُ عَلَى رَسُولِهِ} [الحشر: 7] إِلَى آخِرِ الْآيَةِ، ثُمَّ قَالَ: فَكَانَتْ هَذِهِ خَالِصَةً لِرَسُولِ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم ، فَوَاللَّهِ مَا اسْتَأْثَرَ بِهَا عَلَيْكُمْ، وَلَقَدْ بَثَّهَا فِيكُمْ حَتَّى بَقَّى مِنْهَا هَذَا الْمَالَ، فَكَانَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم يُنْفِقُ مِنْهَا عَلَى أَهْلِهِ نَفَقَةَ سَنَتِهِمْ، ثُمَّ يَأْخُذُ مَا بَقِيَ مِنْ ذَلِكَ فَيَجْعَلُهُ مَجْعَلَ مَالِ اللَّهِ عز وجل، عَمِلَ بِذَلِكَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم، حَتَّى تَوَفَّاهُ اللَّهُ عز وجل ، ثُمَّ قَبَضَهَا أَبُو بَكْرٍ، فَعَمِلَ فِيهَا بِمِثْلِ عَمَلِ رَسُولِ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم، ثُمَّ تُوُفِّيَ أَبُو بَكْرٍ فَقَبَضْتُهَا فَعَمِلْتُ فِيهَا بِمَا عَمِلَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم، وَبِمَا عَمِلَ أَبُو بَكْرٍ رضي الله عنه بَعْدَهُ "
entries.isnad_en: Isma'il informed us. He said: al-Hasan narrated to us. He said: Yahya narrated to us. He said: Ibrahim b. Humayd al-Ru'asi narrated to me, from Usama b. Zayd al-Laythi, who said: Ibn Shihab informed me, from Malik b. Aws b. al-Hadathan, from 'Umar b. al-Khattab (r), who said:
