entries.matn_en: The Messenger of God ﷺ had three safaya (choice properties): Khaybar, Fadak, and Banu al-Nadir. As for Banu al-Nadir, it was set aside (habs) for his emergencies; as for Fadak, it was for the wayfarers (abna' al-sabil); and as for Khaybar, he divided it into three parts: two parts among the Muslims, and one part for the maintenance of his family; and what remained after the maintenance of his family was returned to the poor of the Emigrants. Then 'Umar said: God singled out the Messenger of God ﷺ, from this fay', with something He gave to no one else. Then [p. 35] he recited: {What God bestowed upon His Messenger} [al-Hashr: 7] to the end of the verse. Then he said: So this was exclusively for the Messenger of God ﷺ, and by God he did not monopolize it over you, and he distributed it among you until this property remained of it. The Messenger of God ﷺ used to spend from it on his family the expenditure of their year, then take what remained of that and put it in the place of the property of God, mighty and majestic. The Messenger of God ﷺ acted in this way until God, mighty and majestic, took him; then Abu Bakr took possession of it and acted in it as the Messenger of God ﷺ had acted; then Abu Bakr died and I took possession of it and acted in it as the Messenger of God ﷺ had acted and as Abu Bakr (r) had acted after him.

entries.label: Narration
entries.isnad_ar: أَخْبَرَنَا إِسْمَاعِيلُ، قَالَ: حَدَّثَنَا الْحَسَنُ، قَالَ: حَدَّثَنَا يَحْيَى، قَالَ: حَدَّثَنِي عَبْدُ السَّلَامِ بْنُ حَرْبٍ، عَنْ شُعْبَةَ، عَنِ الْحَكَمِ، عَنْ عَبْدِ الرَّحْمَنِ بْنِ أَبِي لَيْلَى،
entries.matn_ar: فِي قَوْلِهِ عز وجل: " {وَأَثَابَهُمْ فَتْحًا قَرِيبًا} [الفتح: 18] ، قَالَ: " خَيْبَرُ ". {وَأُخْرَى لَمْ تَقْدِرُوا عَلَيْهَا} [الفتح: 21] . قَالَ: " فَارِسُ، وَالرُّومُ "
entries.isnad_en: Isma'il informed us. He said: al-Hasan narrated to us. He said: Yahya narrated to us. He said: 'Abd al-Salam b. Harb narrated to me, from Shu'ba, from al-Hakam, from 'Abd al-Rahman b. Abi Layla, concerning His saying, mighty and majestic: {and rewarded them with a near victory} [al-Fath: 18], he said:
entries.matn_en: Khaybar. {and another which you were not able [to take]} [al-Fath: 21]. He said: Persia and Rome.

entries.label: Narration
entries.isnad_ar: أَخْبَرَنَا إِسْمَاعِيلُ، قَالَ: حَدَّثَنَا الْحَسَنُ، قَالَ: حَدَّثَنَا يَحْيَى، قَالَ: حَدَّثَنِي ابْنُ أَبِي زَائِدَةَ، عَنْ مُحَمَّدِ بْنِ إِسْحَاقَ، عَنِ الزُّهْرِيِّ،
entries.matn_ar: وَعَبْدِ اللَّهِ بْنِ أَبِي بَكْرٍ، وَبَعْضِ وَلَدِ مُحَمَّدِ بْنِ مَسْلَمَةَ، قَالُوا: " بَقِيَتْ بَقِيَّةٌ مِنْ أَهْلِ خَيْبَرَ تَحَصَّنُوا، فَسَأَلُوا رَسُولَ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم أَنْ يَحْقِنَ دِمَاءَهُمْ ، وَيُسَيِّرَهُمْ، فَفَعَلَ، فَسَمِعَ بِذَلِكَ أَهْلُ فَدَكَ، فَنَزَلُوا عَلَى مِثْلِ ذَلِكَ، فَكَانَتْ لِرَسُولِ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم خَالِصَةً؛ لِأَنَّهُ لَمْ يُوجِفْ عَلَيْهَا بِخَيْلٍ وَلَا رِكَابٍ "
entries.isnad_en: Isma'il informed us. He said: al-Hasan narrated to us. He said: Yahya narrated to us. He said: Ibn Abi Za'ida narrated to me, from Muhammad b. Ishaq, from al-Zuhri, 'Abd Allah b. Abi Bakr, and some of the children of Muhammad b. Maslama; they said:
entries.matn_en: A remnant of the people of Khaybar remained, having fortified themselves, and they asked the Messenger of God ﷺ to spare their blood and send them away, and he did so. The people of Fadak heard of that and surrendered on the same terms, so it belonged exclusively to the Messenger of God ﷺ, because no horses or camels had been spurred against it.

entries.label: Narration
entries.isnad_ar: أَخْبَرَنَا إِسْمَاعِيلُ، قَالَ: حَدَّثَنَا الْحَسَنُ، قَالَ: حَدَّثَنَا يَحْيَى، قَالَ: حَدَّثَنَا حَمَّادُ بْنُ سَلَمَةَ، عَنْ يَحْيَى بْنِ سَعِيدٍ، عَنْ بُشَيْرِ بْنِ يَسَارٍ
entries.matn_ar: أَنَّ رَسُولَ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم " قَسَمَ خَيْبَرَ عَلَى سِتَّةٍ وَثَلَاثِينَ سَهْمًا: لِرَسُولِ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم ثَمَانِيَةَ عَشَرَ سَهْمًا لِمَا يَنُوبُهُ مِنَ الْحُقُوقِ وَأَمْرِ النَّاسِ، وَقَسَمَ ثَمَانِيَةَ عَشَرَ سَهْمًا فَضَرَبَ كُلَّ سَهْمٍ لِمِائَةِ رَجُلٍ، وَكَانَ مَعَهُ يَوْمَئِذٍ مِائَةُ فَرَسٍ "
entries.isnad_en: Isma'il informed us. He said: al-Hasan narrated to us. He said: Yahya narrated to us. He said: Hammad b. Salama narrated to us, from Yahya b. Sa'id, from Bushayr b. Yasar
entries.matn_en: that the Messenger of God ﷺ divided Khaybar into thirty-six shares: to the Messenger of God ﷺ eighteen shares for the claims and affairs of the people that befell him, and he divided eighteen shares, allotting each share to a hundred men, and with him that day were a hundred horses.

entries.label: Narration
entries.isnad_ar: أَخْبَرَنَا إِسْمَاعِيلُ، قَالَ: حَدَّثَنَا الْحَسَنُ، قَالَ: حَدَّثَنَا يَحْيَى، قَالَ: حَدَّثَنَا ⦗ص: 36⦘ عَبْدُ السَّلَامِ بْنُ حَرْبٍ، عَنْ يَحْيَى بْنِ سَعِيدٍ، قَالَ: سَمِعْتُ بُشَيْرَ بْنَ يَسَارٍ يَقُولُ:
entries.matn_ar: " قُسِمَتْ سُهْمَانُ خَيْبَرَ عَلَى سِتَّةٍ وَثَلَاثِينَ سَهْمًا، جَمَعَ كُلُّ سَهْمٍ مِائَةً مِنْهُمْ، وَكَانَ مِنْ ذَلِكَ ثَمَانِيَةَ عَشَرَ سَهْمًا جَمْعًا لِلْمُسْلِمِينَ، اقْتَسَمُوهَا بَيْنَهُمْ، مِنْهَا سَهْمُ رَسُولِ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم ، مِثْلُ سَهْمِ أَحَدِهِمْ، وَثَمَانِيَةَ عَشَرَ سَهْمًا وُقِفَتْ لِمَنْ نَزَلَ بِرَسُولِ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم مِنَ النَّاسِ وَالْوُفُودِ ، وَمَا نَابَهُ، فَكَتَبَ فِيهَا رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم لِلنَّاسِ، وَكَانَ لِأَزْوَاجِهِ مِنْ ذَلِكَ "، قَالَ يَحْيَى بْنُ سَعِيدٍ: بَلَغَنَا أَنَّهُ كَانَ لِأَزْوَاجِهِ فِي ذَلِكَ - كَتَبَهُ لِكُلِّ امْرَأَةٍ مِنْهُمْ - ثَمَانُونَ وَسْقًا تَمْرًا وَعِشْرُونَ حَبًّا "
entries.isnad_en: Isma'il informed us. He said: al-Hasan narrated to us. He said: Yahya narrated to us. He said: [p. 36] 'Abd al-Salam b. Harb narrated to us, from Yahya b. Sa'id, who said: I heard Bushayr b. Yasar say:
entries.matn_en: The shares of Khaybar were divided into thirty-six shares, each share comprising a hundred of them. Of that, eighteen shares were a collective for the Muslims, which they divided among themselves, including the share of the Messenger of God ﷺ, like the share of one of them; and eighteen shares were set aside for those who called upon the Messenger of God ﷺ of the people and the delegations, and for what befell him; and the Messenger of God ﷺ wrote in it for the people, and his wives had of that. Yahya b. Sa'id said: It has reached us that his wives had in that—he wrote it for each woman of them—eighty wasqs of dates and twenty [wasqs of] grain (habb).

entries.label: Narration
entries.isnad_ar: أَخْبَرَنَا إِسْمَاعِيلُ، قَالَ: حَدَّثَنَا الْحَسَنُ، قَالَ: حَدَّثَنَا يَحْيَى، قَالَ: حَدَّثَنَا أَبُو بَكْرٍ، عَنِ الْكَلْبِيِّ، قَالَ:
entries.matn_ar: " قَسَمَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم أَمْوَالَ بَنِي النَّضِيرِ إِلَّا سَبْعَةَ حَوَائِطَ مِنْهَا ، أَمْسَكَهَا وَلَمْ يَقْسِمْهَا "
entries.isnad_en: Isma'il informed us. He said: al-Hasan narrated to us. He said: Yahya narrated to us. He said: Abu Bakr narrated to us, from al-Kalbi, who said:
entries.matn_en: The Messenger of God ﷺ divided the property of Banu al-Nadir except seven orchards (hawa'it) of it, which he kept and did not divide.

entries.label: Narration
entries.isnad_ar: أَخْبَرَنَا إِسْمَاعِيلُ، قَالَ: حَدَّثَنَا الْحَسَنُ، قَالَ: حَدَّثَنَا يَحْيَى، قَالَ: حَدَّثَنَا سُفْيَانُ بْنُ عُيَيْنَةَ، قَالَ: سَمِعْنَا فِي قَوْلِهِ عز وجل:
entries.matn_ar: " {مَا آتَاكُمُ الرَّسُولُ فَخُذُوهُ} [الحشر: 7] . قَالَ: مِنَ الْفَيْءِ {وَمَا نَهَاكُمْ عَنْهُ فَانْتَهُوا} [الحشر: 7] قَالَ: " الْغُلُولُ "
entries.isnad_en: Isma'il informed us. He said: al-Hasan narrated to us. He said: Yahya narrated to us. He said: Sufyan b. 'Uyayna narrated to us, who said: We heard concerning His saying, mighty and majestic: {What the Messenger gives you, take it} [al-Hashr: 7]. He said:
entries.matn_en: From the fay'; {and what he forbids you, abstain from it} [al-Hashr: 7], he said: ghulul.

entries.label: Narration
entries.isnad_ar: أَخْبَرَنَا إِسْمَاعِيلُ، قَالَ: حَدَّثَنَا الْحَسَنُ، قَالَ: حَدَّثَنَا يَحْيَى، قَالَ: حَدَّثَنَا أَبُو شِهَابٍ، عَنْ يَحْيَى بْنِ سَعِيدٍ، عَنْ بُشَيْرِ بْنِ يَسَارٍ، أَنَّهُ سَمِعَ نَفَرًا، مِنْ أَصْحَابِ رَسُولِ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم قَالُوا:
entries.matn_ar: " إِنَّ رَسُولَ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم حِينَ ظَهَرَ عَلَى خَيْبَرَ، قَسَمَهَا رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم عَلَى سِتَّةٍ وَثَلَاثِينَ سَهْمًا، جَمَعَ كُلُّ سَهْمٍ مِائَةَ سَهْمٍ، وَكَانَ النِّصْفُ سِهَامًا لِلْمُسْلِمِينَ، وَسَهْمَ رَسُولِ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم، وَعَزَلَ النِّصْفَ لِمَا يَنُوبُهُ مِنَ الْأُمُورِ النَّوائِبِ "
entries.isnad_en: Isma'il informed us. He said: al-Hasan narrated to us. He said: Yahya narrated to us. He said: Abu Shihab narrated to us, from Yahya b. Sa'id, from Bushayr b. Yasar, that he heard a group of the Companions of the Messenger of God ﷺ say:
entries.matn_en: When the Messenger of God ﷺ prevailed over Khaybar, the Messenger of God ﷺ divided it into thirty-six shares, each share comprising a hundred shares; half were shares for the Muslims, and the share of the Messenger of God ﷺ, and he set aside half for the emergencies (nawa'ib) that befell him.

entries.label: Narration
entries.isnad_ar: أَخْبَرَنَا إِسْمَاعِيلُ، قَالَ: حَدَّثَنَا الْحَسَنُ، قَالَ: حَدَّثَنَا يَحْيَى، قَالَ: حَدَّثَنَا ابْنُ ⦗ص: 37⦘ فُضَيْلٍ، عَنْ يَحْيَى بْنِ سَعِيدٍ، عَنْ بُشَيْرٍ، مَوْلَى الْأَنْصَارِ، عَنْ رِجَالٍ،
entries.matn_ar: مِنْ أَصْحَابِ رَسُولِ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم: أَنَّ رَسُولَ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم لَمَّا ظَهَرَ عَلَى خَيْبَرَ، قَسَمَهَا عَلَى سِتَّةٍ وَثَلَاثِينَ سَهْمًا، جَمَعَ كُلُّ سَهْمٍ مِائَةَ سَهْمٍ، فَكَانَ لِرَسُولِ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم وَلِلْمُسْلِمِينَ النِّصْفُ مِنْ ذَلِكَ، وَعَزَلَ النِّصْفَ الْبَاقِيَ لِمَنْ يَنْزِلُ بِهِ مِنَ الْوُفُودِ وَالْأُمُورِ وَنَوَائِبِ النَّاسِ "
entries.isnad_en: Isma'il informed us. He said: al-Hasan narrated to us. He said: Yahya narrated to us. He said: Ibn [p. 37] Fudayl narrated to us, from Yahya b. Sa'id, from Bushayr, client of the Ansar, from men of the Companions of the Messenger of God ﷺ:
entries.matn_en: that the Messenger of God ﷺ, when he prevailed over Khaybar, divided it into thirty-six shares, each share comprising a hundred shares; the Messenger of God ﷺ and the Muslims had half of that, and he set aside the remaining half for the delegations that came to him, for affairs, and for the people’s emergencies.

entries.label: Narration
entries.isnad_ar: أَخْبَرَنَا إِسْمَاعِيلُ، قَالَ: حَدَّثَنَا الْحَسَنُ، قَالَ: حَدَّثَنَا يَحْيَى، قَالَ: حَدَّثَنَا يَحْيَى بْنُ أَبِي زَائِدَةَ، عَنِ مُحَمَّدِ بْنِ إِسْحَاقَ، عَنْ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ بْنِ أَبِي بَكْرٍ،
entries.matn_ar: وَغَيْرِهِ، أَنَّ رَسُولَ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم " خَرَجَ يَسْتَعِينُ بَنِي النَّضِيرِ فِي دِيَةٍ، فَأَرَادُوا قَتْلَهُ، فَخَرَجَ إِلَيْهِمْ ، فَامْتَنَعُوا مِنْهُ، ثُمَّ سَأَلُوهُ أَنْ يُجْلِيَهُمْ وَيَكُفَّ عَنْ دِمَائِهِمْ عَلَى أَنَّ لَهُمْ مَا حَمَلَتِ الْإِبِلُ مِنْ أَمْوَالِهِمْ، إِلَّا الْحَلْقَةَ، فَخَرَجُوا ، وَخَلُّوا أَمْوَالَهُمْ لِلنَّبِيِّ صلى الله عليه وسلم ، فَكَانَتْ لَهُ خَاصَّةً؛ لِأَنَّهُ لَمْ يُوجِفْ عَلَيْهَا بِخَيْلٍ وَلَا رِكَابٍ "
entries.isnad_en: Isma'il informed us. He said: al-Hasan narrated to us. He said: Yahya narrated to us. He said: Yahya b. Abi Za'ida narrated to us, from Muhammad b. Ishaq, from 'Abd Allah b. Abi Bakr and others,
entries.matn_en: that the Messenger of God ﷺ went out seeking the help of Banu al-Nadir in a blood-price (diya), and they wanted to kill him; so he went out to them, and they put up resistance to him. Then they asked him to exile them and spare their blood, on condition that they have what the camels could carry of their property, except the halqa (armor). So they left, and they vacated their property for the Prophet ﷺ, and it belonged to him exclusively, because no horses or camels had been spurred against it.

entries.label: Narration
entries.isnad_ar: أَخْبَرَنَا إِسْمَاعِيلُ، قَالَ: حَدَّثَنَا الْحَسَنُ، قَالَ: حَدَّثَنَا يَحْيَى، قَالَ: حَدَّثَنَا عَبْدُ السَّلَامِ بْنُ حَرْبٍ، عَنْ عُبَيْدِ اللَّهِ بْنِ عُمَرَ، عَنْ نَافِعٍ، عَنِ ابْنِ عُمَرَ، قَالَ:
entries.matn_ar: " عَامَلَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم خَيْبَرَ بِشَطرِ مَا يَخْرُجُ مِنْ زَرْعٍ أَوْ ثَمَرٍ، فَكَانَ يُعْطِي أَزْوَاجَهُ كُلَّ عَامٍ مِائَةَ وَسْقٍ: ثَمَانِينَ وَسْقًا تَمْرًا وَعِشْرِينَ وَسْقًا شَعِيرًا كُلَّ عَامٍ، فَلَمَّا قَسَمَ عُمَرُ بْنُ الْخَطَّابِ رضي الله عنه قَسَمَ خَيْبَرَ، فَخَيَّرَ أَزْوَاجَ النَّبِيِّ صلى الله عليه وسلم أَنْ يُعْطِيَهُنَّ الْأَرْضَ أَوْ يَضْمَنَ لَهُنَّ الْوُسُوقَ كُلَّ عَامٍ، فَاخْتَلَفْنَ: مِنْهُنَّ مَنِ اخْتَارَ الْوُسُوقَ، وَمِنْهُنَّ مَنِ اخْتَارَ أَنْ يَقْطَعَ لَهُنَّ الْأَرْضَ، فَكَانَتْ عَائِشَةُ، وَحَفْصَةُ مِمَّنِ اخْتَارَ الْوُسُوقَ "
entries.isnad_en: Isma'il informed us. He said: al-Hasan narrated to us. He said: Yahya narrated to us. He said: 'Abd al-Salam b. Harb narrated to us, from 'Ubayd Allah b. 'Umar, from Nafi', from Ibn 'Umar, who said:
entries.matn_en: The Messenger of God ﷺ made a mu'amala with Khaybar for half of what came out of crops or fruit, and he used to give his wives each year a hundred wasqs: eighty wasqs of dates and twenty wasqs of barley each year. When 'Umar b. al-Khattab (r) divided, he divided Khaybar, and gave the wives of the Prophet ﷺ the choice between giving them the land or guaranteeing them the wasqs each year; they differed: some of them chose the wasqs and some chose that the land be allotted to them. 'A'isha and Hafsa were among those who chose the wasqs.

entries.label: Narration
entries.isnad_ar: أَخْبَرَنَا إِسْمَاعِيلُ، قَالَ: حَدَّثَنَا الْحَسَنُ، قَالَ: حَدَّثَنَا يَحْيَى، قَالَ: حَدَّثَنَا جَرِيرُ بْنُ عَبْدِ الْحَمِيدِ، عَنْ لَيْثٍ، عَنْ نَافِعٍ، قَالَ:
entries.matn_ar: " أَعْطَى رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم خَيْبَرَ أَهْلَهَا بِالشَّطْرِ، وَالنَّخْلِ - فِيمَا نَحْسَبُ - بِالْخُمُسِ ، فَكَانَتْ فِي حَيَاةِ رَسُولِ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم فِي أَيْدِيهِمْ، وَفِي حَيَاةِ أَبِي بَكْرٍ رضي الله عنه، وَفِي حَيَاةِ عُمَرَ رضي الله عنه، ثُمَّ إِنَّ عَبْدَ اللَّهِ بْنَ عُمَرَ أَتَاهُمْ فِي حَاجَةٍ، فَبَيَّتُوهُ فَجَرَحُوهُ ، فَاتَّهَمَهُمْ عُمَرُ فِي ذَلِكَ، فَأَخْرَجَهُمْ مِنْهَا، وَقَسَمَهَا بَيْنَ مَنْ حَضَرَهَا مِنَ الْمُسْلِمِينَ، فَجَعَلَ لِأَزْوَاجِ النَّبِيِّ صلى الله عليه وسلم مِنْهَا نَصِيبًا، فَقَالَ: أَيَّتُكُنَّ شَاءَتْ أَخَذَتِ الثَّمَنَ، وَأَيَّتُكُنَّ، شَاءَتْ أَخَذَتِ الضَّيْعَةَ، فَكَانَتْ لَهَا وَلِعَقِبِهَا "
entries.isnad_en: Isma'il informed us. He said: al-Hasan narrated to us. He said: Yahya narrated to us. He said: Jarir b. 'Abd al-Hamid narrated to us, from Layth, from Nafi', who said:
entries.matn_en: The Messenger of God ﷺ gave Khaybar to its people for half, and the palm trees—as we reckon—for a fifth. It was in the hands of its people in the lifetime of the Messenger of God ﷺ, in the lifetime of Abu Bakr (r), and in the lifetime of 'Umar (r). Then 'Abd Allah b. 'Umar came to them on an errand, and they attacked him by night and wounded him; 'Umar suspected them in that, so he expelled them from it and divided it among those of the Muslims who were present, and he made for the wives of the Prophet ﷺ a share of it. He said: Whichever of you wishes may take the price (thaman), and whichever of you wishes may take the estate (day'a), and it will be hers and her descendants’.

entries.label: Narration
entries.isnad_ar: حَدَّثَنَا سُفْيَانُ بْنُ عُيَيْنَةَ، عَنْ عَمْرِو بْنِ دِينَارٍ، قَالَ: سَمِعْتُ جَابِرَ بْنَ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ يَقُولُ:
entries.matn_ar: كُنَّا يَوْمَ الْحُدَيْبِيَةِ أَلْفًا وَأَرْبَعَ مِائَةِ رَجُلٍ، فَقَالَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم: " أَنْتُمُ الْيَوْمَ خَيْرُ أَهْلِ الْأَرْضِ "
entries.isnad_en: Sufyan b. 'Uyayna narrated to us, from 'Amr b. Dinar, who said: I heard Jabir b. 'Abd Allah say:
entries.matn_en: On the day of al-Hudaybiya we were one thousand four hundred men, and the Messenger of God ﷺ said: Today you are the best of the people of the earth.

entries.label: Narration
entries.isnad_ar: أَخْبَرَنَا إِسْمَاعِيلُ، قَالَ: حَدَّثَنَا الْحَسَنُ، قَالَ: حَدَّثَنَا يَحْيَى، قَالَ: حَدَّثَنَا أَبُو بَكْرِ بْنُ عَيَّاشٍ، عَنِ الْكَلْبِيِّ، عَنْ أَبِي صَالِحٍ، عَنِ ابْنِ عَبَّاسٍ، قَالَ:
entries.matn_ar: " قُسِمَتْ خَيْبَرُ عَلَى أَلْفِ سَهْمٍ وَخَمْسِمِائَةٍ وَثَمَانِينَ سَهْمًا، وَالَّذِينَ شَهِدُوا الْحُدَيْبِيَةَ أَلْفٌ وَخَمْسُمِائَةٍ وَأَرْبَعُونَ رَجُلًا، وَالَّذِينَ كَانُوا مَعَ جَعْفَرٍ بِأَرْضِ الْحَبَشَةِ أَرْبَعُونَ رَجُلًا، وَكَانَ مَعَهُمْ يَوْمَئِذٍ مِائَتَا فَرَسٍ أَوْ نَحْوُهَا، فَأَسْهَمَ لِلْفَرَسِ سَهْمَيْنِ وَلِصَاحِبِهِ سَهْمًا، قَالَ أَبُو بَكْرٍ: " ثُمَّ قَسَمَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم أَرْضَ بَنِي النَّضِيرِ وَأَرْضَ بَنِي قُرَيْظَةَ وَلَمْ يَقْسِمْ فَدَكًا "، قَالَ: وَلَمْ يَقْسِمْ عُمَرُ بْنُ الْخَطَّابِ رضي الله عنه سَوَادَنَا هَذَا "
entries.isnad_en: Isma'il informed us. He said: al-Hasan narrated to us. He said: Yahya narrated to us. He said: Abu Bakr b. 'Ayyash narrated to us, from al-Kalbi, from Abu Salih, from Ibn 'Abbas, who said:
entries.matn_en: Khaybar was divided into one thousand five hundred and eighty shares; those who witnessed al-Hudaybiya were one thousand five hundred and forty men, and those who were with Ja'far in the land of Abyssinia were forty men; and with them that day were two hundred horses or thereabouts, so he allotted two shares for the horse and one share for its owner. Abu Bakr said: Then the Messenger of God ﷺ divided the land of Banu al-Nadir and the land of Banu Qurayza, and did not divide Fadak. He said: And 'Umar b. al-Khattab (r) did not divide this Sawad of ours.

entries.label: Narration
entries.isnad_ar: أَخْبَرَنَا إِسْمَاعِيلُ، قَالَ: حَدَّثَنَا الْحَسَنُ، قَالَ: حَدَّثَنَا يَحْيَى، قَالَ:
entries.matn_ar: قَالَ أَبُو بَكْرٍ: وَكَانَ الْحَسَنُ الْبَصْرِيُّ، يَقُولُ: " مَا كَانَ فِي الْعَسْكَرِ فَهُوَ لِلَّذِينَ غَلَبُوا عَلَيْهِ، وَالْأَرْضُ لِلْمُسْلِمِينَ ". قَالَ أَبُو بَكْرٍ إِنَّمَا ذَلِكَ إِلَى الْإِمَامِ، إِنْ شَاءَ قَسَمَ الْأَرْضَ، وَإِنْ شَاءَ تَرَكَ "
entries.isnad_en: Isma'il informed us. He said: al-Hasan narrated to us. He said: Yahya narrated to us. He said: Abu Bakr said:
entries.matn_en: And al-Hasan al-Basri used to say: What is in the camp belongs to those who prevailed over it, and the land belongs to the Muslims. Abu Bakr said: That is only up to the imam: if he wishes he divides the land, and if he wishes he leaves it.

entries.label: Narration
entries.isnad_ar: أَخْبَرَنَا إِسْمَاعِيلُ، قَالَ: حَدَّثَنَا الْحَسَنُ، قَالَ: حَدَّثَنَا يَحْيَى، قَالَ: حَدَّثَنَا الْكَلْبِيُّ "
entries.matn_ar: لَمْ يَضْرِبِ النَّبِيُّ صلى الله عليه وسلم فِي خَيْبَرَ لِأَحَدٍ مِنْ غَيْرِ أَهْلِ الْحُدَيْبِيَةِ إِلَّا لِأَصْحَابِ جَعْفَرٍ الَّذِينَ كَانُوا مَعَهُ بِأَرْضِ الْحَبَشَةِ "
entries.isnad_en: Isma'il informed us. He said: al-Hasan narrated to us. He said: Yahya narrated to us. He said: al-Kalbi narrated to us:
entries.matn_en: The Prophet ﷺ did not allot a share at Khaybar to anyone other than the people of al-Hudaybiya, except for the companions of Ja'far who were with him in the land of Abyssinia.

entries.label: Unnumbered report
entries.isnad_ar: أَخْبَرَنَا إِسْمَاعِيلُ، قَالَ: حَدَّثَنَا الْحَسَنُ، قَالَ: حَدَّثَنَا يَحْيَى، قَالَ: حَدَّثَنَا إِسْرَائِيلُ، عَنْ أَبِي إِسْحَاقَ، عَنْ حَارِثَةَ بْنِ مُضَرِّبٍ، عَنْ عُمَرَ رضي الله عنه،
entries.matn_ar: أَنَّهُ أَرَادَ أَنْ يَقْسِمَ السَّوَادَ بَيْنَ الْمُسْلِمِينَ، فَأَمَرَ بِهِمْ أَنْ يُحْصَوْا ، فَوَجَدَ الرَّجُلَ الْمُسْلِمَ يُصِيبُهُ ثَلَاثَةٌ مِنَ الْفَلَّاحِينَ، يَعْنِي: الْعُلُوجَ، فَشَاوَرَ أَصْحَابَ النَّبِيِّ صلى الله عليه وسلم فِي ذَلِكَ ، فَقَالَ لَهُ - يَعْنِي عَلِيًّا -: " دَعْهُمْ يَكُونُونَ مَادَّةَ الْمُسْلِمِينَ، فَبَعَثَ عُثْمَانَ بْنَ حُنَيْفٍ، فَوَضَعَ عَلَيْهِمْ ثَمَانِيَةً وَأَرْبَعِينَ، وَأَرْبَعَةً وَعِشْرِينَ، وَاثْنَيْ عَشَرَ "
entries.isnad_en: Isma'il informed us. He said: al-Hasan narrated to us. He said: Yahya narrated to us. He said: Isra'il narrated to us, from Abu Ishaq, from Haritha b. Mudarrib, from 'Umar (r),
entries.matn_en: that he wished to divide the Sawad among the Muslims, so he ordered that they be counted, and found that each Muslim man would receive three of the peasants (falalih)—meaning the 'uluj (non-Arab foreigners). He consulted the Companions of the Prophet ﷺ about that, and he—meaning 'Ali—said to him: Leave them, to be a resource (maddat) for the Muslims. So he sent 'Uthman b. Hunayf, and he imposed upon them forty-eight, twenty-four and twelve [dirhams].

entries.label: Unnumbered report
entries.isnad_ar: أَخْبَرَنَا إِسْمَاعِيلُ، قَالَ: حَدَّثَنَا الْحَسَنُ، قَالَ: حَدَّثَنَا يَحْيَى، قَالَ: حَدَّثَنَا ⦗ص: 41⦘ زِيَادٌ الْبَكَّائِيُّ، عَنْ مُحَمَّدِ بْنِ إِسْحَاقَ، عَنْ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ بْنِ أَبِي بَكْرٍ، قَالَ:
entries.matn_ar: " حَصَرَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم أَهْلَ خَيْبَرَ فِي حِصْنَيْهِمُ: الْوَطِيحِ وَالسَّلَالِمِ، فَلَمَّا أَيْقَنُوا بِالْهَلَكَةِ، سَأَلُوهُ أَنْ يُسَيِّرَهُمْ وَيَحْقِنَ دِمَاءَهُمْ، فَفَعَلَ، وَكَانَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم قَدْ حَازَ الْأَمْوَالَ كُلَّهَا، الشِّقَّ وَالنَّطَاةَ، وَالْكَتِيبَةَ، وَجَمِيعَ حُصُونِهِمْ، إِلَّا مَا كَانَ مِنْ هَذَيْنِ الْحِصْنَيْنِ، فَلَمَّا سَمِعَ أَهْلُ فَدَكَ مَا صَنَعُوا، بَعَثُوا إِلَى رَسُولِ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم ، فَسَأَلُوهُ أَنْ يُسَيِّرَهُمْ وَيَحْقِنَ دِمَاءَهُمْ، وَيُخَلُّوا لَهُ الْأَمْوَالَ، فَفَعَلَ، وَكَانَ فِيمَنْ مَشَى بَيْنَهُ وَبَيْنَهُمْ مُحَيِّصَةُ بْنُ مَسْعُودٍ "
entries.isnad_en: Isma'il informed us. He said: al-Hasan narrated to us. He said: Yahya narrated to us. He said: [p. 41] Ziyad al-Bakka'i narrated to us, from Muhammad b. Ishaq, from 'Abd Allah b. Abi Bakr, who said:
entries.matn_en: The Messenger of God ﷺ besieged the people of Khaybar in their two fortresses, al-Watih and al-Sulalim. When they were certain of destruction, they asked him to send them away and spare their blood, and he did so. The Messenger of God ﷺ had taken possession of all the property—al-Shiqq, al-Natat, and al-Katiba, and all their fortresses—except what was in those two fortresses. When the people of Fadak heard what they had done, they sent to the Messenger of God ﷺ and asked him to send them away and spare their blood and to vacate the property for him, and he did so. Among those who went between him and them was Muhayyisa b. Mas'ud.

entries.label: Narration
entries.isnad_ar: أَخْبَرَنَا إِسْمَاعِيلُ، قَالَ: حَدَّثَنَا الْحَسَنُ، قَالَ: حَدَّثَنَا يَحْيَى، قَالَ: وَحَدَّثَنِي وَكِيعٌ، وَحُمَيْدُ بْنُ عَبْدِ الرَّحْمَنِ، عَنِ هِشَامِ بْنِ سَعْدٍ، عَنْ زَيْدِ بْنِ أَسْلَمَ، عَنْ أَبِيهِ، عَنْ عُمَرَ رضي الله عنه، أَنَّهُ قَالَ:
entries.matn_ar: " اجْتَمِعُوا حَتَّى نَنْظُرَ لِمَنْ هَذَا الْمَالُ - حِينَ أُتِيَ بِالْفَيْءِ - فَلَمَّا اجْتَمَعُوا، قَالَ: إِنِّي قَرَأْتُ كِتَابَ اللَّهِ ، فَاكْتَفَيْتُ بِهَا "، ثُمَّ قَرَأَ: {مَا أَفَاءَ اللَّهُ عَلَى رَسُولِهِ} [الحشر: 7] ، حَتَّى بَلَغَ {لِلْفُقَرَاءِ الْمُهَاجِرِينَ} [الحشر: 8] ، ثُمَّ قَرَأَ: {وَالَّذِينَ تَبَوَّءُوا الدَّارَ وَالْإِيمَانَ مِنْ قَبْلِهِمْ} ، ثُمَّ قَالَ: {وَالَّذِينَ جَاءُوا مِنْ بَعْدِهِمْ يَقُولُونَ رَبَّنَا اغْفِرْ لَنَا ⦗ص: 42⦘ وَلِإِخْوَانِنَا الَّذِينَ سَبَقُونَا بِالْإِيمَانِ} ، ثُمَّ قَالَ: " مَا أَحَدٌ مِنَ الْمُسْلِمِينَ إِلَّا لَهُ فِي هَذَا الْفَيْءِ حَقٌّ، إِلَّا عَبْدًا مَمْلُوكًا "
entries.isnad_en: Isma'il informed us. He said: al-Hasan narrated to us. He said: Yahya narrated to us. He said: And Waki' and Humayd b. 'Abd al-Rahman narrated to me, from Hisham b. Sa'd, from Zayd b. Aslam, from his father, from 'Umar (r), that he said:
entries.matn_en: Gather, so that we may consider to whom this property belongs—when the fay' was brought to him. When they had gathered, he said: I have read the Book of God and it sufficed me. Then he recited: {What God bestowed upon His Messenger} [al-Hashr: 7], until he reached {for the poor emigrants} [al-Hashr: 8], then he recited: {and those who had settled in the abode and in faith before them}, then he said: {and those who came after them say: Our Lord, forgive us [p. 42] and our brothers who preceded us in faith}, then he said: There is no one of the Muslims but has a right in this fay', except an owned slave.

entries.label: Narration
entries.isnad_ar: أَخْبَرَنَا إِسْمَاعِيلُ، قَالَ: حَدَّثَنَا الْحَسَنُ، قَالَ: حَدَّثَنَا يَحْيَى، قَالَ: حَدَّثَنَا ابْنُ الْمُبَارَكِ، عَنْ هِشَامِ بْنِ سَعْدٍ، عَنْ زَيْدِ بْنِ أَسْلَمَ، عَنْ أَبِيهِ، عَنْ عُمَرَ بْنِ الْخَطَّابِ رضي الله عنه، قَالَ:
entries.matn_ar: " وَاللَّهِ لَوْلَا أَنْ يُتْرَكَ آخِرُ النَّاسِ بَبَّانًا، لَيْسَ لَهُمْ شَيْءٌ، مَا فَتَحَ اللَّهُ عز وجل عَلَى الْمُسْلِمِينَ قَرْيَةً إِلَّا قَسَمْتُهَا سِهَامًا، كَمَا قُسِمَتْ خَيْبَرُ "
entries.isnad_en: Isma'il informed us. He said: al-Hasan narrated to us. He said: Yahya narrated to us. He said: Ibn al-Mubarak narrated to us, from Hisham b. Sa'd, from Zayd b. Aslam, from his father, from 'Umar b. al-Khattab (r), who said:
entries.matn_en: By God, were it not that the last of the people would be left babban (all alike, with nothing), with nothing for them, God, mighty and majestic, would not have opened for the Muslims any village but I would have divided it into shares, as Khaybar was divided.

entries.label: Narration
entries.isnad_ar: أَخْبَرَنَا إِسْمَاعِيلُ، قَالَ: حَدَّثَنَا الْحَسَنُ، قَالَ: حَدَّثَنَا يَحْيَى، قَالَ: حَدَّثَنَا عَبْدُ اللَّهِ بْنُ إِدْرِيسَ، عَنْ مَالِكِ بْنِ أَنَسٍ، عَنْ زَيْدِ بْنِ أَسْلَمَ، عَنْ أَسْلَمَ، عَنْ عُمَرَ نَحْوَهُ، قَالَ:
entries.matn_ar: " لَوْلَا أَنْ يُتْرَكَ آخِرُ النَّاسِ لَا شَيْءَ لَهُمْ، مَا فَتَحَ اللَّهُ عَلَى الْمُسْلِمِينَ قَرْيَةً إِلَّا قَسَمْتُهَا سُهْمَانًا، كَمَا قُسِمَتْ خَيْبَرُ سُهْمَانًا، وَلَكِنِّي أَخْشَى أَنْ يَبْقَى آخِرُ النَّاسِ لَا شَيْءَ لَهُمْ "
entries.isnad_en: Isma'il informed us. He said: al-Hasan narrated to us. He said: Yahya narrated to us. He said: 'Abd Allah b. Idris narrated to us, from Malik b. Anas, from Zayd b. Aslam, from Aslam, from 'Umar, similarly. He said:
entries.matn_en: Were it not that the last of the people would be left with nothing, God would not have opened for the Muslims any village but I would have divided it into shares, as Khaybar was divided into shares; but I fear that the last of the people will remain with nothing.

entries.label: Narration
entries.isnad_ar: أَخْبَرَنَا إِسْمَاعِيلُ، قَالَ: حَدَّثَنَا الْحَسَنُ، قَالَ: حَدَّثَنَا يَحْيَى، قَالَ: حَدَّثَنَا ⦗ص: 43⦘ عَبْدُ اللَّهِ بْنُ إِدْرِيسَ، عَنْ حُصَيْنٍ، عَنْ سَالِمِ بْنِ أَبِي الْجَعْدِ، قَالَ:
entries.matn_ar: قُلْنَا لِجَابِرِ بْنِ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ: كَمْ كُنْتُمْ يَوْمَ الْحُدَيْبِيَةِ؟ قَالَ: " خَمْسَ عَشْرَةَ مِائَةٍ "
entries.isnad_en: Isma'il informed us. He said: al-Hasan narrated to us. He said: Yahya narrated to us. He said: [p. 43] 'Abd Allah b. Idris narrated to us, from Husayn, from Salim b. Abi al-Ja'd, who said:
entries.matn_en: We said to Jabir b. 'Abd Allah: How many were you on the day of al-Hudaybiya? He said: Fifteen hundred.

entries.label: Narration
entries.isnad_ar: أَخْبَرَنَا إِسْمَاعِيلُ، قَالَ: حَدَّثَنَا الْحَسَنُ، قَالَ: حَدَّثَنَا يَحْيَى، قَالَ: حَدَّثَنَا عَبْدُ السَّلَامِ بْنُ حَرْبٍ، عَنْ إِسْمَاعِيلَ بْنِ أَبِي خَالِدٍ، عَنْ قَيْسِ بْنِ أَبِي حَازِمٍ، قَالَ:
entries.matn_ar: أَعْطَى عُمَرُ جَرِيرًا وَقَوْمَهُ رُبُعَ السَّوَادِ فَأَخَذَهُ سَنَتَيْنِ أَوْ ثَلَاثًا، ثُمَّ إِنَّ جَرِيرًا وَفَدَ إِلَى عُمَرَ مَعَ عَمَّارٍ، فَقَالَ لَهُ عُمَرُ: " يَا جَرِيرُ ، لَوْلَا أَنِّي قَاسِمٌ مَسْئُولٌ لَكُنْتُمْ عَلَى مَا كُنْتُمْ عَلَيْهِ، وَلَكِنِّي أَرَى أَنْ تَرُدَّهُ عَلَى الْمُسْلِمِينَ "، فَرَدَّهُ عَلَيْهِمْ، وَأَعْطَاهُمْ عُمَرُ ثَمَانِينَ دِينَارًا
entries.isnad_en: Isma'il informed us. He said: al-Hasan narrated to us. He said: Yahya narrated to us. He said: 'Abd al-Salam b. Harb narrated to us, from Isma'il b. Abi Khalid, from Qays b. Abi Hazim, who said:
entries.matn_en: 'Umar gave Jarir and his people a quarter of the Sawad, and he took it for two or three years. Then Jarir came as a delegate to 'Umar with 'Ammar, and 'Umar said to him: O Jarir, were it not that I am a divider who will be questioned, you would remain as you were; but I think you should return it to the Muslims. So he returned it to them, and 'Umar gave them eighty dinars.

entries.label: Narration
entries.isnad_ar: حَدَّثَنَا ابْنُ أَبِي زَائِدَةَ، عَنْ إِسْمَاعِيلَ بْنِ أَبِي خَالِدٍ، عَنْ قَيْسِ بْنِ أَبِي حَازِمٍ، قَالَ:
entries.matn_ar: كُنَّا رُبُعَ النَّاسِ يَوْمَ الْقَادِسِيَّةِ، فَأَعْطَانَا عُمَرُ رُبُعَ السَّوَادِ، فَأَخَذْنَاهُ ثَلَاثَ سِنِينَ ، ثُمَّ وَفَدَ جَرِيرٌ إِلَى عُمَرَ بَعْدَ ذَلِكَ، فَقَالَ: " أَمَا وَاللَّهِ لَوْلَا أَنِّي قَاسِمٌ مَسْئُولٌ ، لَكُنْتُمْ عَلَى مَا قُسِمَ لَكُمْ، فَأَرَى أَنْ تَرُدَّهُ عَلَى الْمُسْلِمِينَ "، فَفَعَلَ فَأَجَازَهُ بِثَمَانِينَ دِينَارًا
entries.isnad_en: Ibn Abi Za'ida narrated to us, from Isma'il b. Abi Khalid, from Qays b. Abi Hazim, who said:
entries.matn_en: We were a quarter of the people on the day of al-Qadisiyya, so 'Umar gave us a quarter of the Sawad, and we took it for three years. Then Jarir came as a delegate to 'Umar after that, and he said: By God, were it not that I am a divider who will be questioned, you would remain with what was apportioned to you; but I think you should return it to the Muslims. So he did, and he rewarded him with eighty dinars.

entries.label: Narration
entries.isnad_ar: أَخْبَرَنَا إِسْمَاعِيلُ، قَالَ: حَدَّثَنَا الْحَسَنُ، قَالَ: حَدَّثَنَا يَحْيَى، قَالَ: حَدَّثَنَا ابْنُ مُبَارَكٍ، عَنْ حَمَّادِ بْنِ سَلَمَةَ، عَنْ دَاوُدَ بْنِ أَبِي هِنْدَ، عَنِ الشَّعْبِيِّ، قَالَ:
entries.matn_ar: قَالَ عُمَرُ رضي الله عنه لِجَرِيرٍ: " هَلْ لَكَ أَنْ تَأْتِيَ الْعِرَاقَ وَلَكَ الرُّبُعُ ، أَوِ الثُّلُثُ بَعْدَ الْخُمُسِ مِنْ كُلِّ أَرْضٍ وَشَيْءٍ؟ "
entries.isnad_en: Isma'il informed us. He said: al-Hasan narrated to us. He said: Yahya narrated to us. He said: Ibn Mubarak narrated to us, from Hammad b. Salama, from Dawud b. Abi Hind, from al-Sha'bi, who said: 'Umar (r) said to Jarir:
entries.matn_en: Would you come to Iraq, and you shall have the quarter, or the third, after the fifth, of every land and thing?

entries.label: Narration
entries.isnad_ar: أَخْبَرَنَا إِسْمَاعِيلُ، قَالَ: حَدَّثَنَا الْحَسَنُ، قَالَ: حَدَّثَنَا يَحْيَى، قَالَ: حَدَّثَنَا ⦗ص: 44⦘ ابْنُ مُبَارَكٍ، عَنْ إِسْمَاعِيلَ بْنِ أَبِي خَالِدٍ، عَنْ قَيْسِ بْنِ أَبِي حَازِمٍ،
entries.matn_ar: أَنَّ عُمَرَ رضي الله عنه، أَعْطَى بَجِيلَةَ رُبُعَ السَّوَادِ فَأَخَذُوهُ سَنَتَيْنِ، ثُمَّ وَفَدَ جَرِيرٌ إِلَى عُمَرَ رضي الله عنه ، فَقَالَ: لَوْلَا " أَنِّي قَاسِمٌ مَسْئُولٌ لَكُنْتُمْ عَلَى مَا قُسِمَ لَكُمْ، فَأَرَى أَنْ تَرُدَّهُ "، فَرَدَّهُ ، وَأَجَازَهُ بِثَمَانِينَ دِينَارًا "
entries.isnad_en: Isma'il informed us. He said: al-Hasan narrated to us. He said: Yahya narrated to us. He said: [p. 44] Ibn Mubarak narrated to us, from Isma'il b. Abi Khalid, from Qays b. Abi Hazim,
entries.matn_en: that 'Umar (r) gave Bajila a quarter of the Sawad and they took it for two years. Then Jarir went as a delegate to 'Umar (r), who said: Were it not that I am a divider who will be questioned, you would remain with what was apportioned to you; but I think you should return it. So he returned it, and 'Umar rewarded him with eighty dinars.

entries.label: Narration
entries.isnad_ar: أَخْبَرَنَا إِسْمَاعِيلُ، قَالَ: حَدَّثَنَا الْحَسَنُ، قَالَ: حَدَّثَنَا يَحْيَى، قَالَ: حَدَّثَنَا عَمْروُ بْنُ أَبِي الْمِقْدَامِ، عَنْ حَبِيبِ بْنِ أَبِي ثَابِتٍ، عَنْ ثَعْلَبَةَ بْنِ يَزِيدَ الْحِمَّانِيِّ، عَنْ عَلِيٍّ عليه السلام، قَالَ:
entries.matn_ar: " أَيُّهَا النَّاسُ أَعِينُوا عَلَى أَنْفُسِكُمْ، فَإِنَّ السَّبْعَةَ - أَوْ قَالَ: - التِّسْعَةَ يَكُونُونَ فِي الْقَرْيَةِ ، فَيُحْيُونَهَا بِإِذْنِ اللَّهِ عز وجل، وَلَوْلَا أَنْ يَضْرِبَ بَعْضُكُمْ وُجُوهَ بَعْضٍ لَقَسَمْتُ هَذَا السَّوَادَ بَيْنَكُمْ "
entries.isnad_en: Isma'il informed us. He said: al-Hasan narrated to us. He said: Yahya narrated to us. He said: 'Amr b. Abi al-Miqdam narrated to us, from Habib b. Abi Thabit, from Tha'laba b. Yazid al-Himmani, from 'Ali (a), who said:
entries.matn_en: O people, help against yourselves, for the seven—or he said: the nine—who are in a village revive it by the permission of God, mighty and majestic; and were it not that some of you would strike the faces of others, I would divide this Sawad among you.

entries.label: Narration
entries.isnad_ar: أَخْبَرَنَا إِسْمَاعِيلُ، قَالَ: حَدَّثَنَا الْحَسَنُ، قَالَ: حَدَّثَنَا يَحْيَى، قَالَ: حَدَّثَنَا قَيْسُ بْنُ الرَّبِيعِ، عَنْ حَبِيبِ بْنِ أَبِي ثَابِتٍ، عَنْ ثَعْلَبَةَ الْحِمَّانِيِّ، قَالَ:
entries.matn_ar: دَخَلْنَا عَلَى عَلِيٍّ رضي الله عنه بِالرَّحْبَةِ، فَقَالَ: " لَوْلَا أَنْ يَضْرِبَ بَعْضُكُمْ وُجُوهَ بَعْضٍ لَقَسَمْتُ هَذَا السَّوَادَ بَيْنَكُمْ "
entries.isnad_en: Isma'il informed us. He said: al-Hasan narrated to us. He said: Yahya narrated to us. He said: Qays b. al-Rabi' narrated to us, from Habib b. Abi Thabit, from Tha'laba al-Himmani, who said:
entries.matn_en: We went in to 'Ali (r) at al-Rahba, and he said: Were it not that some of you would strike the faces of others, I would divide this Sawad among you.

entries.label: Narration
entries.isnad_ar: أَخْبَرَنَا إِسْمَاعِيلُ، قَالَ: حَدَّثَنَا الْحَسَنُ، قَالَ: حَدَّثَنَا يَحْيَى، قَالَ: حَدَّثَنَا شَرِيكٌ، عَنِ الْأَجْلَحِ، عَنْ حَبِيبٍ، عَنْ ثَعْلَبَةَ، عَنْ عَلِيٍّ عليه السلام، قَالَ:
entries.matn_ar: " لَوْلَا أَنْ يَضْرِبَ بَعْضُكُمْ وُجُوهَ بَعْضٍ لَقَسَمْتُ هَذَا السَّوَادَ بَيْنَكُمْ "
entries.isnad_en: Isma'il informed us. He said: al-Hasan narrated to us. He said: Yahya narrated to us. He said: Sharik narrated to us, from al-Ajlah, from Habib, from Tha'laba, from 'Ali (a), who said:
entries.matn_en: Were it not that some of you would strike the faces of others, I would divide this Sawad among you.

entries.label: Narration
entries.isnad_ar: أَخْبَرَنَا إِسْمَاعِيلُ، قَالَ: حَدَّثَنَا الْحَسَنُ، قَالَ: حَدَّثَنَا يَحْيَى، قَالَ: عَنْ قُرَّانٍ الْأَسَدِيِّ، عَنْ أَبِي سِنَانٍ الشَّيْبَانِيِّ، عَنْ عَمِيرَةَ، عَنْ عَلِيٍّ عليه السلام، قَالَ:
entries.matn_ar: " لَقَدْ هَمَمْتُ أَنْ أَقْسِمَ السَّوَادَ، يَنْزِلُ أَحَدُكُمُ الْقَرْيَةَ فَيَقُولُ: لِتَكْفُونِي - أَوْ قَالَ: - لِتَدَعُونِي وَإِلَّا ، قَسَمْتُهُ "
entries.isnad_en: Isma'il informed us. He said: al-Hasan narrated to us. He said: Yahya narrated to us. He said: [narrating] from Qurran al-Asadi, from Abu Sinan al-Shaybani, from 'Amira, from 'Ali (a), who said:
entries.matn_en: I was on the verge of dividing the Sawad. One of you settles in a village and says: Spare me [the burden]—or he said: Leave me alone—or else I will divide it.

entries.label: Narration
entries.isnad_ar: أَخْبَرَنَا إِسْمَاعِيلُ، قَالَ: حَدَّثَنَا الْحَسَنُ، قَالَ: حَدَّثَنَا يَحْيَى، قَالَ: حَدَّثَنَا ⦗ص: 45⦘ أَبُو بَكْرٍ، عَنِ الْأَجْلَحِ، عَنْ حَبِيبِ بْنِ أَبِي ثَابِتٍ، عَنْ ثَعْلَبَةَ بْنِ يَزِيدَ، عَنْ عَلِيٍّ عليه السلام، قَالَ:
entries.matn_ar: " لَوْلَا أَنْ يَضْرِبَ بَعْضُكُمْ وُجُوهَ بَعْضٍ لَقَسَمْتُ السَّوَادَ بَيْنَكُمْ "، قَالَ: وَشَكَا أَهْلُ السَّوَادِ إِلَى عَلِيٍّ عليه السلام ، فَبَعَثَ مِائَةَ فَارِسٍ ، فِيهِمْ ثَعْلَبَةُ بْنُ يَزِيدَ الْحِمَّانِيُّ، فَلَمَّا رَجَعَ ثَعْلَبَةُ، قَالَ فِي مَسْجِدِ بَنِي حِمَّانَ: " لِلَّهِ عَلَيَّ أَنْ لَا أَرْجِعَ إِلَى السَّوَادِ، مِمَّا رَأَى فِيهِ مِنَ الشَّرِّ "
entries.isnad_en: Isma'il informed us. He said: al-Hasan narrated to us. He said: Yahya narrated to us. He said: [p. 45] Abu Bakr narrated to us, from al-Ajlah, from Habib b. Abi Thabit, from Tha'laba b. Yazid, from 'Ali (a), who said:
entries.matn_en: Were it not that some of you would strike the faces of others, I would divide the Sawad among you. He said: And the people of the Sawad complained to 'Ali (a), so he sent a hundred horsemen, among them Tha'laba b. Yazid al-Himmani. When Tha'laba returned, he said in the mosque of Banu Himman: I vow to God that I will not return to the Sawad, because of the evil he saw in it.

entries.label: Narration
entries.isnad_ar: أَخْبَرَنَا إِسْمَاعِيلُ، قَالَ: حَدَّثَنَا الْحَسَنُ، قَالَ: حَدَّثَنَا يَحْيَى، قَالَ: حَدَّثَنَا ابْنُ مُبَارَكٍ، عَنْ سُفْيَانَ بْنِ سَعِيدٍ، قَالَ:
entries.matn_ar: " إِذَا ظَهَرَ عَلَى بِلَادِ الْعَدُوِّ ، فَالْإِمَامُ بِالْخِيَارِ، إِنْ شَاءَ قَسَمَ الْبِلَادَ وَالْأَمْوَالَ وَالسَّبْيَ، بَعْدَ مَا يُخْرِجُ الْخُمُسَ مِنْ ذَلِكَ، وَإِنْ شَاءَ مَنَّ عَلَيْهِمْ، فَتَرَكَ الْأَرْضَ وَالْأَمْوَالَ، وَكَانُوا ذِمَّةً لِلْمُسْلِمِينَ، كَمَا صَنَعَ عُمَرُ بْنُ الْخَطَّابِ رضي الله عنه، بِأَهْلِ السَّوَادِ، فَإِنْ تَرَكَهُمْ صَارُوا عَهْدًا يَتَوَارَثُونَ ، وَبَاعُوا أَرَضِيهِمْ ". قَالَ يَحْيَى: وَسَمِعْتُ حَفْصَ بْنَ غِيَاثٍ، يَقُولُ: تُبَاعُ وَيُقْضَى بِهَا الدَّيْنُ ، وَتُقْسَمُ فِي الْمَوَارِيثِ
entries.isnad_en: Isma'il informed us. He said: al-Hasan narrated to us. He said: Yahya narrated to us. He said: Ibn Mubarak narrated to us, from Sufyan b. Sa'id, who said:
entries.matn_en: When he prevails over the lands of the enemy, the imam has the choice: if he wishes he divides the lands, the property and the captives, after taking out the fifth of that; and if he wishes he shows them favor (manna 'alayhim), leaving the land and the property, and they become a dhimma for the Muslims, as 'Umar b. al-Khattab (r) did with the people of the Sawad. If he leaves them, they become people of a covenant who inherit from one another, and they sell their lands. Yahya said: And I heard Hafs b. Ghiyath say: They are sold and debts are paid with them, and they are divided in inheritances.

entries.label: Narration
entries.isnad_ar: أَخْبَرَنَا إِسْمَاعِيلُ، قَالَ: حَدَّثَنَا الْحَسَنُ، قَالَ: حَدَّثَنَا يَحْيَى، قَالَ: حَدَّثَنَا ابْنُ مُبَارَكٍ، عَنْ أَبِي حَنِيفَةَ،
entries.matn_ar: مِثْلَ مَعْنَى حَدِيثِ سُفْيَانَ
entries.isnad_en: Isma'il informed us. He said: al-Hasan narrated to us. He said: Yahya narrated to us. He said: Ibn Mubarak narrated to us, from Abu Hanifa,
entries.matn_en: similar in meaning to the hadith of Sufyan.

entries.label: Narration
entries.isnad_ar: أَخْبَرَنَا إِسْمَاعِيلُ، قَالَ: حَدَّثَنَا الْحَسَنُ، قَالَ: حَدَّثَنَا يَحْيَى، قَالَ: حَدَّثَنَا سُفْيَانُ بْنُ عُيَيْنَةَ، عَنِ ابْنِ أَبِي نَجِيحٍ، عَنْ مُجَاهِدٍ، قَالَ:
entries.matn_ar: " أَيُّمَا مَدِينَةٍ أُخِذَتْ عَنْوَةً، فَأَسْلَمَ أَهْلُهَا قَبْلَ أَنْ يَقْتَسِمُوا، فَهُمْ أَحْرَارٌ ، وَأَمْوَالُهُمْ لِلْمُسْلِمِينَ ". وَسَمِعْتُ سُفْيَانَ يَشُكُّ فِي بَعْضِ هَذَا الْحَدِيثِ مَرَّةً
entries.isnad_en: Isma'il informed us. He said: al-Hasan narrated to us. He said: Yahya narrated to us. He said: Sufyan b. 'Uyayna narrated to us, from Ibn Abi Najih, from Mujahid, who said:
entries.matn_en: Any city taken by force whose people become Muslim before they divide it, they are free and their property belongs to the Muslims. And I heard Sufyan express doubt about some of this hadith on one occasion.

entries.label: Narration
entries.isnad_ar: أَخْبَرَنَا إِسْمَاعِيلُ، قَالَ: حَدَّثَنَا الْحَسَنُ، قَالَ: حَدَّثَنَا يَحْيَى، قَالَ: حَدَّثَنَا ابْنُ مُبَارَكٍ، عَنِ ابْنِ لَهِيعَةَ، عَنْ يَزِيدَ بْنِ أَبِي حَبِيبٍ، قَالَ: كَتَبَ عُمَرُ إِلَى سَعْدٍ حِينَ افْتَتَحَ الْعِرَاقَ: "
entries.matn_ar: أَمَّا بَعْدُ: فَقَدْ بَلَغَنِي كِتَابُكَ تَذْكُرُ أَنَّ النَّاسَ سَأَلُوكَ أَنْ تَقْسِمَ بَيْنَهُمْ مَغَانِمَهُمْ، وَمَا أَفَاءَ اللَّهُ عَلَيْهِمْ، فَإِذَا جَاءَكَ كِتَابِي هَذَا فَانْظُرْ مَا أَجْلَبَ النَّاسُ عَلَيْكَ إِلَى الْعَسْكَرِ مِنْ كُرَاعٍ أَوْ مَالٍ، فَاقْسِمْهُ بَيْنَ مَنْ حَضَرَ مِنَ الْمُسْلِمِينَ، وَاتْرُكِ الْأَرَضِينَ وَالْأَنْهَارَ ⦗ص: 46⦘ لِعُمَّالِهَا، لِيَكُونَ ذَلِكَ فِي أُعْطِيَاتِ الْمُسْلِمِينَ، فَإِنَّكَ إِنْ قَسَمْتَهَا بَيْنَ مَنْ حَضَرَ، لَمْ يَكُنْ لِمَنْ بَقِيَ بَعْدَهُمْ شَيْءٌ، وَقَدْ كُنْتُ أَمَرْتُكَ أَنْ تَدْعُوَ النَّاسَ ثَلَاثَةَ أَيَّامٍ، فَمَنِ اسْتَجَابَ لَكَ ، وَأَسْلَمَ قَبْلَ الْقِتَالِ، فَهُوَ رَجُلٌ مِنَ الْمُسْلِمِينَ ، لَهُ مَا لَهُمْ ، وَلَهُ سَهْمٌ فِي الْإِسْلَامِ، وَمَنِ اسْتَجَابَ لَكَ بَعْدَ الْقِتَالِ ، وَبَعْدَ الْهَزِيمَةِ، فَهُوَ رَجُلٌ مِنَ الْمُسْلِمِينَ، وَمَالُهُ لِأَهْلِ الْإِسْلَامِ؛ لِأَنَّهُمْ قَدْ أَحْرَزُوهُ قَبْلَ إِسْلَامِهِ، فَهَذَا أَمْرِي، وَعَهْدِي إِلَيْكَ، وَلَا عُشُورَ عَلَى مُسْلِمٍ، وَلَا عَلَى صَاحِبِ ذِمَّةٍ، إِذَا أَدَّى الْمُسْلِمُ زَكَاةَ مَالِهِ، وَأَدَّى صَاحِبُ الذِّمَّةِ جِزْيَتَهُ الَّتِي صَالَحَ عَلَيْهَا، إِنَّمَا الْعُشُورُ عَلَى أَهْلِ الْحَرْبِ، إِذَا اسْتَأْذَنُوا أَنْ يَتَّجِرُوا فِي أَرْضِنَا، فَأُولَئِكَ عَلَيْهِمُ الْعُشُورُ "
entries.isnad_en: Isma'il informed us. He said: al-Hasan narrated to us. He said: Yahya narrated to us. He said: Ibn Mubarak narrated to us, from Ibn Lahi'a, from Yazid b. Abi Habib, who said:
entries.matn_en: 'Umar wrote to Sa'd when he conquered Iraq: To proceed: Your letter has reached me, mentioning that the people asked you to divide among them their spoils and what God bestowed upon them. So when this letter of mine comes to you, look at what the people brought to the camp of mounts or property, and divide it among those of the Muslims who are present, and leave the lands and rivers [p. 46] to their cultivators ('ummal), so that that may be for the stipends (a'tiyat) of the Muslims; for if you divide them among those present, nothing will remain for those who come after them. I had ordered you to call the people for three days; whoever responds to you and becomes Muslim before the fighting is a man of the Muslims, has what they have, and has a share in Islam; and whoever responds to you after the fighting and after the defeat is a man of the Muslims, but his property belongs to the people of Islam, because they had secured it before his Islam. This is my command and my charge to you. There are no 'ushur (tolls) on a Muslim or on a dhimmi, when the Muslim has paid the zakat of his property and the dhimmi has paid his jizya upon which he made treaty. The 'ushur are only upon the people of war, when they ask permission to trade in our land; those are the ones upon whom the 'ushur fall.

entries.label: Narration
entries.isnad_ar: أَخْبَرَنَا إِسْمَاعِيلُ، قَالَ: حَدَّثَنَا الْحَسَنُ، قَالَ: حَدَّثَنَا يَحْيَى، قَالَ: حَدَّثَنَا ابْنُ مُبَارَكٍ، عَنْ مُحَمَّدِ بْنِ يَسَارٍ، قَالَ: سَمِعْتُ الضَّحَّاكَ يَقُولُ:
entries.matn_ar: " أَيُّمَا حِصْنٍ أَعْطَوْا فِدْيَةً مِنْ غَيْرِ قِتَالٍ - وَإِنْ كَانُوا قَدْ نَظَرُوا إِلَى الْجَيْشِ - فَهُوَ بَيْنَ جَمِيعِ الْمُسْلِمِينَ، يَقُولُ: لِأَنَّهُ فَيْءٌ "
entries.isnad_en: Isma'il informed us. He said: al-Hasan narrated to us. He said: Yahya narrated to us. He said: Ibn Mubarak narrated to us, from Muhammad b. Yasar, who said: I heard al-Dahhak say:
entries.matn_en: Any fortress whose people give a ransom (fidya) without fighting—even if they had looked upon the army—belongs among all the Muslims; he says: because it is fay'.

entries.label: Narration
entries.isnad_ar: أَخْبَرَنَا إِسْمَاعِيلُ، قَالَ: حَدَّثَنَا الْحَسَنُ، قَالَ: حَدَّثَنَا يَحْيَى، قَالَ: حَدَّثَنَا شَرِيكٌ، عَنْ جَابِرٍ، عَنْ عَامِرٍ، قَالَ:
entries.matn_ar: " لَيْسَ لِأَهْلِ السَّوَادِ عَهْدٌ".
entries.isnad_en: Isma'il informed us. He said: al-Hasan narrated to us. He said: Yahya narrated to us. He said: Sharik narrated to us, from Jabir, from 'Amir, who said:
entries.matn_en: There is no covenant for the people of the Sawad.

entries.label: Narration
entries.isnad_ar: أَخْبَرَنَا إِسْمَاعِيلُ، قَالَ: حَدَّثَنَا الْحَسَنُ، قَالَ: حَدَّثَنَا يَحْيَى، قَالَ: حَدَّثَنَا شَرِيكٌ وَكَانَ عَامِرٌ مِنْ أَخْبَرِ النَّاسِ،
entries.matn_ar: بِهَذِهِ الْأُمُورِ
entries.isnad_en: Isma'il informed us. He said: al-Hasan narrated to us. He said: Yahya narrated to us. He said: Sharik narrated to us, [saying:]
entries.matn_en: 'Amir was one of the best informed of people about these matters.

entries.label: Narration
entries.isnad_ar: أَخْبَرَنَا إِسْمَاعِيلُ، قَالَ: حَدَّثَنَا الْحَسَنُ، قَالَ: حَدَّثَنَا يَحْيَى، قَالَ: حَدَّثَنَا إِسْرَائِيلُ، عَنْ جَابِرٍ، عَنْ عَامِرٍ، قَالَ:
entries.matn_ar: " لَيْسَ لِأَهْلِ السَّوَادِ عَهْدٌ، إِنَّمَا نَزَلُوا عَلَى حُكْمٍ "
entries.isnad_en: Isma'il informed us. He said: al-Hasan narrated to us. He said: Yahya narrated to us. He said: Isra'il narrated to us, from Jabir, from 'Amir, who said:
entries.matn_en: There is no covenant for the people of the Sawad; they submitted only to a ruling (hukm).

entries.label: Narration
entries.isnad_ar: أَخْبَرَنَا إِسْمَاعِيلُ، قَالَ: حَدَّثَنَا الْحَسَنُ، قَالَ: حَدَّثَنَا يَحْيَى، قَالَ: ⦗ص: 47⦘ حَدَّثَنَا الصَّلْتُ بْنُ عَبْدِ الرَّحْمَنِ الزُّبَيْدِيُّ، عَنْ مُحَمَّدِ بْنِ قَيْسٍ الْأَسَدِيِّ، عَنِ الشَّعْبِيِّ،
entries.matn_ar: أَنَّهُ سُئِلَ فِي زَمَنِ عُمَرَ بْنِ عَبْدِ الْعَزِيزِ عَنْ أَهْلِ السَّوَادِ، أَلَهُمْ عَهْدٌ؟ فَقَالَ: " لَمْ يَكُنْ لَهُمْ عَهْدٌ، فَلَمَّا رُضِيَ مِنْهُمْ بِالْخَرَاجِ صَارَ لَهُمْ عَهْدٌ".
entries.isnad_en: Isma'il informed us. He said: al-Hasan narrated to us. He said: Yahya narrated to us. He said: [p. 47] al-Salt b. 'Abd al-Rahman al-Zubaydi narrated to us, from Muhammad b. Qays al-Asadi, from al-Sha'bi,
entries.matn_en: that he was asked in the time of 'Umar b. 'Abd al-'Aziz about the people of the Sawad: Do they have a covenant? He said: They had no covenant; when the kharaj was accepted from them, they came to have a covenant.

entries.label: Narration
entries.matn_ar: أَخْبَرَنَا إِسْمَاعِيلُ، قَالَ: حَدَّثَنَا الْحَسَنُ، قَالَ: حَدَّثَنَا يَحْيَى، قَالَ: حَدَّثَنَا حَاتِمُ بْنُ إِسْمَاعِيلَ، وَغَيْرُهُ مِنْ أَصْحَابِنَا، عَنْ مُحَمَّدِ بْنِ قَيْسٍ، عَنِ الشَّعْبِيِّ مِثْلَهُ
entries.isnad_en: Isma'il informed us. He said: al-Hasan narrated to us. He said: Yahya narrated to us. He said: Hatim b. Isma'il, and another of our companions, narrated to us, from Muhammad b. Qays, from al-Sha'bi,
entries.matn_en: the like of it.

entries.label: Narration
entries.isnad_ar: أَخْبَرَنَا إِسْمَاعِيلُ، قَالَ: حَدَّثَنَا الْحَسَنُ، قَالَ: حَدَّثَنَا يَحْيَى، قَالَ: حَدَّثَنَا حَسَنُ بْنُ صَالِحٍ، عَنِ ابْنِ أَبِي لَيْلَى، قَالَ:
entries.matn_ar: " قَدْ رَدَّ إِلَيْهِمْ عُمَرُ بْنُ الْخَطَّابِ رضي الله عنه أَرَضِيهِمْ ، وَصَالَحَهُمْ عَلَى الْخَرَاجِ "
entries.isnad_en: Isma'il informed us. He said: al-Hasan narrated to us. He said: Yahya narrated to us. He said: Hasan b. Salih narrated to us, from Ibn Abi Layla, who said:
entries.matn_en: 'Umar b. al-Khattab (r) returned their lands to them and reconciled them on the kharaj.

entries.label: Narration
entries.isnad_ar: أَخْبَرَنَا إِسْمَاعِيلُ، قَالَ: حَدَّثَنَا الْحَسَنُ، قَالَ: حَدَّثَنَا يَحْيَى، قَالَ: حَدَّثَنَا حَفْصُ بْنُ غِيَاثٍ، عَنِ ابْنِ أَبِي ذِئْبٍ، عَنِ الزُّهْرِيِّ، قَالَ:
entries.matn_ar: " قَضَى رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم فِيمَنْ أَسْلَمَ مِنْ أَهْلِ الْبَحْرَيْنِ أَنَّهُ قَدْ أَحْرَزَ دَمَهُ وَمَالَهُ، إِلَّا أَرْضَهُ ، فَإِنَّهَا فَيْءٌ لِلْمُسْلِمِينَ؛ لِأَنَّهُمْ لَمْ يُسْلِمُوا وَهُمْ مُمْتَنِعُونَ "
entries.isnad_en: Isma'il informed us. He said: al-Hasan narrated to us. He said: Yahya narrated to us. He said: Hafs b. Ghiyath narrated to us, from Ibn Abi Dhi'b, from al-Zuhri, who said:
entries.matn_en: The Messenger of God ﷺ ruled concerning whoever of the people of al-Bahrayn became Muslim that he has secured his blood and his property, except his land, for it is fay' for the Muslims, because they did not become Muslim while they were holding out (mumtani'un).

entries.label: Narration
entries.isnad_ar: أَخْبَرَنَا إِسْمَاعِيلُ، قَالَ: حَدَّثَنَا الْحَسَنُ، قَالَ: حَدَّثَنَا يَحْيَى، قَالَ: حَدَّثَنَا إِسْمَاعِيلُ بْنُ عَيَّاشٍ - أَحْسَبُهُ -، عَنْ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ الْبَهْرَانِيِّ، عَنْ عُمَرَ بْنِ عَبْدِ الْعَزِيزِ، قَالَ:
entries.matn_ar: " مَنْ أَسْلَمَ مِنْ أَهْلِ الْأَرْضِ فَلَهُ مَا أَسْلَمَ عَلَيْهِ مِنْ أَهْلٍ أَوْ مَالٍ، فَأَمَّا دَارُهُ وَأَرْضُهُ فَإِنَّهَا كَائِنَةٌ فِي فَيْءِ اللَّهِ عز وجل عَلَى الْمُسْلِمِينَ "
entries.isnad_en: Isma'il informed us. He said: al-Hasan narrated to us. He said: Yahya narrated to us. He said: Isma'il b. 'Ayyash—I think—narrated to us, from 'Abd Allah al-Bahrani, from 'Umar b. 'Abd al-'Aziz, who said:
entries.matn_en: Whoever of the people of the land becomes Muslim has what he became Muslim upon of family or property; as for his house and his land, it is part of the fay' of God, mighty and majestic, for the Muslims.

entries.label: Narration
entries.isnad_ar: أَخْبَرَنَا إِسْمَاعِيلُ، قَالَ: حَدَّثَنَا الْحَسَنُ، قَالَ: حَدَّثَنَا يَحْيَى، قَالَ: حَدَّثَنِي مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ طَلْحَةَ بْنِ مُصَرِّفٍ الْيَامِيُّ، عَنْ مُحَمَّدِ بْنِ الْمُسَاوِرِ، عَنْ شَيْخٍ مِنْ قُرَيْشٍ، عَنْ ⦗ص: 48⦘ عُمَرَ بْنِ الْخَطَّابِ رضي الله عنه،
entries.matn_ar: أَنَّهُ أَتَاهُ رُؤَسَاءُ السَّوَادِ وَفِيهِمُ ابْنُ الرُّفَيْلِ فَقَالُوا: يَا أَمِيرَ الْمُؤْمِنِينَ، إِنَّا قَوْمٌ مِنْ أَهْلِ السَّوَادِ، وَكَانَ أَهْلُ فَارِسَ قَدْ ظَهَرُوا عَلَيْنَا ، وَأَضَرُّوا بِنَا، فَفَعَلُوا وَفَعَلُوا - حَتَّى ذَكَرُوا النِّسَاءَ - فَلَمَّا سَمِعْنَا بِكُمْ ، فَرِحْنَا بِكُمْ، وَأَعْجَبَنَا ذَلِكَ، فَلَمْ نُرِدْ كَفَّكُمْ عَنْ شَيْءٍ، حَتَّى أَخْرَجْتُمُوهُمْ عَنَّا، فَبَلَغَنَا أَنَّكُمْ تُرِيدُونَ أَنْ تَسْتَرِقُّونَا، فَقَالَ عُمَرُ: " فَالْآنَ إِنْ شِئْتُمْ فَالْإِسْلَامُ، وَإِنْ شِئْتُمْ فَالْجِزْيَةُ " فَاخْتَارُوا الْجِزْيَةَ
entries.isnad_en: Isma'il informed us. He said: al-Hasan narrated to us. He said: Yahya narrated to us. He said: Muhammad b. Talha b. Musarrif al-Yami narrated to me, from Muhammad b. al-Musawir, from a shaykh of Quraysh, from [p. 48] 'Umar b. al-Khattab (r),
entries.matn_en: that the chiefs of the Sawad came to him, among them Ibn al-Rufayl, and said: O Commander of the Faithful, we are a people of the Sawad. The people of Fars had prevailed over us and harmed us; they did this and that—until they mentioned the women. When we heard of you, we rejoiced in you, and that pleased us, and we did not want to hold you back from anything until you drove them out from us. Then it reached us that you want to enslave us. 'Umar said: So now, if you wish, Islam, and if you wish, the jizya. And they chose the jizya.

entries.label: Narration
entries.isnad_ar: أَخْبَرَنَا إِسْمَاعِيلُ، قَالَ: حَدَّثَنَا الْحَسَنُ، قَالَ: حَدَّثَنَا يَحْيَى، قَالَ: حَدَّثَنَا زُهَيْرُ بْنُ مُعَاوِيَةَ، عَنْ يَزِيدَ بْنِ أَبِي زِيَادٍ، عَنْ زَيْدِ بْنِ وَهْبٍ، عَنْ عُمَرَ بْنِ الْخَطَّابِ رضي الله عنه، أَنَّهُ قَالَ:
entries.matn_ar: " اتَّقُوا اللَّهَ فِي الْفَلَّاحِينَ، لَا تَقْتُلُوهُمْ ، إِلَّا أَنْ يَنْصِبُوا لَكُمُ الْحَرْبَ "
entries.isnad_en: Isma'il informed us. He said: al-Hasan narrated to us. He said: Yahya narrated to us. He said: Zuhayr b. Mu'awiya narrated to us, from Yazid b. Abi Ziyad, from Zayd b. Wahb, from 'Umar b. al-Khattab (r), that he said:
entries.matn_en: Fear God regarding the peasants (falalih); do not kill them, unless they set up war against you.

entries.label: Narration
entries.isnad_ar: أَخْبَرَنَا إِسْمَاعِيلُ، قَالَ: حَدَّثَنَا الْحَسَنُ، قَالَ: حَدَّثَنَا يَحْيَى، قَالَ: حَدَّثَنَا عَبْدُ الرَّحْمَنِ الْقَارِي، عَنْ أَشْعَثَ، عَنْ أَبِي الزُّبَيْرِ، عَنْ جَابِرٍ، قَالَ:
entries.matn_ar: " كَانُوا لَا يَقْتُلُونَ تُجَّارَ الْمُشْرِكِينَ "
entries.isnad_en: Isma'il informed us. He said: al-Hasan narrated to us. He said: Yahya narrated to us. He said: 'Abd al-Rahman al-Qari narrated to us, from Ash'ath, from Abu al-Zubayr, from Jabir, who said:
entries.matn_en: They did not kill the merchants of the polytheists.

entries.label: Narration
entries.isnad_ar: أَخْبَرَنَا إِسْمَاعِيلُ، قَالَ: حَدَّثَنَا الْحَسَنُ، قَالَ: حَدَّثَنَا يَحْيَى، قَالَ: حَدَّثَنِي أَبُو بَكْرِ بْنُ عَيَّاشٍ، عَنْ عَمْرِو بْنِ مَيْمُونٍ، عَنْ عُمَرَ بْنِ عَبْدِ الْعَزِيزِ، قَالَ:
entries.matn_ar: " لَا تَقْتُلُوا رَاهِبًا وَلَا أَكَّارًا "
entries.isnad_en: Isma'il informed us. He said: al-Hasan narrated to us. He said: Yahya narrated to us. He said: Abu Bakr b. 'Ayyash narrated to me, from 'Amr b. Maymun, from 'Umar b. 'Abd al-'Aziz, who said:
entries.matn_en: Do not kill a monk or a cultivator (akkar).

entries.label: Narration
entries.isnad_ar: أَخْبَرَنَا إِسْمَاعِيلُ، قَالَ: حَدَّثَنَا الْحَسَنُ، قَالَ: حَدَّثَنَا يَحْيَى، قَالَ: حَدَّثَنَا حَمَّادُ بْنُ زَيْدٍ، وَوُهَيْبُ بْنُ خَالِدٍ، عَنْ أَيُّوبَ السِّخْتِيَانِيِّ، عَنْ رَجُلٍ، عَنْ أَبِيهِ، قَالَ:
entries.matn_ar: " نَهَى رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم عَنْ قَتْلِ الْوُصَفَاءِ وَالْعُسَفَاءِ "
entries.isnad_en: Isma'il informed us. He said: al-Hasan narrated to us. He said: Yahya narrated to us. He said: Hammad b. Zayd and Wuhayb b. Khalid narrated to us, from Ayyub al-Sakhtiyani, from a man, from his father, who said:
entries.matn_en: The Messenger of God ﷺ forbade the killing of servants (wusafa') and hired laborers ('usafa').

entries.label: Narration
entries.isnad_ar: أَخْبَرَنَا إِسْمَاعِيلُ، قَالَ: حَدَّثَنَا الْحَسَنُ، قَالَ: حَدَّثَنَا يَحْيَى، قَالَ: حَدَّثَنِي الْحَسَنُ بْنُ صَالِحٍ، قَالَ: حَدَّثَنَا أَبُو عَلِيٍّ الصَّفَّارُ - أَظُنُّهُ - عَنْ مَنْصُورٍ، عَنْ عُبَيْدِ بْنِ أَبِي الْحَسَنِ، عَنْ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ بْنِ مُغَفَّلٍ الْمُزَنِيِّ، قَالَ:
entries.matn_ar: لَا يُبَاعُ أَرْضٌ دُونَ الْجَبَلِ ، إِلَّا أَرْضَ ⦗ص: 49⦘ بَنِي صَلُوبَا وَأَرْضَ الْحِيرَةِ فَإِنَّ لَهُمْ عَهْدًا "
entries.isnad_en: Isma'il informed us. He said: al-Hasan narrated to us. He said: Yahya narrated to us. He said: al-Hasan b. Salih narrated to me. He said: Abu 'Ali al-Saffar—I think—narrated to us, from Mansur, from 'Ubayd b. Abi al-Hasan, from 'Abd Allah b. Mughaffal al-Muzani, who said:
entries.matn_en: Land on this side of the mountain is not to be sold, except the land of Banu Saluba [p. 49] and the land of al-Hira, for they have a covenant.

entries.label: Narration
entries.isnad_ar: أَخْبَرَنَا إِسْمَاعِيلُ، قَالَ: حَدَّثَنَا الْحَسَنُ، قَالَ: حَدَّثَنَا يَحْيَى، قَالَ:
entries.matn_ar: كَانَ حَسَنُ بْنُ صَالِحٍ يَقُولُ: " كُنَّا نَسْمَعُ أَنَّ مَا دُونَ الْجَبَلِ فَيْءٌ، وَمَا وَرَاءَهُ صُلْحٌ "
entries.isnad_en: Isma'il informed us. He said: al-Hasan narrated to us. He said: Yahya narrated to us. He said:
entries.matn_en: Hasan b. Salih used to say: We used to hear that what is on this side of the mountain is fay', and what is beyond it is by treaty.

entries.label: Narration
entries.isnad_ar: أَخْبَرَنَا إِسْمَاعِيلُ، قَالَ: حَدَّثَنَا الْحَسَنُ، قَالَ: حَدَّثَنَا يَحْيَى، قَالَ: حَدَّثَنَا مُفَضَّلُ بْنُ مُهَلْهَلٍ، عَنْ مَنْصُورٍ، عَنْ عُبَيْدِ أَبِي الْحَسَنِ، عَنْ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ بْنِ مَعْقَلٍ الْمُزَنِيِّ، قَالَ:
entries.matn_ar: " لَا يَصْلُحُ بَيْعُ أَرْضِ مَا دُونَ الْجَبَلِ إِلَّا أَرْضُ بَنِي صَلُوبَا وَأَرْضُ الْحِيرَةِ "
entries.isnad_en: Isma'il informed us. He said: al-Hasan narrated to us. He said: Yahya narrated to us. He said: Mufaddal b. Muhalhil narrated to us, from Mansur, from 'Ubayd Abu al-Hasan, from 'Abd Allah b. Ma'qil al-Muzani, who said:
entries.matn_en: The sale of the land on this side of the mountain is not valid, except the land of Banu Saluba and the land of al-Hira.

entries.label: Narration
entries.isnad_ar: أَخْبَرَنَا إِسْمَاعِيلُ، قَالَ: حَدَّثَنَا الْحَسَنُ، قَالَ: حَدَّثَنَا يَحْيَى، قَالَ: حَدَّثَنَا شَرِيكٌ، عَنْ حَجَّاجٍ، عَنِ الْحَكَمِ، عَنِ ابْنِ مُغَفَّلٍ، قَالَ:
entries.matn_ar: " لَيْسَ لِأَهْلِ السَّوَادِ عَهْدٌ، إِلَّا أَهْلَ الْحِيرَةِ وَأُلَّيْسَ وَبَانِقْيَا ". قَالَ شَرِيكٌ: " إِنَّ أَهْلَ بَانِقْيَا كَانُوا دَلُّوا جَرِيرَ بْنَ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ عَلَى مَخَاضَةٍ - أَوْ قَالَ: مَخَاضَتَيْنِ - وَأَهْلُ أُلَّيْسَ كَانُوا أَنْزَلُوا أَبَا عُبَيْدَةَ وَدَلُّوهُ عَلَى شَيْءٍ. قَالَ يَحْيَى: أَظُنُّهُ يَعْنِي: عَوْرَةً لِلْعَدُوِّ "
entries.isnad_en: Isma'il informed us. He said: al-Hasan narrated to us. He said: Yahya narrated to us. He said: Sharik narrated to us, from Hajjaj, from al-Hakam, from Ibn Mughaffal, who said:
entries.matn_en: There is no covenant for the people of the Sawad, except the people of al-Hira, Ullays and Baniqya. Sharik said: The people of Baniqya had shown Jarir b. 'Abd Allah a ford—or he said: two fords—and the people of Ullays had lodged Abu 'Ubayda and shown him something. Yahya said: I think he means: a weak point ('awra) of the enemy.

entries.label: Narration
entries.isnad_ar: أَخْبَرَنَا إِسْمَاعِيلُ، قَالَ: حَدَّثَنَا الْحَسَنُ، قَالَ: حَدَّثَنَا يَحْيَى، قَالَ: حَدَّثَنَا حَسَنُ بْنُ صَالِحٍ، عَنْ جَابِرٍ، عَنِ الشَّعْبِيِّ، قَالَ:
entries.matn_ar: " لِأَهْلِ الْأَنْبَارِ عَهْدٌ - أَوْ قَالَ: - عَقْدٌ "
entries.isnad_en: Isma'il informed us. He said: al-Hasan narrated to us. He said: Yahya narrated to us. He said: Hasan b. Salih narrated to us, from Jabir, from al-Sha'bi, who said:
entries.matn_en: The people of al-Anbar have a covenant—or he said: a compact ('aqd).

entries.label: Narration
entries.isnad_ar: حَدَّثَنَا حَسَنُ بْنُ صَالِحٍ، عَنْ أَشْعَثَ، عَنِ الشَّعْبِيِّ، قَالَ:
entries.matn_ar: صَالَحَ خَالِدُ بْنُ الْوَلِيدِ أَهْلَ الْحِيرَةِ وَأَهْلَ عَيْنِ التَّمْرِ، قَالَ: وَكَتَبَ بِذَلِكَ إِلَى أَبِي بَكْرٍ رضي الله عنه ، فَأَجَازَهُ "
entries.isnad_en: Hasan b. Salih narrated to us, from Ash'ath, from al-Sha'bi, who said:
entries.matn_en: Khalid b. al-Walid made peace with the people of al-Hira and the people of 'Ayn al-Tamr. He said: And he wrote about that to Abu Bakr (r), who approved it.

entries.label: Narration
entries.matn_ar: قَالَ يَحْيَى: قُلْتُ لِلْحَسَنِ بْنِ صَالِحٍ: فَأَهْلُ عَيْنِ التَّمْرِ مِثْلُ أَهْلِ الْحِيرَةِ؟ إِنَّمَا هُوَ شَيْءٌ عَلَيْهِمْ، وَلَيْسَ أَرَضِيهِمْ؟ قَالَ: " نَعَمْ "
entries.isnad_en: Yahya said:
entries.matn_en: I said to al-Hasan b. Salih: Are the people of 'Ayn al-Tamr like the people of al-Hira? It is only something upon them, and not their lands? He said: Yes.

entries.label: Narration
entries.isnad_ar: أَخْبَرَنَا إِسْمَاعِيلُ، قَالَ: حَدَّثَنَا الْحَسَنُ، قَالَ: حَدَّثَنَا يَحْيَى، قَالَ: حَدَّثَنَا حَسَنُ بْنُ صَالِحٍ، عَنِ الْأَسْوَدِ بْنِ قَيْسٍ، عَنْ أَبِيهِ، قَالَ:
entries.matn_ar: " انْتَهَيْنَا إِلَى الْحِيرَةِ ، فَصَالَحْنَاهُمْ عَلَى أَلْفِ دِرْهَمٍ وَرَحْلٍ "، قَالَ: قُلْتُ لِأَبِي: مَا صَنَعْتُمْ بِذَلِكَ الرَّحْلِ؟ قَالَ: " صَاحِبٌ لَنَا لَمْ يَكُنْ لَهُ رَحْلٌ "
entries.isnad_en: Isma'il informed us. He said: al-Hasan narrated to us. He said: Yahya narrated to us. He said: Hasan b. Salih narrated to us, from al-Aswad b. Qays, from his father, who said:
entries.matn_en: We reached al-Hira and made peace with them for a thousand dirhams and a saddle (rahl). He said: I said to my father: What did you do with that saddle? He said: A companion of ours had no saddle.

entries.label: Narration
entries.isnad_ar: أَخْبَرَنَا إِسْمَاعِيلُ، قَالَ: حَدَّثَنَا الْحَسَنُ، قَالَ: حَدَّثَنَا يَحْيَى، قَالَ: حَدَّثَنَا عَبْدُ الرَّحِيمِ، عَنْ أَشْعَثَ، عَنِ الْحَكَمِ، قَالَ:
entries.matn_ar: " كَانُوا يُرَخِّصُونَ أَنْ يَشْتَرُوا مِنْ أَرْضِ الْحِيرَةِ مِنْ أَجْلِ أَنَّهُمْ صُلْحٌ "
entries.isnad_en: Isma'il informed us. He said: al-Hasan narrated to us. He said: Yahya narrated to us. He said: 'Abd al-Rahim narrated to us, from Ash'ath, from al-Hakam, who said:
entries.matn_en: They used to permit purchasing from the land of al-Hira because they were by treaty.

entries.label: Narration
entries.isnad_ar: أَخْبَرَنَا إِسْمَاعِيلُ، قَالَ: حَدَّثَنَا الْحَسَنُ، قَالَ: حَدَّثَنَا يَحْيَى، قَالَ: حَدَّثَنَا حَسَنُ بْنُ صَالِحٍ، عَنْ مُجَالِدِ بْنِ سَعِيدٍ، قَالَ:
entries.matn_ar: " أَهْلُ الْحِيرَةِ إِنَّمَا صُولِحُوا عَلَى مَا يَقْتَسِمُونَهُ بَيْنَهُمْ، وَلَيْسَ عَلَى رُءُوسِ الرِّجَالِ شَيْءٌ "
entries.isnad_en: Isma'il informed us. He said: al-Hasan narrated to us. He said: Yahya narrated to us. He said: Hasan b. Salih narrated to us, from Mujalid b. Sa'id, who said:
entries.matn_en: The people of al-Hira were reconciled only on a sum that they apportion among themselves, and nothing is upon the heads of the men.

entries.label: Narration
entries.isnad_ar: أَخْبَرَنَا إِسْمَاعِيلُ، قَالَ: حَدَّثَنَا الْحَسَنُ، قَالَ: حَدَّثَنَا يَحْيَى، قَالَ: حَدَّثَنَا حَسَنُ بْنُ صَالِحٍ، عَنْ أَشْعَثَ، عَنِ ابْنِ سِيرِينَ، قَالَ:
entries.matn_ar: " مَا نَعْلَمُ مَنْ لَهُ صُلْحٌ مِمَّنْ لَيْسَ لَهُ صُلْحٌ مِنْ أَهْلِ السَّوَادِ "
entries.isnad_en: Isma'il informed us. He said: al-Hasan narrated to us. He said: Yahya narrated to us. He said: Hasan b. Salih narrated to us, from Ash'ath, from Ibn Sirin, who said:
entries.matn_en: We do not know who among the people of the Sawad has a treaty and who has none.

entries.label: Narration
entries.isnad_ar: أَخْبَرَنَا إِسْمَاعِيلُ، قَالَ: حَدَّثَنَا الْحَسَنُ، قَالَ: حَدَّثَنَا يَحْيَى، قَالَ: حَدَّثَنَا ابْنُ إِدْرِيسَ، عَنْ أَشْعَثَ، عَنِ ابْنِ سِيرِينَ، قَالَ:
entries.matn_ar: " السَّوَادُ كَانَ بَعْضُهُ عَنْوَةً، وَبَعْضُهُ صُلْحًا "
entries.isnad_en: Isma'il informed us. He said: al-Hasan narrated to us. He said: Yahya narrated to us. He said: Ibn Idris narrated to us, from Ash'ath, from Ibn Sirin, who said:
entries.matn_en: As for the Sawad, some of it was by force and some of it by treaty.

entries.label: Narration
entries.isnad_ar: أَخْبَرَنَا إِسْمَاعِيلُ، قَالَ: حَدَّثَنَا الْحَسَنُ، قَالَ: حَدَّثَنَا يَحْيَى، قَالَ: حَدَّثَنَا أَبُو زُبَيْدٍ، عَنْ أَشْعَثَ، عَنِ ابْنِ سِيرِينَ، قَالَ:
entries.matn_ar: " السَّوَادُ مِنْهُ صُلْحٌ وَمِنْهُ عَنْوَةٌ، فَمَا كَانَ مِنْهُ عَنْوَةً فَهُوَ لِلْمُسْلِمِينَ، وَمَا كَانَ مِنْهُ صُلْحًا فَلَهُمْ أَمْوَالُهُمْ "
entries.isnad_en: Isma'il informed us. He said: al-Hasan narrated to us. He said: Yahya narrated to us. He said: Abu Zubayd narrated to us, from Ash'ath, from Ibn Sirin, who said:
entries.matn_en: The Sawad: part of it is by treaty and part by force; what was by force belongs to the Muslims, and what was by treaty, they have their property.

entries.label: Narration
entries.isnad_ar: أَخْبَرَنَا إِسْمَاعِيلُ، قَالَ: حَدَّثَنَا الْحَسَنُ، قَالَ: حَدَّثَنَا يَحْيَى، قَالَ: حَدَّثَنَا ابْنُ الْمُبَارَكِ، عَنْ مَعْمَرٍ، عَنْ عَلِيِّ بْنِ الْحَكَمِ، عَنْ مُحَمَّدِ بْنِ زَيْدٍ، قَالَ: سَمِعْتُ إِبْرَاهِيمَ النَّخَعِيَّ، يَقُولُ:
entries.matn_ar: جَاءَ رَجُلٌ إِلَى عُمَرَ بْنِ الْخَطَّابِ رضي الله عنه، فَقَالَ: إِنِّي قَدْ أَسْلَمْتُ ، فَضَعْ عَنْ أَرْضِي الْخَرَاجَ، قَالَ: " لَا، إِنَّ أَرْضَكَ أُخِذَتْ عَنْوَةً " قَالَ: وَجَاءَ رَجُلٌ آخَرُ ، فَقَالَ: إِنَّ أَرْضَ كَذَا وَكَذَا يُطِيقُونَ مِنَ الْخَرَاجِ أَكْثَرَ مِمَّا عَلَيْهِمْ، فَقَالَ: " لَا سَبِيلَ عَلَيْهِمْ، إِنَّا قَدْ صَالَحْنَاهُمْ صُلْحًا "
entries.isnad_en: Isma'il informed us. He said: al-Hasan narrated to us. He said: Yahya narrated to us. He said: Ibn al-Mubarak narrated to us, from Ma'mar, from 'Ali b. al-Hakam, from Muhammad b. Zayd, who said: I heard Ibrahim al-Nakha'i say:
entries.matn_en: A man came to 'Umar b. al-Khattab (r) and said: I have become Muslim, so lift the kharaj from my land. He said: No, your land was taken by force. He said: And another man came and said: The people of such-and-such land can bear more kharaj than is upon them. He said: There is no recourse against them; we made a treaty with them.

entries.label: Narration
entries.isnad_ar: أَخْبَرَنَا إِسْمَاعِيلُ، قَالَ: حَدَّثَنَا الْحَسَنُ، قَالَ: حَدَّثَنَا يَحْيَى، قَالَ: عَنْ عُبَيْدِ اللَّهِ الْأَشْجَعِيِّ، عَنْ سُفْيَانَ بْنِ سَعِيدٍ، عَنِ الزُّبَيْرِ بْنِ عَدِيٍّ، عَنْ رَجُلٍ مِنْ جُهَيْنَةَ قَالَ: قَالَ:
entries.matn_ar: رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم: " مَنْ أَقَرَّ بِالْخَرَاجِ بَعْدَ أَنْ أَنْقَذَهُ اللَّهُ عز وجل مِنْهُ ، فَعَلَيْهِ لَعْنَةُ اللَّهِ وَالْمَلَائِكَةِ وَالنَّاسِ أَجْمَعِينَ "
entries.isnad_en: Isma'il informed us. He said: al-Hasan narrated to us. He said: Yahya narrated to us. He said: [narrating] from 'Ubayd Allah al-Ashja'i, from Sufyan b. Sa'id, from al-Zubayr b. 'Adi, from a man of Juhayna, who said: The Messenger of God ﷺ said:
entries.matn_en: Whoever accepts the kharaj after God, mighty and majestic, has rescued him from it, upon him is the curse of God, the angels and all people.

entries.label: Narration
entries.isnad_ar: أَخْبَرَنَا إِسْمَاعِيلُ، قَالَ: حَدَّثَنَا الْحَسَنُ، قَالَ: حَدَّثَنَا يَحْيَى، قَالَ:
entries.matn_ar: سَأَلْتُ شَرِيكًا، عَنْ شِرَى أَرْضِ الْخَرَاجِ، قَالَ: " لَا تَجْعَلْ فِي عُنُقِكَ صَغَارًا "، وَقَالَ: " إِنَّمَا الْخَرَاجُ عَلَى أَهْلِ الصُّلْحِ الَّذِينَ صُولِحُوا عَلَى الْخَرَاجِ "
entries.isnad_en: Isma'il informed us. He said: al-Hasan narrated to us. He said: Yahya narrated to us. He said:
entries.matn_en: I asked Sharik about purchasing kharaj land. He said: Do not put humiliation (saghar) on your neck. And he said: The kharaj is only upon the people of the treaty who made peace on the kharaj.

entries.label: Narration
entries.isnad_ar: أَخْبَرَنَا إِسْمَاعِيلُ، قَالَ: حَدَّثَنَا الْحَسَنُ، قَالَ: حَدَّثَنَا يَحْيَى، قَالَ:
entries.matn_ar: وَسَأَلْتُ الْحَسَنَ بْنَ صَالِحٍ فَكَرِهَ شِرَى أَرْضِ الْخَرَاجِ الَّتِي أُخِذَتْ عَنْوَةً ، فَوَضَعَ عَلَيْهَا الْخَرَاجَ، " وَلَمْ يَرَ بَأْسًا بِشِرَى أَرْضِ أَهْلِ الصُّلْحِ الَّذِينَ صُولِحُوا عَلَى الْخَرَاجِ "
entries.isnad_en: Isma'il informed us. He said: al-Hasan narrated to us. He said: Yahya narrated to us. He said:
entries.matn_en: And I asked al-Hasan b. Salih, and he disliked the purchase of kharaj land that was taken by force and upon which the kharaj was placed, and saw no harm in the purchase of the land of the people of the treaty who made peace on the kharaj.

entries.label: Narration
entries.isnad_ar: أَخْبَرَنَا إِسْمَاعِيلُ، قَالَ: حَدَّثَنَا الْحَسَنُ، قَالَ: حَدَّثَنَا يَحْيَى، قَالَ:
entries.matn_ar: وَسَأَلْتُ الْحَسَنَ بْنَ صَالِحٍ، فَكَرِهَ شِرَى أَرْضِ الْخَرَاجِ الَّتِي أُخِذَتْ عَنْوَةً فَوُضِعَ عَلَيْهَا الْخَرَاجُ، فَلَمْ يَرَ بَأْسًا بِشِرَى أَرْضِ أَهْلِ الصُّلْحِ، قَالَ: " فَإِنِ اشْتَرَاهَا مُسْلِمٌ صَارَتْ أَرْضَ عُشْرٍ، ⦗ص: 52⦘ إِلَّا أَنْ تَكُونَ أَرْضًا قَدْ صُولِحَ أَهْلُهَا عَلَى أَنْ يُوضَعَ الْخَرَاجُ عَلَيْهَا ". قَالَ يَحْيَى: وَإِنْ كَانَ وُضِعَ عَلَيْهَا فَهِيَ أَرْضُ خَرَاجٍ لَا يُغَيِّرُ "
entries.isnad_en: Isma'il informed us. He said: al-Hasan narrated to us. He said: Yahya narrated to us. He said:
entries.matn_en: And I asked al-Hasan b. Salih, and he disliked the purchase of kharaj land that was taken by force and upon which the kharaj was placed, and saw no harm in the purchase of the land of the people of the treaty. He said: If a Muslim buys it, it becomes 'ushr land, [p. 52] unless it is land whose people made peace on the condition that the kharaj be placed upon it. Yahya said: And if it was placed upon it, it is kharaj land, which does not change.

entries.label: Narration
entries.isnad_ar: أَخْبَرَنَا إِسْمَاعِيلُ، قَالَ: حَدَّثَنَا الْحَسَنُ، قَالَ: حَدَّثَنَا يَحْيَى، قَالَ: حَدَّثَنِي زُهَيْرُ بْنُ مُعَاوِيَةَ، عَنْ كُلَيْبِ بْنِ وَائِلٍ، قَالَ:
entries.matn_ar: قُلْتُ لِابْنِ عُمَرَ: اشْتَرَيْتُ أَرْضًا ، قَالَ: " الشِّرَى حَسَنٌ "، قَالَ " قُلْتُ: فَإِنِّي أُعْطِي مِنْ كُلِّ جَرِيبِ أَرْضٍ دِرْهَمًا، وَقَفِيزًا مِنْ طَعَامٍ، قَالَ: " لَا تَجْعَلْ فِي عُنُقِكَ الصَّغَارَ".
entries.isnad_en: Isma'il informed us. He said: al-Hasan narrated to us. He said: Yahya narrated to us. He said: Zuhayr b. Mu'awiya narrated to me, from Kulayb b. Wa'il, who said:
entries.matn_en: I said to Ibn 'Umar: I have bought land. He said: Buying is good. He said: I said: I give for every jarib of land a dirham and a qafiz of food. He said: Do not put humiliation on your neck.

entries.label: Narration
entries.matn_ar: أَخْبَرَنَا إِسْمَاعِيلُ، قَالَ: حَدَّثَنَا الْحَسَنُ، قَالَ: حَدَّثَنَا يَحْيَى، قَالَ: حَدَّثَنَا إِسْرَائِيلُ، وَأَبُو بَكْرِ بْنُ عَيَّاشٍ، عَنْ كُلَيْبِ بْنِ وَائِلٍ، عَنْ ابْنِ عُمَرَ مِثْلَهُ
entries.isnad_en: Isma'il informed us. He said: al-Hasan narrated to us. He said: Yahya narrated to us. He said: Isra'il and Abu Bakr b. 'Ayyash narrated to us, from Kulayb b. Wa'il, from Ibn 'Umar,
entries.matn_en: the like of it.

entries.label: Narration
entries.isnad_ar: أَخْبَرَنَا إِسْمَاعِيلُ، قَالَ: حَدَّثَنَا الْحَسَنُ، قَالَ: حَدَّثَنَا يَحْيَى، قَالَ: حَدَّثَنَا سُفْيَانُ بْنُ سَعِيدٍ، عَنْ دَاوُدَ، عَنْ مُحَمَّدِ بْنِ سِيرِينَ، قَالَ:
entries.matn_ar: " نَهَى عُمَرُ رضي الله عنه عَنْ بَيْعِ رَقِيقِ أَهْلِ الذِّمَّةِ وَأَرَضِيهِمْ "
entries.isnad_en: Isma'il informed us. He said: al-Hasan narrated to us. He said: Yahya narrated to us. He said: Sufyan b. Sa'id narrated to us, from Dawud, from Muhammad b. Sirin, who said:
entries.matn_en: 'Umar (r) forbade the sale of the slaves of the dhimmis and their lands.

entries.label: Narration
entries.isnad_ar: أَخْبَرَنَا إِسْمَاعِيلُ، قَالَ: حَدَّثَنَا الْحَسَنُ، قَالَ: حَدَّثَنَا يَحْيَى، قَالَ: حَدَّثَنَا هُشَيْمٌ، عَنْ أَبِي عَقِيلٍ الْأَزْدِيِّ، أَنَّ الْحَسَنَ، حَدَّثَهُمْ، قَالَ:
entries.matn_ar: " نَهَى عُمَرُ بْنُ الْخَطَّابِ رضي الله عنه أَنْ يُشْتَرَى أَرْضُ أَهْلِ الذِّمَّةِ وَرَقِيقُهُمْ".
entries.isnad_en: Isma'il informed us. He said: al-Hasan narrated to us. He said: Yahya narrated to us. He said: Hushaym narrated to us, from Abu 'Aqil al-Azdi, that al-Hasan narrated to them, saying:
entries.matn_en: 'Umar b. al-Khattab (r) forbade the purchase of the land of the dhimmis and their slaves.

entries.label: Narration
entries.isnad_ar: أَخْبَرَنَا إِسْمَاعِيلُ، قَالَ: حَدَّثَنَا الْحَسَنُ، قَالَ: حَدَّثَنَا يَحْيَى، قَالَ: حَدَّثَنَا هُشَيْمٌ، عَنْ يُونُسَ، عَنِ الْحَسَنِ،
entries.matn_ar: مِثْلَهُ، وَلَمْ يَبْلُغْ بِهِ عُمَرَ
entries.isnad_en: Isma'il informed us. He said: al-Hasan narrated to us. He said: Yahya narrated to us. He said: Hushaym narrated to us, from Yunus, from al-Hasan,
entries.matn_en: the like of it, and he did not trace it back to 'Umar.

entries.label: Narration
entries.isnad_ar: أَخْبَرَنَا إِسْمَاعِيلُ، قَالَ: حَدَّثَنَا الْحَسَنُ، قَالَ: حَدَّثَنَا يَحْيَى، قَالَ: حَدَّثَنَا حَفْصُ بْنُ غِيَاثٍ، عَنْ هِشَامِ بْنِ حَسَّانَ، عَنِ الْحَسَنِ، قَالَ:
entries.matn_ar: قَالَ عُمَرُ بْنُ الْخَطَّابِ رضي الله عنه: " لَا تَشْتَرُوا مِنْ عَقَارِ أَهْلِ الذِّمَّةِ وَلَا مِنْ بِلَادِهِمْ شَيْئًا "
entries.isnad_en: Isma'il informed us. He said: al-Hasan narrated to us. He said: Yahya narrated to us. He said: Hafs b. Ghiyath narrated to us, from Hisham b. Hassan, from al-Hasan, who said: 'Umar b. al-Khattab (r) said:
entries.matn_en: Do not buy any of the real estate of the dhimmis, nor any of their lands.

entries.label: Narration
entries.isnad_ar: أَخْبَرَنَا إِسْمَاعِيلُ، قَالَ: حَدَّثَنَا الْحَسَنُ، قَالَ: حَدَّثَنَا يَحْيَى، قَالَ: حَدَّثَنَا ⦗ص: 53⦘ سِنَانٌ الْبُرْجُمِيُّ، عَنْ هِشَامِ بْنِ حَسَّانَ، عَنِ الْحَسَنِ، قَالَ:
entries.matn_ar: " لَا تَشْتَرُوا مِنْ بِلَادِ أَهْلِ الذِّمَّةِ وَلَا مِنْ عَقَارِهِمْ ". يُحَدِّثُ بِذَلِكَ ، عَنْ عُمَرَ رضي الله عنه
entries.isnad_en: Isma'il informed us. He said: al-Hasan narrated to us. He said: Yahya narrated to us. He said: [p. 53] Sinan al-Burjumi narrated to us, from Hisham b. Hassan, from al-Hasan, who said:
entries.matn_en: Do not buy any of the lands of the dhimmis, nor of their real estate. He narrates that from 'Umar (r).

entries.label: Narration
entries.matn_ar: أَخْبَرَنَا إِسْمَاعِيلُ، قَالَ: حَدَّثَنَا الْحَسَنُ، قَالَ: حَدَّثَنَا يَحْيَى، قَالَ: حَدَّثَنَا عَبْدُ الرَّحِيمِ، عَنْ هِشَامٍ، عَنِ الْحَسَنِ، عَنْ عُمَرَ، مِثْلَهُ
entries.isnad_en: Isma'il informed us. He said: al-Hasan narrated to us. He said: Yahya narrated to us. He said: 'Abd al-Rahim narrated to us, from Hisham, from al-Hasan, from 'Umar,
entries.matn_en: the like of it.

entries.label: Narration
entries.isnad_ar: أَخْبَرَنَا إِسْمَاعِيلُ، قَالَ: حَدَّثَنَا الْحَسَنُ، قَالَ: حَدَّثَنَا يَحْيَى، قَالَ: حَدَّثَنَا إِسْرَائِيلُ، عَنْ جَابِرٍ، عَنْ عَامِرٍ، قَالَ:
entries.matn_ar: " لَا يَصْلُحُ بَيْعُ أَرْضِ أَهْلِ الذِّمَّةِ "
entries.isnad_en: Isma'il informed us. He said: al-Hasan narrated to us. He said: Yahya narrated to us. He said: Isra'il narrated to us, from Jabir, from 'Amir, who said:
entries.matn_en: The sale of the land of the dhimmis is not valid.

entries.label: Narration
entries.isnad_ar: أَخْبَرَنَا إِسْمَاعِيلُ، قَالَ: حَدَّثَنَا الْحَسَنُ، قَالَ: حَدَّثَنَا يَحْيَى، قَالَ: حَدَّثَنَا عَبْدُ السَّلَامِ بْنُ حَرْبٍ، عَنْ سَعِيدِ بْنِ أَبِي عَرُوبَةَ، عَنْ قَتَادَةَ، عَنْ شَقِيقٍ الْعُقَيْلِيِّ، عَنْ عُمَرَ بْنِ الْخَطَّابِ رضي الله عنه: أَنَّهُ نَهَى أَنْ يَشْتَرِيَ أَحَدٌ مِنْ أَرْضِ الْخَرَاجِ أَوْ رَقِيقِهِمْ شَيْئًا، وَقَالَ:
entries.matn_ar: " لَا يَنْبَغِي لِمُسْلِمٍ أَنْ يُقِرَّ بِالصَّغَارِ فِي عُنُقِهِ "
entries.isnad_en: Isma'il informed us. He said: al-Hasan narrated to us. He said: Yahya narrated to us. He said: 'Abd al-Salam b. Harb narrated to us, from Sa'id b. Abi 'Aruba, from Qatada, from Shaqiq al-'Uqayli, from 'Umar b. al-Khattab (r):
entries.matn_en: that he forbade anyone to buy anything of the kharaj land or of their slaves, and said: It is not fitting for a Muslim to acknowledge humiliation (saghar) upon his neck.

entries.label: Narration
entries.isnad_ar: أَخْبَرَنَا إِسْمَاعِيلُ، قَالَ: حَدَّثَنَا الْحَسَنُ، قَالَ: حَدَّثَنَا يَحْيَى، قَالَ: حَدَّثَنَا ابْنُ مُبَارَكٍ، عَنْ جَعْفَرِ بْنِ بُرْقَانَ، عَنْ مَيْمُونِ بْنِ مِهْرَانَ، عَنِ ابْنِ عُمَرَ، قَالَ:
entries.matn_ar: " مَا يَسُرُّنِي أَنَّ الْأَرْضَ لِي كُلَّهَا بِجِزْيَةِ خَمْسَةِ دَرَاهِمَ، أُقِرُّ فِيهَا بِالصَّغَارِ عَلَى نَفْسِي؟
entries.isnad_en: Isma'il informed us. He said: al-Hasan narrated to us. He said: Yahya narrated to us. He said: Ibn Mubarak narrated to us, from Ja'far b. Burqan, from Maymun b. Mihran, from Ibn 'Umar, who said:
entries.matn_en: It does not please me that the whole earth be mine for a jizya of five dirhams, in which I acknowledge humiliation upon myself.

entries.label: Narration
entries.isnad_ar: أَخْبَرَنَا إِسْمَاعِيلُ، قَالَ: حَدَّثَنَا الْحَسَنُ، قَالَ: حَدَّثَنَا يَحْيَى، قَالَ: حَدَّثَنَا سُفْيَانُ بْنُ سَعِيدٍ، عَنْ جَابِرٍ، عَنِ الْقَاسِمِ، عَنْ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ، قَالَ:
entries.matn_ar: " مَنْ أَقَرَّ بِالطَّسْقِ فَقَدْ أَقَرَّ بِالصَّغَارِ "
entries.isnad_en: Isma'il informed us. He said: al-Hasan narrated to us. He said: Yahya narrated to us. He said: Sufyan b. Sa'id narrated to us, from Jabir, from al-Qasim, from 'Abd Allah, who said:
entries.matn_en: Whoever acknowledges the tasq (land tax) has acknowledged humiliation.

entries.label: Narration
entries.isnad_ar: أَخْبَرَنَا إِسْمَاعِيلُ، قَالَ: حَدَّثَنَا الْحَسَنُ، قَالَ: حَدَّثَنَا يَحْيَى، قَالَ: حَدَّثَنَا عَبْدُ السَّلَامِ بْنُ حَرْبٍ، عَنْ حَجَّاجٍ، عَنِ الْقَاسِمِ بْنِ عَبْدِ الرَّحْمَنِ، قَالَ:
entries.matn_ar: جَاءَ دِهْقَانٌ إِلَى عَبْدِ اللَّهِ بْنِ مَسْعُودٍ، فَقَالَ: اشْتَرِ مِنِّي أَرْضِي، فَقَالَ عَبْدُ اللَّهِ: " عَلَى أَنْ تَكْفِيَنِي خَرَاجَهَا؟ قَالَ: نَعَمْ، فَاشْتَرَاهَا مِنْهُ
entries.isnad_en: Isma'il informed us. He said: al-Hasan narrated to us. He said: Yahya narrated to us. He said: 'Abd al-Salam b. Harb narrated to us, from Hajjaj, from al-Qasim b. 'Abd al-Rahman, who said:
entries.matn_en: A dihqan came to 'Abd Allah b. Mas'ud and said: Buy my land from me. 'Abd Allah said: On condition that you relieve me of its kharaj? He said: Yes. So he bought it from him.

entries.label: Narration
entries.isnad_ar: أَخْبَرَنَا إِسْمَاعِيلُ، قَالَ: حَدَّثَنَا الْحَسَنُ، قَالَ: حَدَّثَنَا يَحْيَى، قَالَ: ⦗ص: 54⦘ حَدَّثَنَا أَبُو شِهَابٍ، عَنْ حَجَّاجٍ، عَنِ الْقَاسِمِ، عَنِ ابْنِ مَسْعُودٍ، "
entries.matn_ar: أَنَّهُ اشْتَرَى مِنْ دِهْقَانٍ أَرْضًا عَلَى أَنْ يَكْفِيَهُ خَرَاجَهَا "
entries.isnad_en: Isma'il informed us. He said: al-Hasan narrated to us. He said: Yahya narrated to us. He said: [p. 54] Abu Shihab narrated to us, from Hajjaj, from al-Qasim, from Ibn Mas'ud,
entries.matn_en: that he bought land from a dihqan on condition that he relieve him of its kharaj.

entries.label: Narration
entries.isnad_ar: أَخْبَرَنَا إِسْمَاعِيلُ، قَالَ: حَدَّثَنَا الْحَسَنُ، قَالَ: حَدَّثَنَا يَحْيَى، قَالَ: عَنْ عَبْدِ السَّلَامِ بْنِ حَرْبٍ، عَنْ بُكَيْرِ بْنِ عَامِرٍ، عَنْ عَامِرٍ، قَالَ:
entries.matn_ar: اشْتَرَى عُتْبَةُ بْنُ فَرْقَدٍ أَرْضًا مِنْ أَرْضِ الْخَرَاجِ، ثُمَّ أَتَى عُمَرَ رضي الله عنه ، فَأَخْبَرَهُ، فَقَالَ: " مِمَّنِ اشْتَرَيْتَهَا؟ " قَالَ: مِنْ أَهْلِهَا، قَالَ: " فَهَؤُلَاءِ - لِلْمُسْلِمِينَ - أَبِعْتُمُوهُ شَيْئًا؟ " قَالُوا: لَا، قَالَ: " فَاذْهَبْ ، فَاطْلُبْ مَالَكَ حَيْثُ وَضَعْتَهُ "
entries.isnad_en: Isma'il informed us. He said: al-Hasan narrated to us. He said: Yahya narrated to us. He said: [narrating] from 'Abd al-Salam b. Harb, from Bukayr b. 'Amir, from 'Amir, who said:
entries.matn_en: 'Utba b. Farqad bought land of kharaj land, then came to 'Umar (r) and informed him. He said: From whom did you buy it? He said: From its people. He said: And these—[he said, addressing] the Muslims—did you sell him anything? They said: No. He said: Go, then, and seek your money where you put it.

entries.label: Narration
entries.isnad_ar: أَخْبَرَنَا إِسْمَاعِيلُ، قَالَ: حَدَّثَنَا الْحَسَنُ، قَالَ: حَدَّثَنَا يَحْيَى، قَالَ: حَدَّثَنَا قَيْسٌ، عَنْ أَبِي إِسْمَاعِيلَ، عَنِ الشَّعْبِيِّ عَنْ عُتْبَةَ بْنِ فَرْقَدٍ، قَالَ:
entries.matn_ar: اشْتَرَيْتُ عَشَرَةَ أَجْرِبَةٍ مِنْ أَرْضِ السَّوَادِ عَلَى شَاطِئِ الْفُرَاتِ لِقَصَبٍ أُدَاوِيٍّ، فَذَكَرْتُ ذَلِكَ لِعُمَرَ فَقَالَ: " اشْتَرَيْتَهَا مِنْ أَصْحَابِهَا؟ " قُلْتُ: نَعَمْ. قَالَ: " رُحْ إِلَيَّ ". فَرُحْتُ إِلَيْهِ ، فَقَالَ: " يَا هَؤُلَاءِ ، أَبِعْتُمُوهُ شَيْئًا؟ " قَالُوا: لَا، قَالَ: " ابْتَغِ مَالَكَ حَيْثُ وَضَعْتَهُ "
entries.isnad_en: Isma'il informed us. He said: al-Hasan narrated to us. He said: Yahya narrated to us. He said: Qays narrated to us, from Abu Isma'il, from al-Sha'bi, from 'Utba b. Farqad, who said:
entries.matn_en: I bought ten ajriba of land of the Sawad on the bank of the Euphrates for udawi cane (qasab udawi). I mentioned that to 'Umar and he said: Did you buy it from its owners? I said: Yes. He said: Come to me. So I came to him, and he said: O you people, did you sell him anything? They said: No. He said: Seek your money where you put it.

entries.label: Narration
entries.isnad_ar: أَخْبَرَنَا إِسْمَاعِيلُ، قَالَ: حَدَّثَنَا الْحَسَنُ، قَالَ: حَدَّثَنَا يَحْيَى، قَالَ: حَدَّثَنَا حَفْصُ بْنُ غِيَاثٍ، عَنْ مُجَالِدٍ، عَنِ الشَّعْبِيِّ، قَالَ:
entries.matn_ar: " اشْتَرَى عَبْدُ اللَّهِ أَرْضَ خَرَاجٍ مِنْ دِهْقَانٍ، عَلَى أَنْ يَكْفِيَهُ خَرَاجَهَا "
entries.isnad_en: Isma'il informed us. He said: al-Hasan narrated to us. He said: Yahya narrated to us. He said: Hafs b. Ghiyath narrated to us, from Mujalid, from al-Sha'bi, who said:
entries.matn_en: 'Abd Allah bought kharaj land from a dihqan, on condition that he relieve him of its kharaj.

entries.label: Narration
entries.isnad_ar: أَخْبَرَنَا إِسْمَاعِيلُ، قَالَ: حَدَّثَنَا الْحَسَنُ، قَالَ: حَدَّثَنَا يَحْيَى، قَالَ: حَدَّثَنَا حَسَنُ بْنُ صَالِحٍ، عَنِ ابْنِ أَبِي لَيْلَى، قَالَ:
entries.matn_ar: اشْتَرَى الْحَسَنُ بْنُ عَلِيٍّ مِلْحَةً أَوْ مِلْحًا، وَاشْتَرَى الْحُسَيْنُ سُوَيْدَيْنِ مِنْ أَرْضِ الْخَرَاجِ، وَقَالَ: " قَدْ رَدَّ إِلَيْهِمْ عُمَرُ أَرَضِيهِمْ وَصَالَحَهُمْ عَلَى الْخَرَاجِ الَّذِي وَضَعَهُ عَلَيْهِمْ " قَالَ: وَكَانَ ابْنُ أَبِي لَيْلَى " لَا يَرَى بِشِرَاهَا بَأْسًا، وَكَرِهَهُ الْحَسَنُ "
entries.isnad_en: Isma'il informed us. He said: al-Hasan narrated to us. He said: Yahya narrated to us. He said: Hasan b. Salih narrated to us, from Ibn Abi Layla, who said:
entries.matn_en: al-Hasan b. 'Ali bought a salt-pan (milha)—or salt—and al-Husayn bought Suwaydayn of kharaj land, and he said: 'Umar had returned their lands to them and reconciled them on the kharaj that he placed upon them. He said: And Ibn Abi Layla saw no harm in buying it, and al-Hasan disliked it.

entries.label: Narration
entries.isnad_ar: أَخْبَرَنَا إِسْمَاعِيلُ، قَالَ: حَدَّثَنَا الْحَسَنُ، قَالَ: حَدَّثَنَا يَحْيَى، قَالَ: حَدَّثَنَا حَسَنُ بْنُ صَالِحٍ، عَنْ أَشْعَثَ، عَنِ الْحَكَمِ، قَالَ:
entries.matn_ar: " كَانَتْ لِشُرَيْحٍ أَرْضٌ مِنْ أَرْضِ الْحِيرَةِ اشْتَرَاهَا "
entries.isnad_en: Isma'il informed us. He said: al-Hasan narrated to us. He said: Yahya narrated to us. He said: Hasan b. Salih narrated to us, from Ash'ath, from al-Hakam, who said:
entries.matn_en: Shurayh had a piece of land from the land of al-Hira that he had purchased.

entries.label: Narration
entries.isnad_ar: أَخْبَرَنَا إِسْمَاعِيلُ، قَالَ: حَدَّثَنَا الْحَسَنُ، قَالَ: حَدَّثَنَا يَحْيَى، قَالَ: حَدَّثَنَا عَبْدُ الرَّحِيمِ، عَنْ أَشْعَثَ، عَنِ الْحَكَمِ، عَنْ شُرَيْحٍ،
entries.matn_ar: أَنَّهُ " اشْتَرَى أَرْضًا مِنْ أَرْضِ الْحِيرَةِ يُقَالُ لَهَا زَبَا " قَالَ: وَقَالَ الْحَكَمُ: " كَانُوا يُرَخِّصُونَ فِي شِرَى أَرْضِ الْحِيرَةِ مِنْ أَجْلِ أَنَّهُمْ صُلْحٌ "
entries.isnad_en: Isma'il informed us. He said: al-Hasan narrated to us. He said: Yahya narrated to us. He said: 'Abd al-Rahim narrated to us, from Ash'ath, from al-Hakam, from Shurayh,
entries.matn_en: that he bought land of the land of al-Hira called Zaba. He said: And al-Hakam said: They used to permit the purchase of land of al-Hira because they were by treaty.

entries.label: Narration
entries.isnad_ar: أَخْبَرَنَا إِسْمَاعِيلُ، قَالَ: حَدَّثَنَا الْحَسَنُ، قَالَ: حَدَّثَنَا يَحْيَى، قَالَ: حَدَّثَنَا سُفْيَانُ بْنُ سَعِيدٍ، عَنْ عِيسَى بْنِ الْمُغِيرَةِ، قَالَ:
entries.matn_ar: سَأَلْتُ الشَّعْبِيَّ عَنْ شِرَى أَرْضِ الْخَرَاجِ، قَالَ: " مَا أَقُولُ إِنَّهُ رِبًا ، وَلَا آمُرُ بِهِ "
