entries.matn_ar: " لَا تَعْتَمِدُوا - أَوْ قَالَ: - وَلَا تَحَرَّوْا " - يَعْنِي: الدُّونَ فِي الصَّدَقَةِ
entries.isnad_en: Yahya said: And I heard regarding His saying: “and do not aim at the bad of it to spend” [Q. 2:267], he said:
entries.matn_en: Do not aim for it—or he said: and do not seek it out—meaning: the inferior (al-dun) in sadaqa.

entries.label: Narration
entries.isnad_ar: أَخْبَرَنَا إِسْمَاعِيلُ، قَالَ: حَدَّثَنَا الْحَسَنُ، قَالَ: حَدَّثَنَا يَحْيَى، قَالَ: حَدَّثَنَا ابْنُ مُبَارَكٍ، عَنْ سَعِيدٍ، عَنْ جَعْفَرِ بْنِ مُحَمَّدٍ، عَنْ أَبِيهِ،
entries.matn_ar: أَنَّ النَّبِيَّ صلى الله عليه وسلم: " أَمَرَ بِالصَّدَقَةِ - أَوْ قَالَ: ⦗ص: 131⦘ بِالْفِطْرَةِ وَجَاءَ رَجُلٌ بِتَمْرٍ ردِيءٍ فَنَزَلَتْ: {وَلَا تَيَمَّمُوا الْخَبِيثَ مِنْهُ تُنْفِقُونَ} [البقرة: 267] "
entries.isnad_en: Isma'il informed us. He said: al-Hasan narrated to us. He said: Yahya narrated to us. He said: Ibn Mubarak narrated to us, from Sa'id, from Ja'far b. Muhammad, from his father:
entries.matn_en: That the Prophet ﷺ commanded sadaqa—or he said: [p. 131] the fitra—and a man came with poor-quality dates, so there was revealed: “and do not aim at the bad of it to spend” [Q. 2:267].

entries.label: Narration
entries.isnad_ar: أَخْبَرَنَا إِسْمَاعِيلُ، قَالَ: حَدَّثَنَا الْحَسَنُ، قَالَ: حَدَّثَنَا يَحْيَى، قَالَ: حَدَّثَنَا ابْنُ مُبَارَكٍ، عَنْ مُحَمَّدِ بْنِ أَبِي حَفْصَةَ، عَنِ الزُّهْرِيِّ، عَنْ أَبِي أُمَامَةَ بْنِ سَهْلِ بْنِ حُنَيْفٍ، قَالَ:
entries.matn_ar: كَانَ أُنَاسٌ يَتَلُّوَمُونَ بِشِرَاءِ ثِمَارِهِمْ ، فَأَنْزَلَ اللَّهُ تَعَالَى: {وَلَا تَيَمَّمُوا الْخَبِيثَ مِنْهُ تُنْفِقُونَ} [البقرة: 267] قَالَ: " فَنَهَى رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم عَنْ لَوْنَيْنِ مِنَ التَّمْرِ الْجُعْرُورِ وَلَوْنِ حُبَيْقٍ، يَعْنِي: نَهَى عَنْهُ أَنْ يُعْطَى فِي الصَّدَقَةِ "
entries.isnad_en: Isma'il informed us. He said: al-Hasan narrated to us. He said: Yahya narrated to us. He said: Ibn Mubarak narrated to us, from Muhammad b. Abi Hafsa, from al-Zuhri, from Abu Umama b. Sahl b. Hunayf, who said:
entries.matn_en: People used to hesitate (yatalawwamun) over buying their fruit, so God Most High revealed: “and do not aim at the bad of it to spend” [Q. 2:267]. He said: So the Messenger of God ﷺ forbade two kinds of dates, the ju'rur and the kind called hubayq—meaning: he forbade that they be given in sadaqa.

entries.label: Narration
entries.isnad_ar: أَخْبَرَنَا إِسْمَاعِيلُ، قَالَ: حَدَّثَنَا الْحَسَنُ، قَالَ: حَدَّثَنَا يَحْيَى، قَالَ: حَدَّثَنَا ابْنُ مُبَارَكٍ، عَنْ يُونُسَ، عَنِ الزُّهْرِيِّ، قَالَ:
entries.matn_ar: بَلَغَنِي، أَنَّ رَسُولَ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم: " رَدَّ الْجُعْرُورَ ، وَلَوْنَ حُبَيْقٍ " - يَعْنِي: أَنْ يُقْبَلَ فِي الصَّدَقَةِ -
entries.isnad_en: Isma'il informed us. He said: al-Hasan narrated to us. He said: Yahya narrated to us. He said: Ibn Mubarak narrated to us, from Yunus, from al-Zuhri, who said:
entries.matn_en: It has reached me that the Messenger of God ﷺ turned away the ju'rur and the kind called hubayq—meaning: that it be accepted in sadaqa.

entries.label: Narration
entries.isnad_ar: أَخْبَرَنَا إِسْمَاعِيلُ، قَالَ: حَدَّثَنَا الْحَسَنُ، قَالَ: حَدَّثَنَا يَحْيَى، قَالَ: حَدَّثَنَا ابْنُ مُبَارَكٍ، عَنْ عُبَيْدِ اللَّهِ بْنِ حُسَيْنِ بْنِ عَلِيِّ بْنِ حُسَيْنٍ، قَالَ: حَدَّثَنِي سَالِمٌ مَوْلَانَا، ⦗ص: 132⦘ قَالَ: حَدَّثَنِي عَمُّاكَ مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ عَلِيٍّ،
entries.matn_ar: وَعَبْدُ اللَّهِ بْنُ عَلِيٍّ، أَنَّ رَسُولَ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم أُتِيَ بِتَمْرِ بَعْلٍ وَبِتَمْرِ سَقِيٍّ، فَجَعَلَ يَأْكُلُ مِنَ الْبَعْلِ، فَقِيلَ: إِنَّ هَذَا أَصْفَى وَأَطْيَبُ، قَالَ: فَقَالَ: " إِنَّهُ لَمْ تَجُعْ فِيهِ كَبِدٌ، وَلَمْ يَعْرَ فِيهِ جَسَدٌ "
entries.isnad_en: Isma'il informed us. He said: al-Hasan narrated to us. He said: Yahya narrated to us. He said: Ibn Mubarak narrated to us, from 'Ubayd Allah b. Husayn b. 'Ali b. Husayn, who said: Salim, our mawla, narrated to me. [p. 132] He said: Your two paternal uncles, Muhammad b. 'Ali and 'Abd Allah b. 'Ali, narrated to me:
entries.matn_en: That the Messenger of God ﷺ was brought dates from rain-fed palms (ba'l) and dates from irrigated palms (saqi), and he began to eat from the ba'l. It was said: This one is purer and better. He said: So he said: It is that for which no liver has gone hungry and no body has gone unclothed.

sections.title_en: Chapter on the Awsāq and What Requires Zakāt
sections.title_ar: بَابُ الْأَوْسَاقِ ، وَمَا يَجِبُ فِيهِ الزَّكَاةُ

entries.label: Narration
entries.isnad_ar: أَخْبَرَنَا إِسْمَاعِيلُ، قَالَ: حَدَّثَنَا الْحَسَنُ، قَالَ: حَدَّثَنَا يَحْيَى، قَالَ: حَدَّثَنَا سُفْيَانُ بْنُ سَعِيدٍ، عَنْ عَمْرِو بْنِ يَحْيَى الْأَنْصَارِيِّ، عَنْ أَبِيهِ، عَنْ أَبِي سَعِيدٍ، عَنِ النَّبِيِّ صلى الله عليه وسلم أَنَّهُ قَالَ:
entries.matn_ar: " لَيْسَ فِيمَا دُونَ خَمْسَةِ أَوْسُقٍ صَدَقَةٌ "
entries.isnad_en: Isma'il informed us. He said: al-Hasan narrated to us. He said: Yahya narrated to us. He said: Sufyan b. Sa'id narrated to us, from 'Amr b. Yahya al-Ansari, from his father, from Abu Sa'id, from the Prophet ﷺ, that he said:
entries.matn_en: There is no sadaqa on less than five awsuq.

entries.label: Narration
entries.isnad_ar: أَخْبَرَنَا إِسْمَاعِيلُ، قَالَ: حَدَّثَنَا الْحَسَنُ، قَالَ: حَدَّثَنَا يَحْيَى، قَالَ: حَدَّثَنَا سُفْيَانُ بْنُ عُيَيْنَةَ، وَمِنْدَلٌ الْعَنَزِيُّ، عَنْ عَمْرِو بْنِ يَحْيَى الْأَنْصَارِيِّ، عَنْ أَبِيهِ، عَنْ أَبِي سَعِيدٍ الْخُدْرِيِّ، عَنْ رَسُولِ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم قَالَ:
entries.matn_ar: " لَيْسَ فِيمَا دُونَ خَمْسَةِ أَوْسُقٍ صَدَقَةٌ "
entries.isnad_en: Isma'il informed us. He said: al-Hasan narrated to us. He said: Yahya narrated to us. He said: Sufyan b. 'Uyayna and Mindal al-'Anazi narrated to us, from 'Amr b. Yahya al-Ansari, from his father, from Abu Sa'id al-Khudri, from the Messenger of God ﷺ, who said:
entries.matn_en: There is no sadaqa on less than five awsuq.

entries.label: Narration
entries.isnad_ar: أَخْبَرَنَا إِسْمَاعِيلُ، قَالَ: حَدَّثَنَا الْحَسَنُ، قَالَ: حَدَّثَنَا يَحْيَى، قَالَ: حَدَّثَنَا سُفْيَانُ بْنُ سَعِيدٍ، عَنْ إِسْمَاعِيلَ بْنِ أُمَيَّةَ، عَنْ مُحَمَّدِ بْنِ يَحْيَى بْنِ حَبَّانَ، عَنْ يَحْيَى بْنِ عُمَارَةَ، عَنْ أَبِي سَعِيدٍ، عَنِ النَّبِيِّ صلى الله عليه وسلم قَالَ:
entries.matn_ar: " لَا صَدَقَةَ فِي حَبٍّ ، وَلَا تَمْرٍ دُونَ خَمْسَةِ أَوْسُقٍ "
entries.isnad_en: Isma'il informed us. He said: al-Hasan narrated to us. He said: Yahya narrated to us. He said: Sufyan b. Sa'id narrated to us, from Isma'il b. Umayya, from Muhammad b. Yahya b. Habban, from Yahya b. 'Umara, from Abu Sa'id, from the Prophet ﷺ, who said:
entries.matn_en: There is no sadaqa on grain or dates below five awsuq.

entries.label: Narration
entries.isnad_ar: أَخْبَرَنَا إِسْمَاعِيلُ، قَالَ: حَدَّثَنَا الْحَسَنُ، قَالَ: حَدَّثَنَا يَحْيَى، قَالَ: حَدَّثَنَا شَرِيكٌ، عَنِ ابْنِ أَبِي لَيْلَى، عَنْ عَمْرِو بْنِ مُرَّةَ ، عَنْ أَبِي الْبَخْتَرِيِّ، عَنْ أَبِي سَعِيدٍ الْخُدْرِيِّ، يَرْفَعُهُ إِلَى النَّبِيِّ صلى الله عليه وسلم ، قَالَ:
entries.matn_ar: " لَيْسَ فِيمَا دُونَ خَمْسَةِ أَوْسَقٍ صَدَقَةٌ تؤخذ "
entries.isnad_en: Isma'il informed us. He said: al-Hasan narrated to us. He said: Yahya narrated to us. He said: Sharik narrated to us, from Ibn Abi Layla, from 'Amr b. Murra, from Abu al-Bakhtari, from Abu Sa'id al-Khudri, attributing it to the Prophet ﷺ, who said:
entries.matn_en: There is no sadaqa that is taken on less than five awsuq.

entries.label: Unnumbered report
entries.isnad_ar: أَخْبَرَنَا إِسْمَاعِيلُ، قَالَ: حَدَّثَنَا الْحَسَنُ، قَالَ: حَدَّثَنَا يَحْيَى، قَالَ: حَدَّثَنَا عَبْدَةُ، عَنْ مُحَمَّدِ بْنِ إِسْحَاقَ، عَنْ مُحَمَّدِ بْنِ يَحْيَى بْنِ حَبَّانَ، عَنْ يَحْيَى بْنِ عُمَارَةَ، عَنْ أَبِي سَعِيدٍ الْخُدْرِيِّ، قَالَ: سَمِعْتُ رَسُولَ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم يَقُولُ:
entries.matn_ar: " لَيْسَ فِيمَا دُونَ خَمْسَةِ أَوْسَاقٍ مِنَ التَّمْرِ صَدَقَةٌ "
entries.isnad_en: Isma'il informed us. He said: al-Hasan narrated to us. He said: Yahya narrated to us. He said: 'Abda narrated to us, from Muhammad b. Ishaq, from Muhammad b. Yahya b. Habban, from Yahya b. 'Umara, from Abu Sa'id al-Khudri, who said: I heard the Messenger of God ﷺ say:
entries.matn_en: There is no sadaqa on less than five awsaq of dates.

entries.label: Narration
entries.isnad_ar: أَخْبَرَنَا إِسْمَاعِيلُ، قَالَ: حَدَّثَنَا الْحَسَنُ، قَالَ: حَدَّثَنَا يَحْيَى، قَالَ: حَدَّثَنَا أَبُو شِهَابٍ، عَنِ ابْنِ أَبِي لَيْلَى، عَنْ عَمْرِو بْنِ مُرَّةَ، عَنْ أَبِي الْبَخْتَرِيِّ، عَنْ أَبِي سَعِيدٍ، قَالَ:
entries.matn_ar: " لَيْسَ فِي أَقَلَّ مِنْ خَمْسَةِ أَوْسُقٍ صَدَقَةٌ "
entries.isnad_en: Isma'il informed us. He said: al-Hasan narrated to us. He said: Yahya narrated to us. He said: Abu Shihab narrated to us, from Ibn Abi Layla, from 'Amr b. Murra, from Abu al-Bakhtari, from Abu Sa'id, who said:
entries.matn_en: There is no sadaqa on less than five awsuq.

entries.label: Narration
entries.isnad_ar: أَخْبَرَنَا إِسْمَاعِيلُ، قَالَ: حَدَّثَنَا الْحَسَنُ، قَالَ: حَدَّثَنَا يَحْيَى، قَالَ: حَدَّثَنَا عَبْدُ السَّلَامِ بْنُ حَرْبٍ، عَنْ لَيْثٍ، عَنْ نَافِعٍ، عَنْ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ بْنِ عُمَرَ، قَالَ: قَالَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم:
entries.matn_ar: " لَيْسَ فِيمَا دُونَ خَمْسَةِ أَوْسُقٍ زَكَاةٌ "
entries.isnad_en: Isma'il informed us. He said: al-Hasan narrated to us. He said: Yahya narrated to us. He said: 'Abd al-Salam b. Harb narrated to us, from Layth, from Nafi', from 'Abd Allah b. 'Umar, who said: The Messenger of God ﷺ said:
entries.matn_en: There is no zakat on less than five awsuq.

entries.label: Narration
entries.isnad_ar: أَخْبَرَنَا إِسْمَاعِيلُ، قَالَ: حَدَّثَنَا الْحَسَنُ، قَالَ: حَدَّثَنَا يَحْيَى، قَالَ: حَدَّثَنَا وَكِيعٌ، عَنْ إِدْرِيسَ الْأَوْدِيِّ، عَنْ عَمْرِو بْنِ مُرَّةَ، عَنْ أَبِي الْبَخْتَرِيِّ، عَنْ أَبِي سَعِيدٍ الْخُدْرِيِّ، قَالَ: قَالَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم:
entries.matn_ar: " لَيْسَ فِيمَا دُونَ خَمْسَةِ أَوْسُقٍ صَدَقَةٌ "
entries.isnad_en: Isma'il informed us. He said: al-Hasan narrated to us. He said: Yahya narrated to us. He said: Waki' narrated to us, from Idris al-Awdi, from 'Amr b. Murra, from Abu al-Bakhtari, from Abu Sa'id al-Khudri, who said: The Messenger of God ﷺ said:
entries.matn_en: There is no sadaqa on less than five awsuq.

entries.label: Narration
entries.isnad_ar: أَخْبَرَنَا إِسْمَاعِيلُ، قَالَ: حَدَّثَنَا الْحَسَنُ، قَالَ: حَدَّثَنَا يَحْيَى، قَالَ: حَدَّثَنَا قُرَّانٌ الْأَسَدِيُّ، عَنْ يَحْيَى بْنِ أَبِي أُنَيْسَةَ، عَنْ عَمْرِو بْنِ شُعَيْبٍ، عَنْ أَبِيهِ، عَنْ جَدِّهِ، قَالَ: ⦗ص: 134⦘ قَالَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم:
entries.matn_ar: " لَيْسَ فِيمَا دُونَ خَمْسَةِ أَوْسُقٍ صَدَقَةٌ "
entries.isnad_en: Isma'il informed us. He said: al-Hasan narrated to us. He said: Yahya narrated to us. He said: Qurran al-Asadi narrated to us, from Yahya b. Abi Unaysa, from 'Amr b. Shu'ayb, from his father, from his grandfather, who said: [p. 134] The Messenger of God ﷺ said:
entries.matn_en: There is no sadaqa on less than five awsuq.

entries.label: Narration
entries.isnad_ar: أَخْبَرَنَا إِسْمَاعِيلُ، قَالَ: حَدَّثَنَا الْحَسَنُ، قَالَ: حَدَّثَنَا يَحْيَى، قَالَ: حَدَّثَنَا حَفْصُ بْنُ غِيَاثٍ، عَنْ أَشْعَثَ، عَنْ أَبِي الزُّبَيْرِ، عَنْ جَابِرِ بْنِ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ، قَالَ:
entries.matn_ar: " لَيْسَ فِيمَا دُونَ خَمْسَةِ أَوْسُقٍ صَدَقَةٌ "
entries.isnad_en: Isma'il informed us. He said: al-Hasan narrated to us. He said: Yahya narrated to us. He said: Hafs b. Ghiyath narrated to us, from Ash'ath, from Abu al-Zubayr, from Jabir b. 'Abd Allah, who said:
entries.matn_en: There is no sadaqa on less than five awsuq.

entries.label: Narration
entries.isnad_ar: أَخْبَرَنَا إِسْمَاعِيلُ، قَالَ: حَدَّثَنَا الْحَسَنُ، قَالَ: حَدَّثَنَا يَحْيَى، قَالَ: حَدَّثَنَا أَبُو بَكْرِ بْنُ عَيَّاشٍ، عَنْ مُغِيرَةَ، عَنْ إِبْرَاهِيمَ، قَالَ:
entries.matn_ar: " لَيْسَ فِيمَا دُونَ خَمْسَةِ أَوْسُقٍ صَدَقَةٌ "
entries.isnad_en: Isma'il informed us. He said: al-Hasan narrated to us. He said: Yahya narrated to us. He said: Abu Bakr b. 'Ayyash narrated to us, from Mughira, from Ibrahim, who said:
entries.matn_en: There is no sadaqa on less than five awsuq.

entries.label: Narration
entries.isnad_ar: أَخْبَرَنَا إِسْمَاعِيلُ، قَالَ: حَدَّثَنَا الْحَسَنُ، قَالَ: حَدَّثَنَا يَحْيَى، قَالَ: حَدَّثَنَا جَرِيرُ بْنُ عَبْدِ الْحَمِيدِ، عَنْ مُغِيرَةَ، عَنْ إِبْرَاهِيمَ، قَالَ:
entries.matn_ar: " لَيْسَ فِيمَا أَقَلَّ مِنْ خَمْسَةِ أَوْسُقٍ صَدَقَةٌ "
entries.isnad_en: Isma'il informed us. He said: al-Hasan narrated to us. He said: Yahya narrated to us. He said: Jarir b. 'Abd al-Hamid narrated to us, from Mughira, from Ibrahim, who said:
entries.matn_en: There is no sadaqa on less than five awsuq.

entries.label: Narration
entries.isnad_ar: أَخْبَرَنَا إِسْمَاعِيلُ، قَالَ: حَدَّثَنَا الْحَسَنُ، قَالَ: حَدَّثَنَا يَحْيَى، قَالَ: حَدَّثَنَا عَبْدُ الرَّحِيمِ، عَنْ مُحَمَّدِ بْنِ سَالِمٍ، عَنِ الشَّعْبِيِّ، قَالَ:
entries.matn_ar: " لَيْسَ فِيمَا دُونَ خَمْسَةِ أَوْسُقٍ صَدَقَةٌ ⦗ص: 135⦘ ".
entries.isnad_en: Isma'il informed us. He said: al-Hasan narrated to us. He said: Yahya narrated to us. He said: 'Abd al-Rahim narrated to us, from Muhammad b. Salim, from al-Sha'bi, who said:
entries.matn_en: There is no sadaqa on less than five awsuq. [p. 135]

entries.label: Narration
entries.matn_ar: أَخْبَرَنَا إِسْمَاعِيلُ، قَالَ: حَدَّثَنَا الْحَسَنُ، قَالَ: حَدَّثَنَا يَحْيَى، قَالَ: حَدَّثَنَا ابْنُ أَبِي زَائِدَةَ، عَنْ أَبِي سَهْلٍ، عَنْ عَامِرٍ مِثْلَهُ
entries.isnad_en: Isma'il informed us. He said: al-Hasan narrated to us. He said: Yahya narrated to us. He said: Ibn Abi Za'ida narrated to us, from Abu Sahl, from 'Amir,
entries.matn_en: The like of it.

entries.label: Narration
entries.matn_ar: أَخْبَرَنَا إِسْمَاعِيلُ، قَالَ: حَدَّثَنَا الْحَسَنُ، قَالَ: حَدَّثَنَا يَحْيَى، قَالَ: حَدَّثَنَا ابْنُ أَبِي زَائِدَةَ، عَنْ مُبَارَكٍ، عَنِ الْحَسَنِ مِثْلَهُ
entries.isnad_en: Isma'il informed us. He said: al-Hasan narrated to us. He said: Yahya narrated to us. He said: Ibn Abi Za'ida narrated to us, from Mubarak, from al-Hasan,
entries.matn_en: The like of it.

entries.label: Narration
entries.isnad_ar: أَخْبَرَنَا إِسْمَاعِيلُ، قَالَ: حَدَّثَنَا الْحَسَنُ، قَالَ: حَدَّثَنَا يَحْيَى، قَالَ: حَدَّثَنَا ابْنُ مُبَارَكٍ، عَنْ يُونُسَ، عَنِ الزُّهْرِيِّ، قَالَ: سَمِعْتُ أَبَا أُمَامَةَ بْنَ سَهْلِ بْنِ حُنَيْفٍ،
entries.matn_ar: يُحَدِّثُ فِي مَجْلِسِ سَعِيدِ بْنِ الْمُسَيِّبِ: " أَنَّ السُّنَّةَ مَضَتْ لَا تُؤْخَذُ صَدَقَةٌ مِنْ نَخْلٍ حَتَّى يَبْلُغَ خِرْصُهَا خَمْسَةَ أَوْسَاقٍ "
entries.isnad_en: Isma'il informed us. He said: al-Hasan narrated to us. He said: Yahya narrated to us. He said: Ibn Mubarak narrated to us, from Yunus, from al-Zuhri, who said:
entries.matn_en: I heard Abu Umama b. Sahl b. Hunayf narrating in the gathering of Sa'id b. al-Musayyab: The sunna has gone forth that no sadaqa is taken from palm trees until their estimate (khirs) reaches five awsaq.

entries.label: Narration
entries.matn_ar: أَخْبَرَنَا إِسْمَاعِيلُ، قَالَ: حَدَّثَنَا الْحَسَنُ، قَالَ: حَدَّثَنَا يَحْيَى، قَالَ: حَدَّثَنَا ابْنُ مُبَارَكٍ، عَنْ يَعْقُوبَ بْنِ الْقَعْقَاعِ، عَنْ عَطَاءٍ، قَالَ: " فِي خَمْسَةِ أَوْسَاقٍ الزَّكَاةُ، وَذَلِكَ ثَلَاثُمِائَةِ صَاعٍ ". أَخْبَرَنَا إِسْمَاعِيلُ، قَالَ: حَدَّثَنَا الْحَسَنُ، قَالَ: حَدَّثَنَا يَحْيَى، قَالَ: حَدَّثَنَا ابْنُ مُبَارَكٍ، عَنْ مَعْمَرٍ، عَنْ إِسْمَاعِيلَ بْنِ أُمَيَّةَ، قَالَ: سَأَلْتُ الزُّهْرِيَّ، عَنِ الْأَوْسَاقِ ، فَحَقَّقَهَا لِي
entries.matn_en: [454] Isma'il informed us. He said: al-Hasan narrated to us. He said: Yahya narrated to us. He said: Ibn Mubarak narrated to us, from Ya'qub b. al-Qa'qa', from 'Ata', who said: Zakat is due on five awsaq, and that is three hundred sa'. Isma'il informed us. He said: al-Hasan narrated to us. He said: Yahya narrated to us. He said: Ibn Mubarak narrated to us, from Ma'mar, from Isma'il b. Umayya, who said: I asked al-Zuhri about the awsaq, and he made it precise for me.

entries.label: Narration
entries.isnad_ar: قَالَ يَحْيَى: وَكَانَ حَسَنُ بْنُ صَالِحٍ، وَشَرِيكٌ،
entries.matn_ar: " يَأْخُذَانِ بِالْأَوْسَاقِ، وَلَا يَرَيَانِ فِيمَا دُونَهَا شَيْئًا، سَمِعْتُهُ مِنْهُمَا".
entries.isnad_en: Yahya said:
entries.matn_en: Hasan b. Salih and Sharik used to adhere to the awsaq, and did not consider that anything was due on what is below them; I heard it from them.

entries.label: Narration
entries.isnad_ar: أَخْبَرَنَا إِسْمَاعِيلُ، قَالَ: حَدَّثَنَا الْحَسَنُ، قَالَ: حَدَّثَنَا يَحْيَى، قَالَ: حَدَّثَنَا الْأَشْجَعِيُّ، عَنْ سُفْيَانَ بْنِ سَعِيدٍ،
entries.matn_ar: أَنَّهُ كَانَ يَأْخُذُ بِهِ
entries.isnad_en: Isma'il informed us. He said: al-Hasan narrated to us. He said: Yahya narrated to us. He said: al-Ashja'i narrated to us, from Sufyan b. Sa'id:
entries.matn_en: That he used to hold to it.

sections.title_en: Chapter: The Amount of the Wasq in Ṣāʿs, and Its Quantity
sections.title_ar: بَابٌ: مَبْلَغُ كَيْلِ الْوَسْقِ صَاعًا وَمِقْدَارُهُ

entries.label: Narration
entries.isnad_ar: أَخْبَرَنَا إِسْمَاعِيلُ، قَالَ: حَدَّثَنَا الْحَسَنُ، قَالَ: حَدَّثَنَا يَحْيَى، قَالَ: حَدَّثَنَا إِسْرَائِيلُ بْنُ يُونُسَ، عَنْ مُغِيرَةَ، عَنْ إِبْرَاهِيمَ، قَالَ:
entries.matn_ar: " الْوَسْقُ سِتُّونَ صَاعًا "
entries.isnad_en: Isma'il informed us. He said: al-Hasan narrated to us. He said: Yahya narrated to us. He said: Isra'il b. Yunus narrated to us, from Mughira, from Ibrahim, who said:
entries.matn_en: The wasq is sixty sa'.

entries.label: Narration
entries.isnad_ar: أَخْبَرَنَا إِسْمَاعِيلُ، قَالَ: حَدَّثَنَا الْحَسَنُ، قَالَ: حَدَّثَنَا يَحْيَى، قَالَ: حَدَّثَنَا أَبُو بَكْرِ بْنُ عَيَّاشٍ، عَنِ الْمُغِيرَةِ، عَنْ إِبْرَاهِيمَ، قَالَ:
entries.matn_ar: " الْوَسْقُ سِتُّونَ صَاعًا بِالْحَجَّاجِيِّ "
entries.isnad_en: Isma'il informed us. He said: al-Hasan narrated to us. He said: Yahya narrated to us. He said: Abu Bakr b. 'Ayyash narrated to us, from al-Mughira, from Ibrahim, who said:
entries.matn_en: The wasq is sixty sa' by the Hajjaji [sa'].

entries.label: Narration
entries.isnad_ar: أَخْبَرَنَا إِسْمَاعِيلُ، قَالَ: حَدَّثَنَا الْحَسَنُ، قَالَ: حَدَّثَنَا يَحْيَى، قَالَ: حَدَّثَنَا جَرِيرُ بْنُ عَبْدِ الْحَمِيدِ، عَنْ مُغِيرَةَ، عَنْ إِبْرَاهِيمَ، قَالَ:
entries.matn_ar: " الْوَسْقُ سِتُّونَ قَفِيزًا بِقَفِيزِ الْحَجَّاجِيِّ "
entries.isnad_en: Isma'il informed us. He said: al-Hasan narrated to us. He said: Yahya narrated to us. He said: Jarir b. 'Abd al-Hamid narrated to us, from Mughira, from Ibrahim, who said:
entries.matn_en: The wasq is sixty qafiz by the Hajjaji qafiz.

entries.label: Narration
entries.isnad_ar: أَخْبَرَنَا إِسْمَاعِيلُ، قَالَ: حَدَّثَنَا الْحَسَنُ، قَالَ: حَدَّثَنَا يَحْيَى، قَالَ: حَدَّثَنَا سُفْيَانُ بْنُ سَعِيدٍ، عَنِ الْحَذَّاءِ، عَنْ أَبِي قِلَابَةَ، قَالَ:
entries.matn_ar: " الْوَسْقُ سِتُّونَ صَاعًا "
entries.isnad_en: Isma'il informed us. He said: al-Hasan narrated to us. He said: Yahya narrated to us. He said: Sufyan b. Sa'id narrated to us, from al-Hadhdha', from Abu Qilaba, who said:
entries.matn_en: The wasq is sixty sa'.

entries.label: Narration
entries.isnad_ar: أَخْبَرَنَا إِسْمَاعِيلُ، قَالَ: حَدَّثَنَا الْحَسَنُ، قَالَ: حَدَّثَنَا يَحْيَى، قَالَ: حَدَّثَنَا عَبْدُ الرَّحِيمِ، عَنْ مُحَمَّدِ بْنِ سَالِمٍ، عَنِ الشَّعْبِيِّ، قَالَ:
entries.matn_ar: " الْوَسْقُ سِتُّونَ صَاعًا بِالْحَجَّاجِيِّ "
entries.isnad_en: Isma'il informed us. He said: al-Hasan narrated to us. He said: Yahya narrated to us. He said: 'Abd al-Rahim narrated to us, from Muhammad b. Salim, from al-Sha'bi, who said:
entries.matn_en: The wasq is sixty sa' by the Hajjaji [sa'].

entries.label: Narration
entries.isnad_ar: أَخْبَرَنَا إِسْمَاعِيلُ، قَالَ: حَدَّثَنَا الْحَسَنُ، قَالَ: حَدَّثَنَا يَحْيَى، قَالَ: حَدَّثَنَا ابْنُ أَبِي زَائِدَةَ، عَنِ الْمُبَارَكِ، عَنِ الْحَسَنِ، قَالَ:
entries.matn_ar: " وَزْنُ الْوَسْقِ سِتُّونَ صَاعًا بِالْحَجَّاجِيِّ "
entries.isnad_en: Isma'il informed us. He said: al-Hasan narrated to us. He said: Yahya narrated to us. He said: Ibn Abi Za'ida narrated to us, from al-Mubarak, from al-Hasan, who said:
entries.matn_en: The weight of the wasq is sixty sa' by the Hajjaji [sa'].

entries.label: Narration
entries.isnad_ar: أَخْبَرَنَا إِسْمَاعِيلُ، قَالَ: حَدَّثَنَا الْحَسَنُ، قَالَ: حَدَّثَنَا يَحْيَى، قَالَ: حَدَّثَنَا وَكِيعٌ، عَنْ شَرِيكٍ، عَنْ لَيْثٍ، عَنْ نَافِعٍ، عَنِ ابْنِ عُمَرَ، قَالَ:
entries.matn_ar: " وَزْنُ الْوَسْقِ سِتُّونَ صَاعًا ". قَالَ يَحْيَى: فَسَأَلْتُ شَرِيكًا عَنْهُ ، فَلَمْ يَحْفَظْهُ
entries.isnad_en: Isma'il informed us. He said: al-Hasan narrated to us. He said: Yahya narrated to us. He said: Waki' narrated to us, from Sharik, from Layth, from Nafi', from Ibn 'Umar, who said:
entries.matn_en: The weight of the wasq is sixty sa'. Yahya said: I asked Sharik about it, and he did not remember it.

entries.label: Narration
entries.isnad_ar: أَخْبَرَنَا إِسْمَاعِيلُ، قَالَ: حَدَّثَنَا الْحَسَنُ، قَالَ: حَدَّثَنَا يَحْيَى، قَالَ: وَحَدَّثَنِي، ⦗ص: 137⦘ عَنْ أَبِي سَعِيدٍ الْخُدْرِيِّ، قَالَ:
entries.matn_ar: " الْوَسْقُ سِتُّونَ صَاعًا "
entries.isnad_en: Isma'il informed us. He said: al-Hasan narrated to us. He said: Yahya narrated to us. He said: And [—] narrated to me, [p. 137] from Abu Sa'id al-Khudri, who said:
entries.matn_en: The wasq is sixty sa'.

entries.label: Unnumbered report
entries.isnad_ar: أَخْبَرَنَا إِسْمَاعِيلُ، قَالَ: حَدَّثَنَا الْحَسَنُ، قَالَ: حَدَّثَنَا يَحْيَى، قَالَ: حَدَّثَنِي ابْنُ مُبَارَكٍ، عَنْ يَعْقُوبَ بْنِ الْقَعْقَاعِ، عَنْ عَطَاءٍ، قَالَ:
entries.matn_ar: " الْوَسْقُ سِتُّونَ صَاعًا "
entries.isnad_en: Isma'il informed us. He said: al-Hasan narrated to us. He said: Yahya narrated to us. He said: Ibn Mubarak narrated to me, from Ya'qub b. al-Qa'qa', from 'Ata', who said:
entries.matn_en: The wasq is sixty sa'.

entries.label: Narration
entries.isnad_ar: أَخْبَرَنَا إِسْمَاعِيلُ، قَالَ: حَدَّثَنَا الْحَسَنُ، قَالَ: حَدَّثَنَا يَحْيَى، قَالَ: حَدَّثَنَا أَبُو شِهَابٍ، عَنِ ابْنِ أَبِي لَيْلَى، قَالَ:
entries.matn_ar: " الْوَسْقُ سِتُّونَ صَاعًا "
entries.isnad_en: Isma'il informed us. He said: al-Hasan narrated to us. He said: Yahya narrated to us. He said: Abu Shihab narrated to us, from Ibn Abi Layla, who said:
entries.matn_en: The wasq is sixty sa'.

entries.label: Narration
entries.isnad_ar: حَدَّثَنَا ابْنُ مُبَارَكٍ، عَنْ يَعْقُوبَ بْنِ الْقَعْقَاعِ، عَنْ قَتَادَةَ، عَنْ سَعِيدِ بْنِ الْمُسَيِّبِ، قَالَ:
entries.matn_ar: " الْوَسْقُ سِتُّونَ صَاعًا "
entries.isnad_en: Ibn Mubarak narrated to us, from Ya'qub b. al-Qa'qa', from Qatada, from Sa'id b. al-Musayyab, who said:
entries.matn_en: The wasq is sixty sa'.

entries.label: Narration
entries.isnad_ar: أَخْبَرَنَا إِسْمَاعِيلُ، قَالَ: حَدَّثَنَا الْحَسَنُ، قَالَ: حَدَّثَنَا يَحْيَى، قَالَ: حَدَّثَنَا أَبُو شِهَابٍ، عَنِ ابْنِ أَبِي لَيْلَى، قَالَ:
entries.matn_ar: " الْوَسْقُ سِتُّونَ صَاعًا "
entries.isnad_en: Isma'il informed us. He said: al-Hasan narrated to us. He said: Yahya narrated to us. He said: Abu Shihab narrated to us, from Ibn Abi Layla, who said:
entries.matn_en: The wasq is sixty sa'.

entries.label: Narration
entries.isnad_ar: أَخْبَرَنَا إِسْمَاعِيلُ، قَالَ: حَدَّثَنَا الْحَسَنُ، قَالَ: حَدَّثَنَا يَحْيَى، قَالَ: حَدَّثَنَا الْحَسَنُ بْنُ صَالِحٍ، وَشَرِيكٌ، قَالَا:
entries.matn_ar: " الْوَسْقُ سِتُّونَ صَاعًا، وَكَانَا لَا يَرَيَانِ الصَّدَقَةَ فِيمَا يَنْقُصُ مِنْ خَمْسَةِ أَوْسُقٍ "
entries.isnad_en: Isma'il informed us. He said: al-Hasan narrated to us. He said: Yahya narrated to us. He said: al-Hasan b. Salih and Sharik narrated to us; they both said:
entries.matn_en: The wasq is sixty sa'; and they did not consider that sadaqa was due on what falls short of five awsuq.

sections.title_en: Chapter on the Measure of the Ṣāʿ

entries.label: Narration
entries.isnad_ar: أَخْبَرَنَا إِسْمَاعِيلُ، قَالَ: حَدَّثَنَا الْحَسَنُ، قَالَ: حَدَّثَنَا يَحْيَى، قَالَ:
entries.matn_ar: سَأَلْتُ حَسَنَ بْنَ صَالِحٍ، عَنِ الصَّاعِ، فَقَالَ: " الْقَفِيزُ الْحَجَّاجِيُّ صَاعٌ ، وَهُوَ ثَمَانِيَةُ أَرْطَالٍ "
entries.isnad_en: Isma'il informed us. He said: al-Hasan narrated to us. He said: Yahya narrated to us. He said: He said:
entries.matn_en: I asked Hasan b. Salih about the sa', and he said: The Hajjaji qafiz is a sa', and it is eight ratls.

entries.label: Narration
entries.isnad_ar: أَخْبَرَنَا إِسْمَاعِيلُ، قَالَ: حَدَّثَنَا الْحَسَنُ، قَالَ: حَدَّثَنَا يَحْيَى، قَالَ:
entries.matn_ar: سَأَلْتُ شَرِيكًا، عَنِ الصَّاعِ، فَقَالَ: " هُوَ أَقَلُّ مِنْ ثَمَانِيَةِ أَرْطَالٍ ، وَأَكْثَرُ مِنْ سَبْعَةِ أَرْطَالٍ "
entries.isnad_en: Isma'il informed us. He said: al-Hasan narrated to us. He said: Yahya narrated to us. He said: He said:
entries.matn_en: I asked Sharik about the sa', and he said: It is less than eight ratls and more than seven ratls.

entries.label: Narration
entries.isnad_ar: أَخْبَرَنَا إِسْمَاعِيلُ، قَالَ: حَدَّثَنَا الْحَسَنُ، قَالَ: حَدَّثَنَا يَحْيَى، قَالَ: حَدَّثَنَا شَرِيكٌ، عَنْ مُغِيرَةَ، عَنْ إِبْرَاهِيمَ، قَالَ:
entries.matn_ar: " الْحَجَّاجِيُّ عَلَى صَاعِ عُمَرَ رَضِيَ اللَّهُ عَنْهُ
entries.isnad_en: Isma'il informed us. He said: al-Hasan narrated to us. He said: Yahya narrated to us. He said: Sharik narrated to us, from Mughira, from Ibrahim, who said:
entries.matn_en: The Hajjaji is based on the sa' of 'Umar (r).

entries.label: Narration
entries.isnad_ar: أَخْبَرَنَا إِسْمَاعِيلُ، قَالَ: حَدَّثَنَا الْحَسَنُ، قَالَ: حَدَّثَنَا يَحْيَى، قَالَ: حَدَّثَنَا أَبُو بَكْرِ بْنُ عَيَّاشٍ، وَجَرِيرُ بْنُ عَبْدِ الْحَمِيدِ، عَنْ مُغِيرَةَ، عَنْ إِبْرَاهِيمَ، قَالَ:
entries.matn_ar: " الْحَجَّاجِيُّ هُوَ الصَّاعُ "
entries.isnad_en: Isma'il informed us. He said: al-Hasan narrated to us. He said: Yahya narrated to us. He said: Abu Bakr b. 'Ayyash and Jarir b. 'Abd al-Hamid narrated to us, from Mughira, from Ibrahim, who said:
entries.matn_en: The Hajjaji is the sa'.

entries.label: Narration
entries.isnad_ar: أَخْبَرَنَا إِسْمَاعِيلُ، قَالَ: حَدَّثَنَا الْحَسَنُ، قَالَ: حَدَّثَنَا يَحْيَى، قَالَ: حَدَّثَنَا أَبُو شِهَابٍ، عَنْ حَجَّاجٍ، عَنْ فُضَيْلِ بْنِ عَمْرٍو، عَنْ إِبْرَاهِيمَ، قَالَ:
entries.matn_ar: " الصَّاعُ مِثْلُ الْحَجَّاجِيِّ "
entries.isnad_en: Isma'il informed us. He said: al-Hasan narrated to us. He said: Yahya narrated to us. He said: Abu Shihab narrated to us, from Hajjaj, from Fudayl b. 'Amr, from Ibrahim, who said:
entries.matn_en: The sa' is like the Hajjaji.

entries.label: Narration
entries.isnad_ar: أَخْبَرَنَا إِسْمَاعِيلُ، قَالَ: حَدَّثَنَا الْحَسَنُ، قَالَ: حَدَّثَنَا يَحْيَى، قَالَ: حَدَّثَنَا زُهَيْرُ بْنُ مُعَاوِيَةَ، عَنْ أَبِي إِسْحَاقَ، عَنْ رَجُلٍ سَمَّاهُ، عَنْ مُوسَى بْنِ طَلْحَةَ، قَالَ:
entries.matn_ar: " صَاعُ عُمَرَ - أَوْ قَالَ: قَفِيزُ عُمَرَ بْنِ الْخَطَّابِ مِثْلُ الْحَجَّاجِيِّ - "
entries.isnad_en: Isma'il informed us. He said: al-Hasan narrated to us. He said: Yahya narrated to us. He said: Zuhayr b. Mu'awiya narrated to us, from Abu Ishaq, from a man whom he named, from Musa b. Talha, who said:
entries.matn_en: The sa' of 'Umar—or he said: the qafiz of 'Umar b. al-Khattab—is like the Hajjaji.

entries.label: Narration
entries.isnad_ar: أَخْبَرَنَا إِسْمَاعِيلُ، قَالَ: حَدَّثَنَا الْحَسَنُ، قَالَ: حَدَّثَنَا يَحْيَى، قَالَ:
entries.matn_ar: قَالَ لِي إِسْرَائِيلُ: عَنْ أَبِي إِسْحَاقَ، قَالَ: قَدِمَ عَلَيْنَا الْحَجَّاجُ مِنَ الْمَدِينَةِ فَقَالَ: " إِنِّي قَدِ اتَّخَذْتُ لَكُمْ مَخْتُومًا عَلَى صَاعِ عُمَرَ بْنِ الْخَطَّابِ "
entries.isnad_en: Isma'il informed us. He said: al-Hasan narrated to us. He said: Yahya narrated to us. He said: He said: Isra'il said to me, from Abu Ishaq, who said:
entries.matn_en: Al-Hajjaj came to us from Medina and said: I have had a sealed (makhtum) measure made for you on the sa' of 'Umar b. al-Khattab.

entries.label: Narration
entries.isnad_ar: أَخْبَرَنَا إِسْمَاعِيلُ، قَالَ: حَدَّثَنَا الْحَسَنُ، قَالَ: حَدَّثَنَا يَحْيَى، قَالَ: حَدَّثَنَا زُهَيْرٌ، عَنْ يَحْيَى بْنِ سَعِيدٍ، قَالَ:
entries.matn_ar: " هَذَا صَاعَانِ بِالْأَوَّلِ ". قَالَ زُهَيْرٌ: فَقُدِّرَ بِهِ ، فَكَانَ اثْنَيْنِ بِالْحَجَّاجِيِّ إِنْ شَاءَ اللَّهُ
entries.isnad_en: Isma'il informed us. He said: al-Hasan narrated to us. He said: Yahya narrated to us. He said: Zuhayr narrated to us, from Yahya b. Sa'id, who said:
entries.matn_en: This is two sa's by the first [measure]. Zuhayr said: It was measured by it, and it came to two by the Hajjaji, God willing.

entries.label: Narration
entries.isnad_ar: أَخْبَرَنَا إِسْمَاعِيلُ، قَالَ: حَدَّثَنَا الْحَسَنُ، قَالَ: حَدَّثَنَا يَحْيَى، قَالَ: حَدَّثَنَا أَبُو شِهَابٍ، عَنِ ابْنِ أَبِي لَيْلَى، قَالَ:
entries.matn_ar: " الصَّاعُ مِثْلُ الْحَجَّاجِيِّ وَأَرْجَحُ شَيْئًا "
entries.isnad_en: Isma'il informed us. He said: al-Hasan narrated to us. He said: Yahya narrated to us. He said: Abu Shihab narrated to us, from Ibn Abi Layla, who said:
entries.matn_en: The sa' is like the Hajjaji, and slightly more.

entries.label: Narration
entries.isnad_ar: أَخْبَرَنَا إِسْمَاعِيلُ، قَالَ: حَدَّثَنَا الْحَسَنُ، قَالَ: حَدَّثَنَا يَحْيَى، قَالَ: حَدَّثَنَا جَرِيرُ بْنُ عَبْدِ الْحَمِيدِ، عَنْ يَزِيدَ بْنِ أَبِي زِيَادٍ، عَنْ عَبْدِ الرَّحْمَنِ بْنِ أَبِي لَيْلَى، قَالَ:
entries.matn_ar: " الصَّاعُ يَزِيدُ عَلَى الْحَجَّاجِيِّ مِكْيَالًا ". قَالَ جَرِيرٌ: أَظُنُّهُ يَعْنِي الْمِكْيَالَ، يَقُولَ: الرُّبُعُ
entries.isnad_en: Isma'il informed us. He said: al-Hasan narrated to us. He said: Yahya narrated to us. He said: Jarir b. 'Abd al-Hamid narrated to us, from Yazid b. Abi Ziyad, from 'Abd al-Rahman b. Abi Layla, who said:
entries.matn_en: The sa' exceeds the Hajjaji by a measure (mikyal). Jarir said: I think he means by ‘the measure’—he says: the quarter (al-rub').

entries.label: Narration
entries.isnad_ar: أَخْبَرَنَا إِسْمَاعِيلُ، قَالَ: حَدَّثَنَا الْحَسَنُ، قَالَ: حَدَّثَنَا يَحْيَى، قَالَ: سَمِعْتُ حَسَنَ بْنَ صَالِحٍ،
entries.matn_ar: وَسُفْيَانَ، فِي زَمَنِ أَبِي جَعْفَرٍ " فَأَمَرَانِي فِي كَفَّارَةِ الْيَمِينِ بِقَفِيزٍ، وَرُبُعٍ بِالْهَاشِمِيِّ - الْقَوْلُ حِنْطَةٌ - لِعَشَرَةِ مَسَاكِينَ، وَكَانَ اثْنَيْنِ وَثَلَاثِينَ رَطْلًا "
entries.isnad_en: Isma'il informed us. He said: al-Hasan narrated to us. He said: Yahya narrated to us. He said: He said:
entries.matn_en: I heard Hasan b. Salih and Sufyan, in the time of Abu Ja'far, and they both commanded me, for the expiation of an oath, [to give] a qafiz and a quarter by the Hashimi [measure]—the statement is: wheat—for ten poor persons, and it was thirty-two ratls.

sections.title_en: Chapter on Whoever Said: In What the Earth Brings Forth, Little or Much, There Is Ṣadaqa; Among Them Ibrāhīm and Others; and They Differed Regarding Ibrāhīm on It, and Regarding ʿAṭāʾ
sections.title_ar: بَابُ مَنْ قَالَ: فِيمَا أَخْرَجَتِ الْأَرْضُ قَلِيلٌ أَوْكَثِيرٌ الصَّدَقَةُ فَمِنْهُمْ إِبْرَاهِيمُ وَغَيْرُهُ، وَاخْتَلَفُوا عَنْ إِبْرَاهِيمَ فِيهِ، وَعَنْ عَطَاءٍ

entries.label: Narration
entries.isnad_ar: أَخْبَرَنَا إِسْمَاعِيلُ، قَالَ: حَدَّثَنَا الْحَسَنُ، قَالَ: حَدَّثَنَا يَحْيَى، قَالَ: حَدَّثَنَا الْحَسَنُ بْنُ صَالِحٍ، عَنْ مَنْصُورٍ، عَنْ إِبْرَاهِيمَ، قَالَ:
entries.matn_ar: " مَا أَخْرَجَتِ الْأَرْضُ فَفِيهِ الْعُشْرُ أَوْ نِصْفُ الْعُشْرِ"
entries.isnad_en: Isma'il informed us. He said: al-Hasan narrated to us. He said: Yahya narrated to us. He said: al-Hasan b. Salih narrated to us, from Mansur, from Ibrahim, who said:
entries.matn_en: On what the earth brings forth there is the tenth or the half-tenth.

entries.label: Narration
entries.matn_ar: أَخْبَرَنَا إِسْمَاعِيلُ، قَالَ: حَدَّثَنَا الْحَسَنُ، قَالَ: حَدَّثَنَا يَحْيَى، قَالَ: حَدَّثَنَا حَسَنٌ، عَنْ أَشْعَثَ، عَنْ عَطَاءٍ مِثْلَهُ
entries.isnad_en: Isma'il informed us. He said: al-Hasan narrated to us. He said: Yahya narrated to us. He said: Hasan narrated to us, from Ash'ath, from 'Ata',
entries.matn_en: The like of it.

entries.label: Narration
entries.isnad_ar: أَخْبَرَنَا إِسْمَاعِيلُ، قَالَ: حَدَّثَنَا الْحَسَنُ، قَالَ: حَدَّثَنَا يَحْيَى، قَالَ: حَدَّثَنَا شَرِيكٌ، عَنْ مَنْصُورٍ، عَنْ إِبْرَاهِيمَ، قَالَ:
entries.matn_ar: " فِي كُلِّ مَا أَخْرَجَتِ الْأَرْضُ الْعُشْرُ أَوْ نِصْفُ الْعُشْرِ "
entries.isnad_en: Isma'il informed us. He said: al-Hasan narrated to us. He said: Yahya narrated to us. He said: Sharik narrated to us, from Mansur, from Ibrahim, who said:
entries.matn_en: On everything the earth brings forth there is the tenth or the half-tenth.

entries.label: Narration
entries.isnad_ar: أَخْبَرَنَا إِسْمَاعِيلُ، قَالَ: حَدَّثَنَا الْحَسَنُ، قَالَ: حَدَّثَنَا يَحْيَى، قَالَ: حَدَّثَنَا حَفْصُ بْنُ غِيَاثٍ، عَنْ أَشْعَثَ، عَنِ الْحَكَمِ، وَحَمَّادٍ، عَنْ إِبْرَاهِيمَ، قَالَ:
entries.matn_ar: " فِيمَا أَخْرَجَتِ الْأَرْضُ مِنْ قَلِيلٍ أَوْ كَثِيرٍ فِيهِ الْعُشْرُ أَوْ نِصْفُ الْعُشْرِ "
entries.isnad_en: Isma'il informed us. He said: al-Hasan narrated to us. He said: Yahya narrated to us. He said: Hafs b. Ghiyath narrated to us, from Ash'ath, from al-Hakam and Hammad, from Ibrahim, who said:
entries.matn_en: On what the earth brings forth, whether little or much, there is the tenth or the half-tenth.

entries.label: Narration
entries.isnad_ar: أَخْبَرَنَا إِسْمَاعِيلُ، قَالَ: حَدَّثَنَا الْحَسَنُ، قَالَ: حَدَّثَنَا يَحْيَى، قَالَ: حَدَّثَنَا الْحَسَنُ بْنُ عَيَّاشٍ، عَنْ أَشْعَثَ، عَنِ الْحَكَمِ، وَحَمَّادٍ، عَنْ إِبْرَاهِيمَ، قَالَ:
entries.matn_ar: " فِي كُلِّ شَيْءٍ أَخْرَجَتِ الْأَرْضُ الصَّدَقَةُ: الْعُشْرُ وَنِصْفُ الْعُشْرِ "
entries.isnad_en: Isma'il informed us. He said: al-Hasan narrated to us. He said: Yahya narrated to us. He said: al-Hasan b. 'Ayyash narrated to us, from Ash'ath, from al-Hakam and Hammad, from Ibrahim, who said:
entries.matn_en: On everything the earth brings forth there is sadaqa: the tenth and the half-tenth.

entries.label: Narration
entries.isnad_ar: أَخْبَرَنَا إِسْمَاعِيلُ، قَالَ: حَدَّثَنَا الْحَسَنُ، قَالَ: حَدَّثَنَا يَحْيَى، قَالَ: حَدَّثَنَا عَبْدُ الرَّحِيمِ، عَنْ أَشْعَثَ، عَنْ حَمَّادٍ، عَنْ إِبْرَاهِيمَ، قَالَ:
entries.matn_ar: " فِي كُلِّ قَلِيلٍ أَوْ كَثِيرٍ أَنْبَتَتِ الْأَرْضُ صَدَقَةٌ: الْعُشْرُ أَوْ نِصْفُ الْعُشْرِ" ⦗ص: 141⦘
entries.isnad_en: Isma'il informed us. He said: al-Hasan narrated to us. He said: Yahya narrated to us. He said: 'Abd al-Rahim narrated to us, from Ash'ath, from Hammad, from Ibrahim, who said:
entries.matn_en: On everything, little or much, that the earth causes to grow there is sadaqa: the tenth or the half-tenth. [p. 141]

entries.label: Narration
entries.matn_ar: حَدَّثَنِي ابْنُ عَيَّاشٍ، وَعَبْدُ الرَّحِيمِ، عَنْ أَشْعَثَ، عَنْ عَطَاءٍ مِثْلَهُ
entries.isnad_en: Ibn 'Ayyash and 'Abd al-Rahim narrated to me, from Ash'ath, from 'Ata',
entries.matn_en: The like of it.

entries.label: Narration
entries.matn_ar: أَخْبَرَنَا إِسْمَاعِيلُ، قَالَ: حَدَّثَنَا الْحَسَنُ، قَالَ: حَدَّثَنَا يَحْيَى، قَالَ: أَخْبَرَنَا إِسْمَاعِيلُ، قَالَ: حَدَّثَنَا الْحَسَنُ، قَالَ: حَدَّثَنَا يَحْيَى، قَالَ: حَدَّثَنَا أَيُّوبُ بْنُ جَابِرٍ، عَنْ حَمَّادٍ، عَنْ إِبْرَاهِيمَ مِثْلَهُ
entries.isnad_en: Isma'il informed us. He said: al-Hasan narrated to us. He said: Yahya narrated to us. He said: Isma'il informed us. He said: al-Hasan narrated to us. He said: Yahya narrated to us. He said: Ayyub b. Jabir narrated to us, from Hammad, from Ibrahim,
entries.matn_en: The like of it.

entries.label: Narration
entries.isnad_ar: أَخْبَرَنَا إِسْمَاعِيلُ، قَالَ: حَدَّثَنَا الْحَسَنُ، قَالَ: حَدَّثَنَا يَحْيَى، قَالَ: حَدَّثَنَا ابْنُ أَبِي زَائِدَةَ، عَنْ مُجَالِدٍ، عَنْ أَبِي بُرْدَةَ، قَالَ:
entries.matn_ar: " فِي الرُّطَبَةِ صَدَقَةٌ، وَقَدْ قَالَ بَعْضُهُمْ: فِي دَسْتَجَةٍ مِنْ بَقْلٍ "
entries.isnad_en: Isma'il informed us. He said: al-Hasan narrated to us. He said: Yahya narrated to us. He said: Ibn Abi Za'ida narrated to us, from Mujalid, from Abu Burda, who said:
entries.matn_en: On fresh herbage (al-rutba) there is sadaqa; and some of them have said: on a bundle (dastaja) of vegetables.

entries.label: Narration
entries.isnad_ar: أَخْبَرَنَا إِسْمَاعِيلُ، قَالَ: حَدَّثَنَا الْحَسَنُ، قَالَ: حَدَّثَنَا يَحْيَى، قَالَ: حَدَّثَنَا سَعِيدُ بْنُ سَالِمِ بْنِ أَبِي الْهَيْفَاءِ، عَنْ الصَّلْتِ بْنِ دِينَارٍ، عَنْ أَبِي رَجَاءٍ الْعُطَارِدِيِّ، قَالَ:
entries.matn_ar: كَانَ ابْنُ عَبَّاسٍ بِالْبَصْرَةِ، " يَأْخُذُ صَدَقَاتِهَا ، حَتَّى دَسَاتِجَ الْكُرَّاثِ "
entries.isnad_en: Isma'il informed us. He said: al-Hasan narrated to us. He said: Yahya narrated to us. He said: Sa'id b. Salim b. Abi al-Hayfa' narrated to us, from al-Salt b. Dinar, from Abu Raja' al-'Utaridi, who said:
entries.matn_en: Ibn 'Abbas was in Basra, taking its sadaqas, even bundles of leeks (kurrath).

entries.label: Narration
entries.isnad_ar: أَخْبَرَنَا إِسْمَاعِيلُ، قَالَ: حَدَّثَنَا الْحَسَنُ، قَالَ: حَدَّثَنَا يَحْيَى، قَالَ: حَدَّثَنَا يُونُسُ، عَنْ أَبِي حَنِيفَةَ، عَنْ حَمَّادٍ، عَنْ إِبْرَاهِيمَ، قَالَ:
entries.matn_ar: " فِي كُلِّ شَيْءٍ أَخْرَجَتِ الْأَرْضُ وَلَوْ كَانَ دَسْتَجَةَ بَقْلٍ فَمَا فَوْقَهَا الْعُشْرُ "
entries.isnad_en: Isma'il informed us. He said: al-Hasan narrated to us. He said: Yahya narrated to us. He said: Yunus narrated to us, from Abu Hanifa, from Hammad, from Ibrahim, who said:
entries.matn_en: On everything the earth brings forth, even if it be a bundle of greens (dastajat baql) or more, the tenth is due.

entries.label: Narration
entries.isnad_ar: أَخْبَرَنَا إِسْمَاعِيلُ، قَالَ: حَدَّثَنَا الْحَسَنُ، قَالَ: حَدَّثَنَا يَحْيَى، قَالَ: حَدَّثَنَا ابْنُ مُبَارَكٍ، عَنْ يُونُسَ، عَنِ الزُّهْرِيِّ، قَالَ:
entries.matn_ar: " مَا كَانَ سِوَى الْقَمْحِ وَالشَّعِيرِ وَالنَّخْلِ وَالْعِنَبِ وَالسُّلْتِ وَالزَّيْتُونِ، فَإِنِّي أَرَى أَنْ تُخْرَجَ صَدَقَةٌ مِنْ أَثْمَانِهِ "، قَالَ: " وَالْقِطْنِيَّةُ: هُوَ الْعَدْسُ وَالْحِمَّصُ وَالْحُبُوبُ، يُسَمِّيهَا أَهْلُ الْمَدِينَةِ: قِطْنِيَّةً، وَيَقُولُ أَهْلُ الشَّامِ: الْقِطَانِيُّ لَهَا أَيْضًا "
entries.isnad_en: Isma'il informed us. He said: al-Hasan narrated to us. He said: Yahya narrated to us. He said: Ibn Mubarak narrated to us, from Yunus, from al-Zuhri, who said:
entries.matn_en: As for whatever is other than wheat, barley, palm, grapes, sult and olives, I hold that sadaqa be taken out of their prices. He said: And the qitniyya is lentils, chickpeas and the [other] grains; the people of Medina call it qitniyya, and the people of Syria likewise say al-qatani for it.

entries.label: Narration
entries.isnad_ar: أَخْبَرَنَا إِسْمَاعِيلُ، قَالَ: حَدَّثَنَا الْحَسَنُ، قَالَ: حَدَّثَنَا يَحْيَى، قَالَ: ⦗ص: 142⦘ حَدَّثَنَا إِسْمَاعِيلُ بْنُ عَيَّاشٍ الشَّامِيُّ، عَنْ عَطَاءٍ الْخُرَاسَانِيِّ، لَيْسَ فِي الْخُضَرِ وَالْجَوْزِ وَاللَّوْزِ وَالْفَاكِهَةِ كُلِّهَا عُشْرٌ، قَالَ:
entries.matn_ar: " فَمَا بِيعَ مِنْهُ ، فَبَلَغَ مِائَتَيْ دِرْهَمٍ فَصَاعِدًا ، فَفِيهِ الزَّكَاةُ".
entries.isnad_en: Isma'il informed us. He said: al-Hasan narrated to us. He said: Yahya narrated to us. He said: He said: [p. 142] Isma'il b. 'Ayyash al-Shami narrated to us, from 'Ata' al-Khurasani:
entries.matn_en: There is no tenth on greens, walnuts, almonds and fruit of all kinds. He said: Whatever of it is sold and reaches two hundred dirhams or more, zakat is due on it.

entries.label: Narration
entries.matn_ar: أَخْبَرَنَا إِسْمَاعِيلُ، قَالَ: حَدَّثَنَا الْحَسَنُ، قَالَ: حَدَّثَنَا يَحْيَى، قَالَ: حَدَّثَنَا إِسْمَاعِيلُ بْنُ عَيَّاشٍ، عَنْ عَبْدِ الْعَزِيزِ بْنِ عُبَيْدِ اللَّهِ، عَنِ الشَّعْبِيِّ نَحْوَهُ.
entries.isnad_en: Isma'il informed us. He said: al-Hasan narrated to us. He said: Yahya narrated to us. He said: Isma'il b. 'Ayyash narrated to us, from 'Abd al-'Aziz b. 'Ubayd Allah, from al-Sha'bi,
entries.matn_en: The like of it.

entries.label: Narration
entries.isnad_ar: قَالَ يَحْيَى:
entries.matn_ar: " وَمَا عَلِمْتُ أَحَدًا مِنْ أَصْحَابِنَا يَعْرِفُ هَذَا مِنْ قَوْلِ الشَّعْبِيِّ، وَقَدْ سَمِعْنَا عَنْهُ خِلَافَهُ وَهُوَ فِي هَذَا الْكِتَابِ "
entries.isnad_en: Yahya said:
entries.matn_en: I do not know any of our companions who knows this from the saying of al-Sha'bi; we have heard from him the opposite, and it is in this book.

sections.title_en: Chapter: Whoever Said: Ṣadaqa Is Due Only on Wheat, Barley, Dates and Raisins Specifically, and There Is No Ṣadaqa in…
sections.title_ar: بَابٌ: مَنْ قَالَ: الصَّدَقَةُ فِي الْحِنْطَةِ وَالشَّعِيرِ وَالتَّمْرِ وَالزَّبِيبِ خَاصَّةً ، وَلَيْسَ فِي صَدَقَةٍ

entries.label: Narration
entries.matn_ar: قال يحيى: وَالْخُضَرُ عِنْدَنَا: الرِّطَابُ، وَالرَّيَاحِينُ، وَالْبُقُولُ، وَالْفَاكِهَةُ، مِثْلُ الْكُمَّثْرَى وَالسَّفَرْجَلِ وَالْخَوْخِ، وَالتُّفَّاحِ، وَالتِّينِ، وَالْإِجَّاصِ، وَالْمِشْمِشِ، وَالرُّمَّانِ، وَالْخِيَارِ، وَالْقِثَّاءِ، وَالنَّبْقِ، وَالْبَاقِلَّى ، وَالْجَزَرِ، وَالْمَوْزِ، وَالْمُقْلِ، وَالْجَوْزِ، وَاللَّوْزِ، وَالْبِطِّيخِ، وَأَشْبَاهِهِ "
entries.isnad_en: Yahya said:
entries.matn_en: And the greens (al-khudar), in our usage, are: the fresh produce (al-ritab), the fragrant herbs (al-rayahin), the vegetables (al-buqul), and the fruits, such as pear (kummathra), quince (safarjal), peach (khawkh), apple (tuffah), fig (tin), plum (ijjas), apricot (mishmish), pomegranate (rumman), cucumber (khiyar), qiththa', nabq, broad beans (baqilla), carrots (jazar), banana (mawz), muql, walnut, almond, watermelon (bittikh), and the like.

entries.label: Narration
entries.matn_ar: قَالَ يَحْيَى، قَالَ حَسَنُ بْنُ صَالِحٍ: الصَّدَقَةُ فِي الْحِنْطَةِ وَالشَّعِيرِ وَالتَّمْرِ ⦗ص: 143⦘ وَالزَّبِيبِ، وَقَالَ: هَذَا الَّذِي سَمِعْنَا أَنَّ رَسُولَ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم " فَرَضَ فِيهِ الصَّدَقَةَ، وَلَمْ يَرَ حَسَنٌ فِيمَا سِوَى ذَلِكَ صَدَقَةً مِنْ ذُرَةٍ وَلَا غَيْرِهَا".
entries.isnad_en: Yahya said: Hasan b. Salih said:
entries.matn_en: Sadaqa is on wheat, barley, dates [p. 143] and raisins; and he said: This is what we have heard, that the Messenger of God ﷺ made sadaqa obligatory on it. And Hasan did not consider that there was sadaqa on anything other than that, whether sorghum (dhura) or anything else.

entries.label: Narration
entries.matn_ar: قَالَ يَحْيَى، وَحَدَّثَنَا الْأَشْجَعِيُّ، عَنْ سُفْيَانَ مِثْلَهُ
entries.isnad_en: Yahya said: And al-Ashja'i narrated to us, from Sufyan,
entries.matn_en: The like of it.

entries.label: Narration
entries.matn_ar: قَالَ يَحْيَى: وَسَأَلْتُ شَرِيكًا عَنِ الْأَرُزِّ، وَالْحُبُوبِ، فِيهِ صَدَقَةٌ؟ فَقَالَ: كَانَ إِبْرَاهِيمُ يَقُولُ: " إِنَّ فِي هَذَا كُلِّهِ " - يَعْنِي: صَدَقَةً -
entries.isnad_en: Yahya said:
entries.matn_en: And I asked Sharik about rice and the [other] grains: is there sadaqa on it? He said: Ibrahim used to say: Indeed in all of this—meaning: sadaqa.

entries.label: Narration
entries.isnad_ar: قَالَ يَحْيَى، قَالَ شَرِيكٌ: وَكَانَ مُوسَى بْنُ طَلْحَةَ يَذْكُرُ أَنَّ فِي الْكِتَابِ إِلَى عَمْرِو بْنِ حَزْمٍ:
entries.matn_ar: " أَنَّ الصَّدَقَةَ فِي الْأَرْبَعَةِ الْأَشْيَاءِ: الْحِنْطَةِ، وَالشَّعِيرِ، وَالتَّمْرِ، وَالزَّبِيبِ ". قَالَ شَرِيكٌ: فَصَدَّقَهُ الْحَجَّاجُ ، وَعَامَلَ النَّاسَ بِذَلِكَ
entries.isnad_en: Yahya said: Sharik said:
entries.matn_en: Musa b. Talha used to mention that in the letter to 'Amr b. Hazm: Sadaqa is on four things: wheat, barley, dates and raisins. Sharik said: And al-Hajjaj confirmed it, and dealt with the people accordingly.

entries.label: Narration
entries.isnad_ar: أَخْبَرَنَا إِسْمَاعِيلُ، قَالَ: حَدَّثَنَا الْحَسَنُ، قَالَ: حَدَّثَنَا يَحْيَى، قَالَ: حَدَّثَنَا أَبُو بَكْرِ بْنُ عَيَّاشٍ، عَنْ مُغِيرَةَ، قَالَ: كَتَبَ عَامِلُ الْحَجَّاجِ،
entries.matn_ar: مُوسَى بْنُ الْمُغِيرَةِ، إِلَى الْحَجَّاجِ: أَنَّ مُوسَى بْنَ طَلْحَةَ، يَقُولُ: " لَيْسَ فِي شَيْءٍ مِنَ الْبُقُولِ وَلَا مَا يَحِيلُ فِي أَيْدِي النَّاسِ صَدَقَةٌ "، قَالَ: فَقَالَ الْحَجَّاجُ: " صَدَقَ "
entries.isnad_en: Isma'il informed us. He said: al-Hasan narrated to us. He said: Yahya narrated to us. He said: Abu Bakr b. 'Ayyash narrated to us, from Mughira, who said:
entries.matn_en: Al-Hajjaj's governor, Musa b. al-Mughira, wrote to al-Hajjaj: Musa b. Talha says: There is no sadaqa on any of the vegetables, nor on what spoils (ma yahilu) in people's hands. He said: So al-Hajjaj said: He has spoken truly.

entries.label: Narration
entries.isnad_ar: أَخْبَرَنَا إِسْمَاعِيلُ، قَالَ: حَدَّثَنَا الْحَسَنُ، قَالَ: حَدَّثَنَا يَحْيَى، قَالَ: حَدَّثَنَا عَبْدُ السَّلَامِ بْنُ حَرْبٍ، عَنْ عَطَاءِ بْنِ السَّائِبِ، قَالَ:
entries.matn_ar: أَرَادَ مُوسَى بْنُ الْمُغِيرَةِ أَنْ يَأْخُذَ مِنْ خُضَرِ أَرْضِ مُوسَى بْنِ طَلْحَةَ، فَقَالَ لَهُ مُوسَى بْنُ طَلْحَةَ: إِنَّهُ لَيْسَ فِي الْخُضَرِ شَيْءٌ، وَرَوَاهُ عَنْ رَسُولِ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم. قَالَ: فَكَتَبُوا بِذَلِكَ إِلَى الْحَجَّاجِ، فَكَتَبَ الْحَجَّاجُ: أَنَّ مُوسَى بْنَ طَلْحَةَ أَعْلَمُ مِنْ مُوسَى بْنِ الْمُغِيرَةِ
entries.isnad_en: Isma'il informed us. He said: al-Hasan narrated to us. He said: Yahya narrated to us. He said: 'Abd al-Salam b. Harb narrated to us, from 'Ata' b. al-Sa'ib, who said:
entries.matn_en: Musa b. al-Mughira wished to take [sadaqa] from the greens of the land of Musa b. Talha, and Musa b. Talha said to him: There is nothing on greens; and he related it from the Messenger of God ﷺ. He said: So they wrote about that to al-Hajjaj, and al-Hajjaj wrote: Musa b. Talha knows better than Musa b. al-Mughira.

entries.label: Narration
entries.isnad_ar: أَخْبَرَنَا إِسْمَاعِيلُ، قَالَ: حَدَّثَنَا الْحَسَنُ، قَالَ: حَدَّثَنَا يَحْيَى، قَالَ: حَدَّثَنَا حَفْصُ بْنُ غِيَاثٍ، عَنْ عَمْرِو بْنِ عُثْمَانَ بْنِ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ بْنِ مَوْهَبٍ، عَنْ مُوسَى بْنِ طَلْحَةَ، قَالَ:
entries.matn_ar: فَرَضَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم الصَّدَقَةَ فِي الْحِنْطَةِ وَالشَّعِيرِ وَالتَّمْرِ وَالزَّبِيبِ ". قَالَ عَمْرُو بْنُ عُثْمَانَ: وَالزَّبِيبِ ، أَوْ قَالَ: الْعِنَبِ
entries.isnad_en: Isma'il informed us. He said: al-Hasan narrated to us. He said: Yahya narrated to us. He said: Hafs b. Ghiyath narrated to us, from 'Amr b. 'Uthman b. 'Abd Allah b. Mawhab, from Musa b. Talha, who said:
entries.matn_en: The Messenger of God ﷺ made sadaqa obligatory on wheat, barley, dates and raisins. 'Amr b. 'Uthman said: And raisins—or he said: grapes.

entries.label: Narration
entries.matn_ar: قَالَ حَفْصٌ: أَحَدُهُمَا الْعِنَبُ ، أَوِ الزَّبِيبُ ، وَالْحَبُّ: حَبُّ الْعِنَبِ
entries.isnad_en: Hafs said:
entries.matn_en: One of the two is grapes or raisins; and the ‘habb’ is the grape berry (habb al-'inab).

entries.label: Narration
entries.isnad_ar: أَخْبَرَنَا إِسْمَاعِيلُ، قَالَ: حَدَّثَنَا الْحَسَنُ، قَالَ: حَدَّثَنَا يَحْيَى، قَالَ: حَدَّثَنَا حَفْصُ بْنُ غِيَاثٍ، عَنْ لَيْثٍ، عَنِ الْحَكَمِ، عَنْ مُوسَى بْنِ طَلْحَةَ، قَالَ:
entries.matn_ar: " الصَّدَقَةُ فِي الْحِنْطَةِ وَالشَّعِيرِ وَالتَّمْرِ وَالزَّبِيبِ "
entries.isnad_en: Isma'il informed us. He said: al-Hasan narrated to us. He said: Yahya narrated to us. He said: Hafs b. Ghiyath narrated to us, from Layth, from al-Hakam, from Musa b. Talha, who said:
entries.matn_en: Sadaqa is on wheat, barley, dates and raisins.

entries.label: Narration
entries.isnad_ar: أَخْبَرَنَا إِسْمَاعِيلُ، قَالَ: حَدَّثَنَا الْحَسَنُ، قَالَ: حَدَّثَنَا يَحْيَى، قَالَ: حَدَّثَنَا وَكِيعٌ، عَنْ طَلْحَةَ بْنِ يَحْيَى، عَنْ مُوسَى بْنِ طَلْحَةَ،
entries.matn_ar: أَنَّ عَبْدَ الْحَمِيدِ، سَأَلَهُ ، فَقَالَ مُوسَى بْنُ طَلْحَةَ: " إِنَّمَا الصَّدَقَةُ فِي الْحِنْطَةِ، وَالشَّعِيرِ، وَالتَّمْرِ، وَالزَّبِيبِ "
entries.isnad_en: Isma'il informed us. He said: al-Hasan narrated to us. He said: Yahya narrated to us. He said: Waki' narrated to us, from Talha b. Yahya, from Musa b. Talha:
entries.matn_en: That 'Abd al-Hamid asked him, and Musa b. Talha said: Sadaqa is only on wheat, barley, dates and raisins.

entries.label: Narration
entries.isnad_ar: أَخْبَرَنَا إِسْمَاعِيلُ، قَالَ: حَدَّثَنَا الْحَسَنُ، قَالَ: حَدَّثَنَا يَحْيَى، قَالَ: حَدَّثَنَا يَزِيدُ بْنُ عَبْدِ الْعَزِيزِ، عَنْ عَمْرِو بْنِ عُثْمَانَ بْنِ مَوْهَبٍ، قَالَ: سَمِعْتُ مُوسَى بْنَ طَلْحَةَ يَقُولُ:
entries.matn_ar: بَعَثَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم مُعَاذًا عَلَى صَدَقَاتِ الْيَمَنِ، وَأَمَرَهُ أَنْ يَأْخُذَ مِنَ الْحِنْطَةِ، وَالشَّعِيرِِ، وَالنَّخْلِ وَالْعِنَبِ - أَوْ قاَلَ الزَّبِيبِ - الْعُشْرَ وَنِصْفَ الْعُشْرِ. "
entries.isnad_en: Isma'il informed us. He said: al-Hasan narrated to us. He said: Yahya narrated to us. He said: Yazid b. 'Abd al-'Aziz narrated to us, from 'Amr b. 'Uthman b. Mawhab, who said: I heard Musa b. Talha say:
entries.matn_en: The Messenger of God ﷺ sent Mu'adh over the sadaqas of Yemen, and commanded him to take from wheat, barley, palm and grapes—or he said: raisins—the tenth and the half-tenth.

entries.label: Narration
entries.isnad_ar: أَخْبَرَنَا إِسْمَاعِيلُ، قَالَ: حَدَّثَنَا الْحَسَنُ، قَالَ: حَدَّثَنَا يَحْيَى، قَالَ: حَدَّثَنَا وَكِيعٌ، قَالَ: حَدَّثَنَا عَمْرُو بْنُ عُثْمَانَ، عَنْ مُوسَى بْنِ طَلْحَةَ،
entries.matn_ar: أَنَّ مُعَاذًا " أَتَى الْيَمَنَ ، فَلَمْ يَأْخُذِ الصَّدَقَةَ إِلَّا مِنَ الْحِنْطَةَ، وَالشَّعِيرَ، وَالتَّمْرَ، وَالزَّبِيبَ "
entries.isnad_en: Isma'il informed us. He said: al-Hasan narrated to us. He said: Yahya narrated to us. He said: Waki' narrated to us. He said: 'Amr b. 'Uthman narrated to us, from Musa b. Talha:
entries.matn_en: That Mu'adh came to Yemen and did not take sadaqa except from wheat, barley, dates and raisins.

entries.label: Unnumbered report
entries.isnad_ar: أَخْبَرَنَا إِسْمَاعِيلُ، قَالَ: حَدَّثَنَا الْحَسَنُ، قَالَ: حَدَّثَنَا يَحْيَى، قَالَ: حَدَّثَنَا عَبْدُ الرَّحِيمِ، قَالَ: حَدَّثَنَا عَمْرو بْنُ عُثْمَانَ بْنِ مَوْهَبٍ، قَالَ: سَمِعْتُ مُوسَى بْنَ طَلْحَةَ، قَالَ:
entries.matn_ar: " بَعَثَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم مُعَاذًا إِلَى الْيَمَنِ عَلَى الصَّدَقَةِ، وَأَمَرَهُ أَنْ يَأْخُذَ الصَّدَقَةَ مِنَ الْحِنْطَةِ وَالشَّعِيرِ ، وَالنَّخْلِ "
entries.isnad_en: Isma'il informed us. He said: al-Hasan narrated to us. He said: Yahya narrated to us. He said: 'Abd al-Rahim narrated to us. He said: 'Amr b. 'Uthman b. Mawhab narrated to us. He said: I heard Musa b. Talha say:
entries.matn_en: The Messenger of God ﷺ sent Mu'adh to Yemen over the sadaqa, and commanded him to take sadaqa from wheat, barley and palm.

entries.label: Narration
entries.isnad_ar: أَخْبَرَنَا إِسْمَاعِيلُ، قَالَ: حَدَّثَنَا الْحَسَنُ، قَالَ: حَدَّثَنَا يَحْيَى، قَالَ: حَدَّثَنَا ابْنُ أَبِي زَائِدَةَ، عَنْ عَمْرِو بْنِ عُثْمَانَ، عَنْ مُوسَى بْنِ طَلْحَةَ، قَالَ:
entries.matn_ar: بَعَثَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم: مُعَاذًا إِلَى الْيَمَنِ، وَأَمَرَهُ أَنْ يَأْخُذَ الصَّدَقَةَ مِنَ الْحِنْطَةِ وَالشَّعِيرِ وَالتَّمْرِ وَالْعِنَبِ
entries.isnad_en: Isma'il informed us. He said: al-Hasan narrated to us. He said: Yahya narrated to us. He said: Ibn Abi Za'ida narrated to us, from 'Amr b. 'Uthman, from Musa b. Talha, who said:
entries.matn_en: The Messenger of God ﷺ sent Mu'adh to Yemen, and commanded him to take sadaqa from wheat, barley, dates and grapes.

entries.label: Narration
entries.isnad_ar: أَخْبَرَنَا إِسْمَاعِيلُ، قَالَ: حَدَّثَنَا الْحَسَنُ، قَالَ: حَدَّثَنَا يَحْيَى، قَالَ: حَدَّثَنَا عَبْدُ الرَّحِيمِ، عَنْ حَجَّاجِ بْنِ أَرْطَاةَ، عَنْ عَمْرِو بْنِ عُثْمَانَ بْنِ مَوْهَبٍ، عَنْ مُوسَى بْنِ طَلْحَةَ، ⦗ص: 145⦘ قَالَ:
entries.matn_ar: " بَعَثَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم مُعَاذًا إِلَى الْيَمَنِ، ، وَأَمَرَهُ أَنْ يَأْخُذَ الصَّدَقَةَ مِنَ الْحِنْطَةِ، وَالشَّعِيرِ، وَالتَّمْرِ، وَالزَّبِيبِ "
entries.isnad_en: Isma'il informed us. He said: al-Hasan narrated to us. He said: Yahya narrated to us. He said: 'Abd al-Rahim narrated to us, from Hajjaj b. Artat, from 'Amr b. 'Uthman b. Mawhab, from Musa b. Talha, [p. 145] who said:
entries.matn_en: The Messenger of God ﷺ sent Mu'adh to Yemen, and commanded him to take sadaqa from wheat, barley, dates and raisins.

entries.label: Narration
entries.isnad_ar: أَخْبَرَنَا إِسْمَاعِيلُ، قَالَ: حَدَّثَنَا الْحَسَنُ، قَالَ: حَدَّثَنَا يَحْيَى، قَالَ: حَدَّثَنَا شَرِيكٌ، عَنِ ابْنِ أَبِي لَيْلَى، عَنْ عَمْرِو بْنِ مُرَّةَ، عَنْ أَبِي الْبَخْتَرِيِّ، عَنْ أَبِي سَعِيدٍ الْخُدْرِيِّ، رَفَعَهُ إِلَى النَّبِيِّ صلى الله عليه وسلم أَنَّهُ قَالَ:
entries.matn_ar: " لَيْسَ فِيمَا دُونَ خَمْسَةِ أَوْسَاقٍ مِنَ الْحِنْطَةِ، وَالشَّعِيرِ، وَالتَّمْرِ، وَالزَّبِيبِ صَدَقَةٌ تُؤْخَذُ "
entries.isnad_en: Isma'il informed us. He said: al-Hasan narrated to us. He said: Yahya narrated to us. He said: Sharik narrated to us, from Ibn Abi Layla, from 'Amr b. Murra, from Abu al-Bakhtari, from Abu Sa'id al-Khudri, attributing it to the Prophet ﷺ, that he said:
entries.matn_en: There is no sadaqa that is taken on less than five awsaq of wheat, barley, dates and raisins.

entries.label: Narration
entries.isnad_ar: أَخْبَرَنَا إِسْمَاعِيلُ، قَالَ: حَدَّثَنَا الْحَسَنُ، قَالَ: حَدَّثَنَا يَحْيَى، قَالَ: حَدَّثَنَا أَبُو شِهَابٍ، عَنِ ابْنِ أَبِي لَيْلَى، عَنْ عَمْرِو بْنِ مُرَّةَ، عَنْ أَبِي الْبَخْتَرِيِّ، عَنْ أَبِي سَعِيدٍ الْخُدْرِيِّ، يَرْفَعُهُ إِلَى النَّبِيِّ صلى الله عليه وسلم قَالَ:
entries.matn_ar: " لَيْسَ فِي أَقَلَّ مِنْ خَمْسَةِ أَوْسَاقٍ مِنَ الْحِنْطَةِ، وَالشَّعِيرِ، وَالتَّمْرِ، وَالزَّبِيبِ شَيْءٌ "
entries.isnad_en: Isma'il informed us. He said: al-Hasan narrated to us. He said: Yahya narrated to us. He said: Abu Shihab narrated to us, from Ibn Abi Layla, from 'Amr b. Murra, from Abu al-Bakhtari, from Abu Sa'id al-Khudri, attributing it to the Prophet ﷺ, who said:
entries.matn_en: There is nothing due on less than five awsaq of wheat, barley, dates and raisins.

entries.label: Narration
entries.isnad_ar: أَخْبَرَنَا إِسْمَاعِيلُ، قَالَ: حَدَّثَنَا الْحَسَنُ، قَالَ: حَدَّثَنَا يَحْيَى، قَالَ: حَدَّثَنَا سُفْيَانُ بْنُ عُيَيْنَةَ، عَنْ عَمْرِو بْنِ عُبَيْدٍ، عَنِ الْحَسَنِ، قَالَ:
entries.matn_ar: " لَمْ يَفْرِضْ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم الصَّدَقَةَ إِلَّا فِي عَشَرَةِ أَشْيَاءَ: الْإِبِلِ، وَالْبَقَرِ، وَالْغَنَمِ، وَالذَّهَبِ، وَالْفِضَّةِ، وَالْحِنْطَةِ، وَالشَّعِيرِ، وَالتَّمْرِ، وَالزَّبِيبِ ". قَالَ ابْنُ عُيَيْنَةَ: وَأُرَاهُ قَالَ: وَالذُّرَةِ
entries.isnad_en: Isma'il informed us. He said: al-Hasan narrated to us. He said: Yahya narrated to us. He said: Sufyan b. 'Uyayna narrated to us, from 'Amr b. 'Ubayd, from al-Hasan, who said:
entries.matn_en: The Messenger of God ﷺ made sadaqa obligatory on only ten things: camels, cattle, sheep, gold, silver, wheat, barley, dates and raisins. Ibn 'Uyayna said: And I think he said: and sorghum (dhura).

entries.label: Narration
entries.isnad_ar: أَخْبَرَنَا إِسْمَاعِيلُ، قَالَ: حَدَّثَنَا الْحَسَنُ، قَالَ: حَدَّثَنَا يَحْيَى، قَالَ: حَدَّثَنَا أَبُو بَكْرِ بْنُ عَيَّاشٍ، عَنِ الْأَجْلَحِ، عَنِ الشَّعْبِيِّ، قَالَ: كَتَبَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم إِلَى أَهْلِ الْيَمَنِ: "
entries.matn_ar: إِنَّمَا الصَّدَقَةُ فِي الْحِنْطَةِ، وَالشَّعِيرِ، وَالتَّمْرِ، وَالزَّبِيبِ "
entries.isnad_en: Isma'il informed us. He said: al-Hasan narrated to us. He said: Yahya narrated to us. He said: Abu Bakr b. 'Ayyash narrated to us, from al-Ajlah, from al-Sha'bi, who said:
entries.matn_en: The Messenger of God ﷺ wrote to the people of Yemen: Sadaqa is only on wheat, barley, dates and raisins.

entries.label: Narration
entries.isnad_ar: أَخْبَرَنَا إِسْمَاعِيلُ، قَالَ: حَدَّثَنَا الْحَسَنُ، قَالَ: حَدَّثَنَا يَحْيَى، قَالَ: حَدَّثَنَا عَبْدُ الرَّحِيمِ، عَنِ الْأَجْلَحِ، عَنِ الشَّعْبِيِّ، قَالَ: " كَتَبَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم إِلَى أَهْلِ الْيَمَنِ فِي الزَّكَاةِ فِي الْحِنْطَةِ،
entries.matn_ar: وَالشَّعِيرِ، وَالتَّمْرِ "
entries.isnad_en: Isma'il informed us. He said: al-Hasan narrated to us. He said: Yahya narrated to us. He said: 'Abd al-Rahim narrated to us, from al-Ajlah, from al-Sha'bi, who said:
entries.matn_en: The Messenger of God ﷺ wrote to the people of Yemen concerning zakat on wheat, barley and dates.

entries.label: Narration
entries.isnad_ar: أَخْبَرَنَا إِسْمَاعِيلُ، قَالَ: حَدَّثَنَا الْحَسَنُ، قَالَ: حَدَّثَنَا يَحْيَى، قَالَ: حَدَّثَنَا عَتَّابٌ الْجَزَرِيُّ، عَنْ خُصَيْفٍ، عَنْ مُجَاهِدٍ، قَالَ:
entries.matn_ar: " لَمْ تَكُنِ الصَّدَقَةُ فِي عَهْدِ رَسُولِ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم إِلَّا فِي خَمْسَةِ أَشْيَاءَ: الْحِنْطَةِ، وَالشَّعِيرِ، وَالتَّمْرِ، وَالزَّبِيبِ، وَالذُّرَةِ "
entries.isnad_en: Isma'il informed us. He said: al-Hasan narrated to us. He said: Yahya narrated to us. He said: 'Attab al-Jazari narrated to us, from Khusayf, from Mujahid, who said:
entries.matn_en: Sadaqa, in the time of the Messenger of God ﷺ, was only on five things: wheat, barley, dates, raisins and sorghum (dhura).

entries.label: Narration
entries.isnad_ar: أَخْبَرَنَا إِسْمَاعِيلُ، قَالَ: حَدَّثَنَا الْحَسَنُ، قَالَ: حَدَّثَنَا يَحْيَى، قَالَ: حَدَّثَنَا أَبُو حَمَّادٍ - يَعْنِي: الْحَنَفِيَّ -، عَنْ أَبَانَ، عَنْ أَنَسٍ، قَالَ:
entries.matn_ar: " لَمْ يَفْرِضْ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم الصَّدَقَةَ إِلَّا مِنَ الْحِنْطَةِ، وَالشَّعِيرِ، وَالتَّمْرِ، وَالْأَعْنَابِ "
entries.isnad_en: Isma'il informed us. He said: al-Hasan narrated to us. He said: Yahya narrated to us. He said: Abu Hammad—meaning al-Hanafi—narrated to us, from Aban, from Anas, who said:
entries.matn_en: The Messenger of God ﷺ did not make sadaqa obligatory except on wheat, barley, dates and grapes.

entries.label: Narration
entries.isnad_ar: أَخْبَرَنَا إِسْمَاعِيلُ، قَالَ: حَدَّثَنَا الْحَسَنُ، قَالَ: حَدَّثَنَا يَحْيَى، قَالَ: حَدَّثَنَا عَبْدُ الرَّحِيمِ، عَنْ أَشْعَثَ، عَنِ الشَّعْبِيِّ، قَالَ:
entries.matn_ar: " الصَّدَقَةُ فِيمَا أَخْرَجَتِ الْأَرْضُ مِنَ الْحِنْطَةِ، وَالشَّعِيرِ، وَالزَّبِيبِ " قَالَ: قَالَ عَامِرٌ: يَرَوْنَ أَنَّ الذُّرَةَ مِنْهَا
entries.isnad_en: Isma'il informed us. He said: al-Hasan narrated to us. He said: Yahya narrated to us. He said: 'Abd al-Rahim narrated to us, from Ash'ath, from al-Sha'bi, who said:
entries.matn_en: Sadaqa is on what the earth brings forth of wheat, barley and raisins. He said: 'Amir said: They hold that sorghum (dhura) is among them.

entries.label: Narration
entries.isnad_ar: أَخْبَرَنَا إِسْمَاعِيلُ، قَالَ: حَدَّثَنَا الْحَسَنُ، قَالَ: حَدَّثَنَا يَحْيَى، قَالَ: حَدَّثَنَا عَبْدُ الرَّحِيمِ، عَنْ لَيْثٍ، عَنْ مُجَاهِدٍ، قَالَ:
entries.matn_ar: " إِنَّمَا الصَّدَقَةُ فِي الْحِنْطَةِ، وَالشَّعِيرِ، وَالنَّخْلِ "
entries.isnad_en: Isma'il informed us. He said: al-Hasan narrated to us. He said: Yahya narrated to us. He said: 'Abd al-Rahim narrated to us, from Layth, from Mujahid, who said:
entries.matn_en: Sadaqa is only on wheat, barley and palm.

entries.label: Narration
entries.isnad_ar: أَخْبَرَنَا إِسْمَاعِيلُ، قَالَ: حَدَّثَنَا الْحَسَنُ، قَالَ: حَدَّثَنَا يَحْيَى، قَالَ: حَدَّثَنَا حَسَنُ بْنُ صَالِحٍ، عَنْ مُغِيرَةَ، عَنْ إِبْرَاهِيمَ، قَالَ:
entries.matn_ar: " فِي السُّلْتِ، وَالذُّرَةِ صَدَقَةٌ "
entries.isnad_en: Isma'il informed us. He said: al-Hasan narrated to us. He said: Yahya narrated to us. He said: Hasan b. Salih narrated to us, from Mughira, from Ibrahim, who said:
entries.matn_en: On sult and sorghum (dhura) there is sadaqa.

entries.label: Narration
entries.isnad_ar: أَخْبَرَنَا إِسْمَاعِيلُ، قَالَ: حَدَّثَنَا الْحَسَنُ، قَالَ: حَدَّثَنَا يَحْيَى، قَالَ: حَدَّثَنَا عَبْدُ الرَّحْمَنِ بْنُ حُمَيْدٍ الرُّؤَاسِيُّ، عَنْ أَبِي إِسْحَاقَ، عَنِ الْحَارِثِ، عَنْ عَلِيٍّ رضي الله عنه ، قَالَ:
entries.matn_ar: " الصَّدَقَةُ مِنَ الْبُرِّ، فَإِنْ لَمْ يَكُنْ بُرٌّ فَشَعِيرٌ، فَإِنْ لَمْ يَكُنْ شَعِيرٌ ، فَزَبِيبٌ، فَإِنْ لَمْ يَكُنْ زَبِيبٌ ، فَتَمْرٌ "
entries.isnad_en: Isma'il informed us. He said: al-Hasan narrated to us. He said: Yahya narrated to us. He said: 'Abd al-Rahman b. Humayd al-Ru'asi narrated to us, from Abu Ishaq, from al-Harith, from 'Ali (r), who said:
entries.matn_en: Sadaqa is from wheat (burr); if there is no wheat, then barley; if there is no barley, then raisins; if there are no raisins, then dates.

entries.label: Narration
entries.isnad_ar: أَخْبَرَنَا إِسْمَاعِيلُ، قَالَ: حَدَّثَنَا الْحَسَنُ، قَالَ: حَدَّثَنَا يَحْيَى، قَالَ: حَدَّثَنَا قُرَّانٌ الْأَسَدِيُّ، عَنْ يَحْيَى بْنِ أَبِي أُنَيْسَةَ، عَنْ عَمْرِو بْنِ شُعَيْبٍ، عَنْ أَبِيهِ، عَنْ جَدِّهِ، قَالَ: قَالَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم:
entries.matn_ar: " أَرْبَعٌ لَيْسَ فِيهَا سِوَاهَا شَيْءٌ الْحِنْطَةُ، وَالشَّعِيرُ، وَالتَّمْرُ، وَالزَّبِيبُ "
entries.isnad_en: Isma'il informed us. He said: al-Hasan narrated to us. He said: Yahya narrated to us. He said: Qurran al-Asadi narrated to us, from Yahya b. Abi Unaysa, from 'Amr b. Shu'ayb, from his father, from his grandfather, who said: The Messenger of God ﷺ said:
entries.matn_en: There are four, and on nothing besides them is there anything: wheat, barley, dates and raisins.

entries.label: Narration
entries.isnad_ar: أَخْبَرَنَا إِسْمَاعِيلُ، قَالَ: حَدَّثَنَا الْحَسَنُ، قَالَ: حَدَّثَنَا يَحْيَى، قَالَ: حَدَّثَنَا سُفْيَانُ بْنُ عُيَيْنَةَ، عَنْ عَمْرِو بْنِ دِينَارٍ، عَنْ طَاوُسٍ، قَالَ:
entries.matn_ar: قَالَ مُعَاذٌ بِالْيَمَنِ: " ائْتُونِي بِعَرَضِ ثِيَابٍ آخُذُهُ مِنْكُمْ مَكَانَ الذُّرَةِ وَالشَّعِيرِ، فَإِنَّهُ أَهْوَنُ عَلَيْكُمْ، وَخَيْرٌ لِلْمُهَاجِرِينَ بِالْمَدِينَةِ "
entries.isnad_en: Isma'il informed us. He said: al-Hasan narrated to us. He said: Yahya narrated to us. He said: Sufyan b. 'Uyayna narrated to us, from 'Amr b. Dinar, from Tawus, who said:
entries.matn_en: Mu'adh said in Yemen: Bring me goods of clothing ('arad thiyab) and I shall take it from you in place of sorghum and barley, for that is easier for you and better for the Emigrants in Medina.

entries.label: Narration
entries.isnad_ar: أَخْبَرَنَا إِسْمَاعِيلُ، قَالَ: حَدَّثَنَا الْحَسَنُ، قَالَ: حَدَّثَنَا يَحْيَى، قَالَ: حَدَّثَنَا سُفْيَانُ بْنُ عُيَيْنَةَ، عَنْ إِبْرَاهِيمَ بْنِ مَيْسَرَةَ، عَنْ طَاوُسٍ، قَالَ:
entries.matn_ar: قَالَ مُعَاذٌ بِالْيَمَنِ: " ائْتُونِي بِخَمِيسٍ أَوْ لَبِيسٍ آخُذُهُ مِنْكُمْ مَكَانَ الصَّدَقَةِ، فَإِنَّهُ أَهْوَنُ عَلَيْكُمْ، وَخَيْرٌ لِلْمُهَاجِرِينَ بِالْمَدِينَةِ "
entries.isnad_en: Isma'il informed us. He said: al-Hasan narrated to us. He said: Yahya narrated to us. He said: Sufyan b. 'Uyayna narrated to us, from Ibrahim b. Maysara, from Tawus, who said:
entries.matn_en: Mu'adh said in Yemen: Bring me a khamis or a labis [garment] and I shall take it from you in place of sadaqa, for that is easier for you and better for the Emigrants in Medina.

entries.label: Narration
entries.isnad_ar: أَخْبَرَنَا إِسْمَاعِيلُ، قَالَ: حَدَّثَنَا الْحَسَنُ، قَالَ: حَدَّثَنَا يَحْيَى، قَالَ: حَدَّثَنَا ⦗ص: 148⦘ ابْنُ أَبِي زَائِدَةَ، عَنْ أَشْعَثَ، عَنِ الشَّعْبِيِّ، قَالَ:
entries.matn_ar: " كَانَتِ الصَّدَقَةُ عَلَى عَهْدِ النَّبِيِّ صلى الله عليه وسلم فِي الْحِنْطَةِ، وَالشَّعِيرِ، وَالزَّبِيبِ، وَالتَّمْرِ "
entries.isnad_en: Isma'il informed us. He said: al-Hasan narrated to us. He said: Yahya narrated to us. He said: He said: [p. 148] Ibn Abi Za'ida narrated to us, from Ash'ath, from al-Sha'bi, who said:
entries.matn_en: Sadaqa, in the time of the Prophet ﷺ, was on wheat, barley, raisins and dates.

entries.label: Narration
entries.isnad_ar: أَخْبَرَنَا إِسْمَاعِيلُ، قَالَ: حَدَّثَنَا الْحَسَنُ، قَالَ: حَدَّثَنَا يَحْيَى، قَالَ: حَدَّثَنَا أَبُو زُبَيْدٍ، عَنْ مُحَمَّدِ بْنِ سَالِمٍ عَنِ الشَّعْبِيِّ، قَالَ:
entries.matn_ar: لَيْسَ فِيمَا أَنْبَتَتِ الْأَرْضُ زَكَاةٌ إِلَّا الْحِنْطَةُ، وَالشَّعِيرُ، وَالتَّمْرُ، وَالْكَرْمُ "
entries.isnad_en: Isma'il informed us. He said: al-Hasan narrated to us. He said: Yahya narrated to us. He said: Abu Zubayd narrated to us, from Muhammad b. Salim, from al-Sha'bi, who said:
entries.matn_en: There is no zakat on what the earth grows except wheat, barley, dates and the vine (al-karm).

entries.label: Narration
entries.isnad_ar: أَخْبَرَنَا إِسْمَاعِيلُ، قَالَ: حَدَّثَنَا الْحَسَنُ، قَالَ: حَدَّثَنَا يَحْيَى، قَالَ: حَدَّثَنَا قَيْسٌ، عَنْ مُحَمَّدِ بْنِ سَالِمٍ، عَنِ الشَّعْبِيِّ، قَالَ:
entries.matn_ar: " الصَّدَقَةُ فِي أَرْبَعَةِ أَشْيَاءَ: فِي الْحِنْطَةِ، وَالشَّعِيرِ، وَالتَّمْرِ، وَالزَّبِيبِ "، قَالَ: قُلْتُ: فَإِنْ بَاعَ كَرْمَهُ عِنَبًا؟ قَالَ: " يُخْرِجُ مِنْ ثَمَنِهِ الْعُشْرَ أَوْ نِصْفَ الْعُشْرِ "
entries.isnad_en: Isma'il informed us. He said: al-Hasan narrated to us. He said: Yahya narrated to us. He said: Qays narrated to us, from Muhammad b. Salim, from al-Sha'bi, who said:
entries.matn_en: Sadaqa is on four things: wheat, barley, dates and raisins. He said: I said: And if he sells his vine as grapes? He said: He pays out of its price the tenth or the half-tenth.

entries.label: Narration
entries.isnad_ar: أَخْبَرَنَا إِسْمَاعِيلُ، قَالَ: حَدَّثَنَا الْحَسَنُ، قَالَ: حَدَّثَنَا يَحْيَى، قَالَ: حَدَّثَنَا ابْنُ أَبِي زَائِدَةَ، عَنْ أَشْعَثَ، عَنْ عَامِرٍ، قَالَ:
entries.matn_ar: " كَانَتِ الصَّدَقَةُ عَلَى عَهْدِ النَّبِيِّ صلى الله عليه وسلم فِي الْحِنْطَةِ، وَالشَّعِيرِ، وَالتَّمْرِ، وَالزَّبِيبِ "
entries.isnad_en: Isma'il informed us. He said: al-Hasan narrated to us. He said: Yahya narrated to us. He said: Ibn Abi Za'ida narrated to us, from Ash'ath, from 'Amir, who said:
entries.matn_en: Sadaqa, in the time of the Prophet ﷺ, was on wheat, barley, dates and raisins.

entries.label: Narration
entries.isnad_ar: أَخْبَرَنَا إِسْمَاعِيلُ، قَالَ: حَدَّثَنَا الْحَسَنُ، قَالَ: حَدَّثَنَا يَحْيَى، قَالَ: حَدَّثَنَا ابْنُ الْمُبَارَكِ، عَنِ ابْنِ جُرَيْجٍ، عَنْ عَطَاءٍ، قَالَ:
entries.matn_ar: " لَا صَدَقَةَ إِلَّا فِي نَخْلٍ أَوْ عِنَبٍ أَوْ حَبٍّ، وَلَيْسَ فِي شَيْءٍ مِنَ الْخُضَرِ ، يَعْنِي: وَالْفَوَاكِهِ كُلِّهَا - صَدَقَةٌ "
entries.isnad_en: Isma'il informed us. He said: al-Hasan narrated to us. He said: Yahya narrated to us. He said: Ibn al-Mubarak narrated to us, from Ibn Jurayj, from 'Ata', who said:
entries.matn_en: There is no sadaqa except on palm, grapes or grain; and on none of the greens—meaning: and all the fruits—is there sadaqa.

entries.label: Narration
entries.isnad_ar: أَخْبَرَنَا إِسْمَاعِيلُ، قَالَ: حَدَّثَنَا الْحَسَنُ، قَالَ: حَدَّثَنَا يَحْيَى، قَالَ: حَدَّثَنَا ابْنُ مُبَارَكٍ، عَنْ يُونُسَ، قَالَ:
entries.matn_ar: سَأَلْتُ الزُّهْرِيَّ، عَنْ صَدَقَةِ الْحُبُوبِ، فَقَالَ: " لَيْسَ يَبْلُغْنِي أَنَّ الصَّدَقَةَ إِلَّا فِي الْقَمْحِ وَالشَّعِيرِ وَالنَّخْلِ وَالْعِنَبِ وَالسُّلْتِ وَالزَّيْتُونِ "
entries.isnad_en: Isma'il informed us. He said: al-Hasan narrated to us. He said: Yahya narrated to us. He said: Ibn Mubarak narrated to us, from Yunus, who said:
entries.matn_en: I asked al-Zuhri about the sadaqa of grains, and he said: It has not reached me that there is sadaqa except on wheat, barley, palm, grapes, sult and olives.

entries.label: Narration
entries.isnad_ar: أَخْبَرَنَا إِسْمَاعِيلُ، قَالَ: حَدَّثَنَا الْحَسَنُ، قَالَ: حَدَّثَنَا يَحْيَى، قَالَ: حَدَّثَنَا حَسَنٌ، عَنْ مُغِيرَةَ، عَنْ إِبْرَاهِيمَ، قَالَ:
entries.matn_ar: " فِي السُّلْتِ صَدَقَةٌ "
entries.isnad_en: Isma'il informed us. He said: al-Hasan narrated to us. He said: Yahya narrated to us. He said: Hasan narrated to us, from Mughira, from Ibrahim, who said:
entries.matn_en: On sult there is sadaqa.

entries.label: Narration
entries.isnad_ar: أَخْبَرَنَا إِسْمَاعِيلُ، قَالَ: حَدَّثَنَا الْحَسَنُ، قَالَ: حَدَّثَنَا يَحْيَى، قَالَ: حَدَّثَنَا ⦗ص: 149⦘ أَبُو بَكْرِ بْنُ عَيَّاشٍ، عَنْ مُغِيرَةَ، عَنْ إِبْرَاهِيمَ، قَالَ:
entries.matn_ar: " الصَّدَقَةُ فِي الْحِنْطَةِ، وَالشَّعِيرِ، وَالتَّمْرِ، وَالزَّبِيبِ، وَالدُّخْنِ، وَلَيْسَ مِنْ هَذَا دُونَ خَمْسَةِ أَوْسُقٍ صَدَقَةٌ "
entries.isnad_en: Isma'il informed us. He said: al-Hasan narrated to us. He said: Yahya narrated to us. He said: He said: [p. 149] Abu Bakr b. 'Ayyash narrated to us, from Mughira, from Ibrahim, who said:
entries.matn_en: Sadaqa is on wheat, barley, dates, raisins and millet (dukhn); and there is no sadaqa on any of this below five awsuq.

entries.label: Narration
entries.isnad_ar: أَخْبَرَنَا إِسْمَاعِيلُ، قَالَ: حَدَّثَنَا الْحَسَنُ، قَالَ: حَدَّثَنَا يَحْيَى، قَالَ: حَدَّثَنَا زُهَيْرُ بْنُ مُعَاوِيَةَ، عَنْ مُوسَى بْنِ عُقْبَةَ، عَنْ نَافِعٍ، عَنِ ابْنِ عُمَرَ،
entries.matn_ar: أَنَّهُ كَانَ يَقُولُ فِي صَدَقَةِ الثِّمَارِ وَالزَّرْعِ: " مَا كَانَ مِنْ نَخْلٍ أَوْ كَرْمٍ أَوْ زَرْعٍ ، أَوْ حِنْطَةٍ ، أَوْ شَعِيرٍ ، أَوْ سُلْتٍ، فَفِيهِ الْعُشْرُ أَوْ نِصْفُ الْعُشْرِ "
entries.isnad_en: Isma'il informed us. He said: al-Hasan narrated to us. He said: Yahya narrated to us. He said: Zuhayr b. Mu'awiya narrated to us, from Musa b. 'Uqba, from Nafi', from Ibn 'Umar, that he used to say regarding the sadaqa of fruits and crops:
entries.matn_en: Whatever is of date palm, grapevine, crops, wheat, barley or sult (a kind of barley)—on it is the tenth or half of the tenth.

entries.label: Narration
entries.isnad_ar: أَخْبَرَنَا إِسْمَاعِيلُ، قَالَ: حَدَّثَنَا الْحَسَنُ، قَالَ: حَدَّثَنَا يَحْيَى، قَالَ: حَدَّثَنَا ابْنُ مُبَارَكٍ، عَنْ مُوسَى بْنِ عُقْبَةَ، عَنْ نَافِعٍ، عَنِ ابْنِ عُمَرَ، قَالَ:
entries.matn_ar: " فِي السُّلْتِ صَدَقَةٌ "
entries.isnad_en: Isma'il informed us. He said: al-Hasan narrated to us. He said: Yahya narrated to us. He said: Ibn Mubarak narrated to us, from Musa b. 'Uqba, from Nafi', from Ibn 'Umar, who said:
entries.matn_en: On sult there is sadaqa.

entries.label: Narration
entries.isnad_ar: أَخْبَرَنَا إِسْمَاعِيلُ، قَالَ: حَدَّثَنَا الْحَسَنُ، قَالَ: حَدَّثَنَا يَحْيَى، قَالَ: حَدَّثَنَا الْأَشْجَعِيُّ، عَنْ سُفْيَانَ بْنِ سَعِيدٍ، عَنْ طَلْحَةَ بْنِ يَحْيَى، عَنْ أَبِي بُرْدَةَ، عَنْ أَبِي مُوسَى الْأَشْعَرِيِّ،
entries.matn_ar: وَمُعَاذٍ " أَنَّهُمَا حِينَ بُعِثَا إِلَى الْيَمَنِ لَمْ يَأْخُذَا إِلَّا مِنَ الْحِنْطَةِ وَالشَّعِيرِ وَالتَّمْرِ وَالزَّبِيبِ ". قَالَ الْأَشْجَعِيُّ: وَسَمِعْتُ سُفْيَانَ يَقُولُ: لَيْسَ فِيمَا أَخْرَجَتِ الْأَرْضُ صَدَقَةٌ إِلَّا فِي أَرْبَعَةِ أَشْيَاءَ: الْحِنْطَةِ، وَالشَّعِيرِ، وَالتَّمْرِ، وَالزَّبِيبِ. قَالَ يَحْيَى: فَهَذَا قَوْلُ أَصْحَابِنَا
entries.isnad_en: Isma'il informed us. He said: al-Hasan narrated to us. He said: Yahya narrated to us. He said: al-Ashja'i narrated to us, from Sufyan b. Sa'id, from Talha b. Yahya, from Abu Burda, from Abu Musa al-Ash'ari and Mu'adh:
entries.matn_en: That when the two of them were sent to Yemen they took only from wheat, barley, dates and raisins. Al-Ashja'i said: I heard Sufyan say: There is no sadaqa in what the earth brings forth except in four things: wheat, barley, dates and raisins. Yahya said: This is the opinion of our companions.

entries.label: Narration
entries.isnad_ar: أَخْبَرَنَا إِسْمَاعِيلُ، قَالَ: حَدَّثَنَا الْحَسَنُ، قَالَ: حَدَّثَنَا يَحْيَى، قَالَ: حَدَّثَنَا وَكِيعٌ، قَالَ: حَدَّثَنَا طَلْحَةُ بْنُ يَحْيَى، عَنْ أَبِي بُرْدَةَ، عَنْ أَبِي مُوسَى الْأَشْعَرِيِّ "
entries.matn_ar: أَنَّهُ لَمَّا أَتَى الْيَمَنَ لَمْ يَأْخُذِ الصَّدَقَةَ إِلَّا مِنَ الْحِنْطَةِ، وَالشَّعِيرِ، وَالتَّمْرِ، وَالزَّبِيبِ "
entries.isnad_en: Isma'il informed us. He said: al-Hasan narrated to us. He said: Yahya narrated to us. He said: Waki' narrated to us. He said: Talha b. Yahya narrated to us, from Abu Burda, from Abu Musa al-Ash'ari:
entries.matn_en: That when he came to Yemen he took the sadaqa only from wheat, barley, dates and raisins.

entries.label: Narration
entries.isnad_ar: أَخْبَرَنَا إِسْمَاعِيلُ، قَالَ: حَدَّثَنَا الْحَسَنُ، قَالَ: حَدَّثَنَا يَحْيَى، قَالَ: حَدَّثَنَا أَبُو بَكْرِ بْنُ عَيَّاشٍ، عَنْ مُغِيرَةَ، عَنْ إِبْرَاهِيمَ، قَالَ:
entries.matn_ar: " الصَّدَقَةُ فِي الْحِنْطَةِ، وَالشَّعِيرِ، وَالتَّمْرِ، ⦗ص: 150⦘ وَالزَّبِيبِ، وَالدُّخْنِ، وَلَيْسَ فِي شَيْءٍ مِنْ هَذَا دُونَ خَمْسَةِ أَوْسُقٍ صَدَقَةٌ "
entries.isnad_en: Isma'il informed us. He said: al-Hasan narrated to us. He said: Yahya narrated to us. He said: Abu Bakr b. 'Ayyash narrated to us, from Mughira, from Ibrahim, who said:
entries.matn_en: Sadaqa is due on wheat, barley, dates, [p. 150] raisins and millet (dukhn), and there is no sadaqa on any of this below five awsuq.

sections.title_en: Chapter: Whoever Said That What Does Not Last in People’s Hands for the Year, of Measured Grain and the Like, Is Not Subject to Zakāt
sections.title_ar: بَابٌ: مَنْ قَالَ مَا يَحِيلُ فِي أَيْدِي النَّاسِ مِمَّا يُكَالُ مِنَ الْحَبِّ وَنَحْوِهِ

entries.label: Narration
entries.isnad_ar: أَخْبَرَنَا إِسْمَاعِيلُ، قَالَ: حَدَّثَنَا الْحَسَنُ، قَالَ: حَدَّثَنَا يَحْيَى، قَالَ: حَدَّثَنَا مُفَضَّلُ بْنُ مُهَلْهَلٍ، عَنِ الْمُغِيرَةِ، عَنْ مُجَاهِدٍ "
entries.matn_ar: أَنَّهُ كَانَ لَا يَرَى الصَّدَقَةَ فِي الْبُقُولِ، وَالْكُمَّثْرَى، وَأَشْبَاهِهِ، وَفِيمَا لَا يَحُولُ عَلَيْهِ الْحَوْلُ "
entries.isnad_en: Isma'il informed us. He said: al-Hasan narrated to us. He said: Yahya narrated to us. He said: Mufaddal b. Muhalhil narrated to us, from al-Mughira, from Mujahid:
entries.matn_en: That he did not consider sadaqa due on vegetables, pears and the like, nor on what does not last the year.

entries.label: Narration
entries.isnad_ar: أَخْبَرَنَا إِسْمَاعِيلُ، قَالَ: حَدَّثَنَا الْحَسَنُ، قَالَ: حَدَّثَنَا يَحْيَى، قَالَ: حَدَّثَنَا أَبُو حَمَّادٍ الْحَنَفِيُّ، عَنْ مُغِيرَةَ، عَنْ مُجَاهِدٍ، قَالَ:
entries.matn_ar: " لَيْسَ فِي التُّفَّاحِ وَالْكُمَّثْرَى وَأَشْبَاهِهِ مِنَ الْبُقُولِ مِمَّا لَا يَحُولُ حَوْلًا صَدَقَةٌ "
entries.isnad_en: Isma'il informed us. He said: al-Hasan narrated to us. He said: Yahya narrated to us. He said: Abu Hammad al-Hanafi narrated to us, from Mughira, from Mujahid, who said:
entries.matn_en: There is no sadaqa on apples, pears and the like of the vegetables, which do not last a year.

entries.label: Narration
entries.isnad_ar: أَخْبَرَنَا إِسْمَاعِيلُ، قَالَ: حَدَّثَنَا الْحَسَنُ، قَالَ: حَدَّثَنَا يَحْيَى، قَالَ: حَدَّثَنَا أَبُو بَكْرِ بْنُ عَيَّاشٍ، عَنْ مُغِيرَةَ، قَالَ: كَتَبَ مُوسَى بْنُ الْمُغِيرَةِ،
entries.matn_ar: إِلَى الْحَجَّاجِ، أَنَّ مُوسَى بْنَ طَلْحَةَ، أَخْبَرَنِي " أَنَّهُ لَيْسَ فِي شَيْءٍ مِنَ الْبُقُولِ وَمِمَّا لَا يَحُولُ فِي أَيْدِي النَّاسِ زَكَاةٌ "
entries.isnad_en: Isma'il informed us. He said: al-Hasan narrated to us. He said: Yahya narrated to us. He said: Abu Bakr b. 'Ayyash narrated to us, from Mughira, who said: Musa b. al-Mughira wrote to al-Hajjaj that Musa b. Talha informed me:
entries.matn_en: That there is no zakat on any vegetables, nor on what does not last in people’s hands.

entries.label: Narration
entries.isnad_ar: أَخْبَرَنَا إِسْمَاعِيلُ، قَالَ: حَدَّثَنَا الْحَسَنُ، قَالَ: حَدَّثَنَا يَحْيَى، قَالَ: حَدَّثَنَا قَيْسُ بْنُ الرَّبِيعِ، عَنْ خُصَيْفٍ، عَنْ مُجَاهِدٍ، قَالَ:
entries.matn_ar: " لَيْسَ فِي التِّينِ زَكَاةٌ، إِلَّا أَنْ يُجْمَعَ ⦗ص: 151⦘ وَيَيْبَسَ "
entries.isnad_en: Isma'il informed us. He said: al-Hasan narrated to us. He said: Yahya narrated to us. He said: Qays b. al-Rabi' narrated to us, from Khusayf, from Mujahid, who said:
entries.matn_en: There is no zakat on figs, unless they are gathered [p. 151] and dried.

entries.label: Narration
entries.isnad_ar: أَخْبَرَنَا إِسْمَاعِيلُ، قَالَ: حَدَّثَنَا الْحَسَنُ، قَالَ: حَدَّثَنَا يَحْيَى، قَالَ: حَدَّثَنَا أَبُو حَمَّادٍ، عَنْ خُصَيْفٍ، عَنْ مُجَاهِدٍ، قَالَ:
entries.matn_ar: " لَيْسَ فِي الْخُضَرِ زَكَاةٌ، إِلَّا ثَمَرَةً يَابِسَةً تُجْمَعُ
entries.isnad_en: Isma'il informed us. He said: al-Hasan narrated to us. He said: Yahya narrated to us. He said: Abu Hammad narrated to us, from Khusayf, from Mujahid, who said:
entries.matn_en: There is no zakat on greens, except dried fruit that is gathered.

entries.label: Narration
entries.matn_ar: " قَالَ يَحْيَى: وَهَذَا يُشْبِهُ قَوْلَ مَنْ قَالَ مَا كَانَ يَبْقَى فِي أَيْدِي النَّاسِ إِلَى الْحَوْلِ مِمَّا يُكَالُ
entries.isnad_en: Yahya said:
entries.matn_en: This resembles the saying of those who said: zakat is due on whatever remains in people’s hands until the year, of what is measured.

entries.label: Narration
entries.isnad_ar: أَخْبَرَنَا إِسْمَاعِيلُ، قَالَ: حَدَّثَنَا الْحَسَنُ، قَالَ: حَدَّثَنَا يَحْيَى، قَالَ: حَدَّثَنَا ابْنُ مُبَارَكٍ، عَنْ مَعْمَرٍ، قَالَ:
entries.matn_ar: سَأَلْتُ الزُّهْرِيَّ عَنِ الزَّيْتُونِ، فَقَالَ: " هُوَ يُكَالُ فِيهِ الْعُشْرُ
entries.isnad_en: Isma'il informed us. He said: al-Hasan narrated to us. He said: Yahya narrated to us. He said: Ibn Mubarak narrated to us, from Ma'mar, who said:
entries.matn_en: I asked al-Zuhri about olives, and he said: It is measured, and the tenth is due on it.

entries.label: Narration
entries.matn_ar: " قَالَ يَحْيَى: كَأَنَّهُ يَرَى الزَّكَاةَ فِيمَا يُكَالُ، وَأَمَّا عَلِيٌّ وَعُمَرُ فَقَدْ ذَكَرُوا عَنْهُمَا: " أَنَّهُ لَيْسَ فِي الْخُضَرِ صَدَقَةٌ
entries.isnad_en: Yahya said:
entries.matn_en: It is as though he holds that zakat is due on what is measured. As for 'Ali and 'Umar, it has been mentioned from them: that there is no sadaqa on greens (al-khudar).

entries.label: Narration
entries.isnad_ar: أَخْبَرَنَا إِسْمَاعِيلُ، قَالَ: حَدَّثَنَا الْحَسَنُ، قَالَ: حَدَّثَنَا يَحْيَى، قَالَ: حَدَّثَنَا عَبْدُ الرَّحْمَنِ بْنُ حُمَيْدٍ الرُّؤَاسِيُّ، عَنْ جَعْفَرِ بْنِ نَجِيحٍ السَّعْدِيِّ الْمَدَنِيِّ، عَنْ بِشْرِ بْنِ عَاصِمٍ،
entries.matn_ar: وَعُثْمَانَ بْنِ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ بْنِ أَوْسٍ: أَنَّ سُفْيَانَ بْنَ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ الثَّقَفِيَّ، كَتَبَ إِلَى عُمَرَ بْنِ الْخَطَّابِ رضي الله عنه وَكَانَ عَامِلًا لَهُ عَلَى الطَّائِفِ - فَكَتَبَ إِلَيْهِ: أَنَّ قِبَلَهُ حِيطَانًا فِيهَا كُرُومٌ، وَفِيهَا مِنَ الْفَرْسَكِ، وَالرُّمَّانِ مَا هُوَ أَكْثَرُ غَلَّةً مِنَ الْكَرْمِ أَضْعَافًا، فَكَتَبَ إِلَيْهِ يَسْتَأْمِرُهُ فِي الْعُشْرِ، قَالَ: فَكَتَبَ إِلَيْهِ عُمَرُ: " إِنَّهُ لَيْسَ عَلَيْهَا عُشْرٌ "، وَقَالَ: " هِيَ مِنَ الْعِضَاهِ كُلِّهَا، وَلَيْسَ عَلَيْهَا صَدَقَةٌ "
entries.isnad_en: Isma'il informed us. He said: al-Hasan narrated to us. He said: Yahya narrated to us. He said: 'Abd al-Rahman b. Humayd al-Ru'asi narrated to us, from Ja'far b. Najih al-Sa'di al-Madani, from Bishr b. 'Asim and 'Uthman b. 'Abd Allah b. Aws:
entries.matn_en: That Sufyan b. 'Abd Allah al-Thaqafi wrote to 'Umar b. al-Khattab (r)—he was his governor over al-Ta'if—that in his district there were orchards with vines, and among them were peaches (firsak) and pomegranates that yield many times more than the vine; so he wrote asking his instruction about the tenth. He said: 'Umar wrote back to him: There is no tenth on them. And he said: They belong to the 'idah (thorny wild trees) altogether, and there is no sadaqa on them.

entries.label: Narration
entries.isnad_ar: أَخْبَرَنَا إِسْمَاعِيلُ، قَالَ: حَدَّثَنَا الْحَسَنُ، قَالَ: حَدَّثَنَا يَحْيَى، قَالَ: حَدَّثَنَا حَفْصُ بْنُ غِيَاثٍ، عَنْ لَيْثٍ، عَنْ مُجَاهِدٍ، عَنْ عُمَرَ، قَالَ:
entries.matn_ar: " لَيْسَ فِي الْخُضْرَوَاتِ صَدَقَةٌ "
entries.isnad_en: Isma'il informed us. He said: al-Hasan narrated to us. He said: Yahya narrated to us. He said: Hafs b. Ghiyath narrated to us, from Layth, from Mujahid, from 'Umar, who said:
entries.matn_en: There is no sadaqa on vegetables (al-khudrawat).

entries.label: Narration
entries.isnad_ar: أَخْبَرَنَا إِسْمَاعِيلُ، قَالَ: حَدَّثَنَا الْحَسَنُ، قَالَ: حَدَّثَنَا يَحْيَى، قَالَ: حَدَّثَنَا أَبُو مُعَاوِيَةَ، عَنْ لَيْثٍ، عَنْ مُجَاهِدٍ، عَنْ عُمَرَ رضي الله عنه، قَالَ:
entries.matn_ar: " لَيْسَ فِي الْخُضْرَاوَاتِ زَكَاةٌ "
entries.isnad_en: Isma'il informed us. He said: al-Hasan narrated to us. He said: Yahya narrated to us. He said: Abu Mu'awiya narrated to us, from Layth, from Mujahid, from 'Umar (r), who said:
entries.matn_en: There is no zakat on vegetables.

entries.label: Narration
entries.isnad_ar: أَخْبَرَنَا إِسْمَاعِيلُ، قَالَ: حَدَّثَنَا الْحَسَنُ، قَالَ: حَدَّثَنَا يَحْيَى، قَالَ: حَدَّثَنَا عَبْدُ الرَّحِيمِ، عَنْ لَيْثِ بْنِ أَبِي سُلَيْمٍ، عَنْ مُجَاهِدٍ، عَنْ عُمَرَ بْنِ الْخَطَّابِ رضي الله عنه: "
entries.matn_ar: لَيْسَ فِي الْخُضْرَاوَاتِ زَكَاةٌ "
entries.isnad_en: Isma'il informed us. He said: al-Hasan narrated to us. He said: Yahya narrated to us. He said: 'Abd al-Rahim narrated to us, from Layth b. Abi Sulaym, from Mujahid, from 'Umar b. al-Khattab (r):
entries.matn_en: There is no zakat on vegetables.

entries.label: Narration
entries.isnad_ar: أَخْبَرَنَا إِسْمَاعِيلُ، قَالَ: حَدَّثَنَا الْحَسَنُ، قَالَ: حَدَّثَنَا يَحْيَى، قَالَ: حَدَّثَنَا أَبُو الْأَحْوَصِ، عَنْ مُغِيرَةَ، عَنْ مُجَاهِدٍ، قَالَ:
entries.matn_ar: " لَيْسَ فِي الْفَوَاكِهِ وَالْبُقُولِ صَدَقَةٌ "
entries.isnad_en: Isma'il informed us. He said: al-Hasan narrated to us. He said: Yahya narrated to us. He said: Abu al-Ahwas narrated to us, from Mughira, from Mujahid, who said:
entries.matn_en: There is no sadaqa on fruits and vegetables.

entries.label: Narration
entries.isnad_ar: أَخْبَرَنَا إِسْمَاعِيلُ، قَالَ: حَدَّثَنَا الْحَسَنُ، قَالَ: حَدَّثَنَا يَحْيَى، قَالَ: حَدَّثَنَا عَبْدُ السَّلَامِ بْنُ حَرْبٍ، عَنْ لَيْثٍ، عَنْ مُجَاهِدٍ، قَالَ:
entries.matn_ar: " لَيْسَ فِي الْخُضَرِ صَدَقَةٌ "
entries.isnad_en: Isma'il informed us. He said: al-Hasan narrated to us. He said: Yahya narrated to us. He said: 'Abd al-Salam b. Harb narrated to us, from Layth, from Mujahid, who said:
entries.matn_en: There is no sadaqa on greens.

entries.label: Narration
entries.isnad_ar: أَخْبَرَنَا إِسْمَاعِيلُ، قَالَ: حَدَّثَنَا الْحَسَنُ، قَالَ: حَدَّثَنَا يَحْيَى، قَالَ: حَدَّثَنَا قَيْسُ بْنُ الرَّبِيعِ، عَنْ أَبِي إِسْحَاقَ، عَنْ عَاصِمِ بْنِ ضَمْرَةَ، عَنْ عَلِيٍّ رضي الله عنه قَالَ:
entries.matn_ar: " لَيْسَ فِي الْبُقُولِ وَالْخُضَرِ صَدَقَةٌ "
entries.isnad_en: Isma'il informed us. He said: al-Hasan narrated to us. He said: Yahya narrated to us. He said: Qays b. al-Rabi' narrated to us, from Abu Ishaq, from 'Asim b. Damra, from 'Ali (r), who said:
entries.matn_en: There is no sadaqa on vegetables and greens.

entries.label: Narration
